The observation informs understanding of how pre-trained representational biases toward text formatting scale up to system-level behavior in closed-loop interactions, with direct implications for multi-agent prompt design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Implements a minimal coupled circular phase oscillator setup with 17 stateless, goal-free agents with no access to history or identity. At each step, each agent receives only an encoded text summary of neighboring agents' relative phases, and outputs one of three actions (advance/stay/retard) to adjust its phase, with identical physical update rules across all conditions. Three encodings are tested, all computed from the same underlying phase distribution: low-order circular moments summarizing distribution direction and concentration, a 24-bin histogram labeled by bin centers, and an identical 24-bin histogram labeled by interval bounds. Initial random seeds are matched across conditions, a zero-coupling (K=0) control rules out engine confounds, and separate open-loop tests with fixed synthetic fields measure action response operators independent of closed-loop feedback effects.
summary_en.experiments: On GPT-5.4-mini, moment encoding achieved full synchronization (final polar order parameter r1 ~ 1) across 6/6 random seeds at positive coupling values, while both histogram encodings achieved 0/6 full synchronization. Center-labeled histograms produced only partial alignment, while interval-labeled histograms frequently converged to a stable two-cluster opposing state. The K=0 control produced identical physical trajectories across all encodings, eliminating initial condition and engine implementation confounds. Open-loop response measurements showed moment encoding produces pure directional attraction, interval encoding produces a two-lobed response with zero net directional bias, and center encoding produces a reversed net retarding bias. The qualitative encoding effect replicated on Claude, though the direction of effect across encodings was reversed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core design insights; focus on the control variable rationale (why the stateless, goal-free setup and K=0 control are required for valid causal attribution) and the result contrasts in Figures 1 and 2. No deep background in coupled oscillator theory is needed; estimated reading time 15 minutes. The core takeaway is that pre-trained models' inherent response biases to different text representations are strong enough to shape divergent macro-scale system outcomes in closed-loop interaction.

recommendation.zh: 实验设计干净，强提醒：状态序列化方式直接决定 agent 群体行为，做 agent/长链推理时别把 prompt 格式当无关变量；读 Fig2 和 replay 对照。
recommendation.en: A clean experiment showing state serialization is not a passive wrapper but an interaction term; read Fig. 2 and the replay control before designing agent interfaces.

paper.title: OrchestraBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Failure Modes, Recovery, and Decomposition Quality
paper.abstract: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks are moving from demos to production, yet benchmarks typically report task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown. OrchestraBench evaluates failure, recovery, and decomposition through a controlled, seed-reproducible failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows. It introduces cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics and compares routing pol

summary.core_problem: 多agent编排基准只报告任务准确率，无法诊断失败原因、级联起点或具体路由决策的问题。
summary.importance: 首个通过可控故障注入系统评估多agent编排的失败模式、恢复能力和分解质量的基准，引入级联半径和单故障模式恢复率等新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 基于模板化企业工作流的种子可复现故障注入harness，使用bootstrap置信区间和配对检验比较路由策略。
summary.experiments: 在26个金标诊断案例上，关键词/flag路由器在有误导或缺失表面flag的对抗案例上得0分，意图推理模型路由器得100%匹配oracle；真实Claude agent在算术依赖链上揭示三级故障处理层次。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent orchestration benchmarks report only task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown.
summary_en.importance: First benchmark to evaluate failure, recovery, and decomposition in multi-agent orchestration via controlled, seed-reproducible failure injection, introducing cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows, comparing routing policies with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired statistical tests.
summary_en.experiments: On a 26-case gold diagnostic, keyword/flag routers scored 0% on adversarial cases with misleading/missing surface flags, while an intent-reasoning model router scored 100% matching the oracle; probes with a real Claude agent revealed three failure-handling tiers across five MAST modes.

recommendation.zh: 多agent编排的故障注入评测框架，关键词路由在对抗场景下完全失效这一点值得注意，但对预训练研究员主要是了解agent能力边界。
recommendation.en: Failure-injection benchmark for multi-agent orchestration; the 0% vs 100% gap between keyword and reasoning routers is notable, mainly useful for understanding agent capability boundaries.

paper.title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attrib

summary.core_problem: 在性别歧视检测中保留标注者之间的真实分歧，而不是把分歧压成多数票标签。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练和偏好优化的任务化改造。它对 alignment 的一个小问题有参考意义：偏好数据中的 disagreement 可能不是噪声，而是需要显式建模的多视角信号；但任务范围较窄，离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAP-PO，即先按标注行为聚类标注者，而不是按人口统计属性分组；再为每个聚类微调一个 LLM agent 来复现该群体标注模式；最后用结合个体奖励和团队奖励的 preference optimization 协调多个 agent。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 EXIST 2024 英语和西班牙语推文数据，在两种语言和两种 backbone LLM 上形成四个设置；评估每个 agent 是否复现自身 cluster 的标注，以及多 agent 集体是否复现多数标签。摘要未给出具体模型名称、参数量和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Utrecht University；未见与 LLM 基座预训练相关的代表性团队信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to preserve genuine annotator disagreement in sexism detection instead of collapsing it into a majority-vote label.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task-specific adaptation of preference optimization. It is mildly relevant to alignment because it treats disagreement in preference data as structured signal rather than noise, but the setup remains narrow and far from foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAP-PO first clusters annotators by labeling behavior rather than demographic attributes. It then fine-tunes one LLM agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster’s annotation pattern, and coordinates agents through preference optimization with both individual and team-level rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use the EXIST 2024 English and Spanish tweet dataset, with four settings from two languages and two backbone LLMs. The evaluation checks cluster-level reproduction and majority-label reproduction. The abstract does not provide exact backbone sizes or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Utrecht University; no foundation-model pretraining track record is identifiable from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它把偏好分歧当训练信号，但 sexism 数据集太窄，别外推到通用对齐。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework only: it treats preference disagreement as signal, but the sexism-detection setting is too narrow to generalize.

paper.title: When Does Latent Communication Pay? A Causal Audit of Relayed KV Caches in Multi-Agent LLMs
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems relay key--value caches instead of text and credit their gains to exchanged ``latent thoughts''. That credit is a claim about \emph{which} example's cache is relayed, not merely that one is. We audit it causally in released systems. The cache is replaced with deranged (mismatched-example), zeroed, and moment-matched random counterparts, under two regimes defined by whether the receiver needs the sender's private information. Where it does, the battery reads ceiling: 100\%

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 LLM 系统中，用 KV 缓存中继代替文本通信被广泛归因于「传递了示例特定的潜在思想」，但这一归因从未被因果验证：性能提升既可能来自缓存中携带的真实示例内容，也可能只是任何合法形状的缓存前缀对接收方产生的通用接口扰动效应；现有评估只看是否有缓存，不看缓存和示例是否匹配。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心价值是方法论层面的：第一，给出了「中继内容是否真的被使用」的因果审计标准——必须做错例匹配控制，而不能只做有无缓存的消融；第二，揭示了 KV 缓存中继的收益高度依赖任务信息结构：只有当接收方确实需要发送方的私有信息时，示例匹配的缓存才带来真实收益；在接收方本身就能解题的标准基准上，缓存匹配效应通常落在等价区间内，不能作为「潜在思想传输」的证据；第三，同一审计工具可以跨系统移植，直接区分不同已发布 KV 通信方案的实际内容传输等级，对后续设计跨模型/跨智能体表示接口有直接约束作用。
summary.technical_approach: 审计在已发布系统的中继边界上做无训练干预，保持缓存的层数、序列长度、数据类型完全一致，只替换内容，共六个实验臂：True（配对示例的真实缓存）、Deranged（同批次其他示例的缓存，无固定点置换，严格保持缓存边际分布）、Zero（全零缓存）、Random（按每层每 K/V 张量匹配真实矩的高斯随机缓存）、Intact-no-private（发送方处理时把私有信息替换为无关内容，仅在校准任务使用）、Direct-text reference（私有信息直接以文本形式给接收方）。任务分两类：校准任务（程序化生成发送方私有事实，接收方无法自行恢复）和自然任务（GSM8K、ARC-Challenge、MedQA 等标准基准，接收方可独立解题）。核心对比是 True 与 Deranged 的差异，即「示例配对项」，这是「潜在内容被使用」这一归因成立的必要条件。
summary.experiments: 校准任务上，在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、phi-4 共五个检查点、三个模型家族、以及散文反事实 QA 任务面上，True 臂准确率接近 100%，Deranged/无关内容臂仅 23–25%，示例配对效应达到天花板，说明审计工具有效。自然任务上，采用五种子的预注册协议、Holm 校正的等价性检验：在 GSM8K、ARC-Challenge 上三个 Qwen3 尺度、以及 MedQA 8B 上，True 与 Deranged 的差异被约束在 ±2.8 分以内（该边际来自被审计系统自身报告的收益幅度），仅有一个单元检测到边际内的微小优势；第二个模型家族未检测到任何配对优势。值得注意的是，Zero 臂在一个自然任务单元上比 True 低 14.7 分，但 Deranged 与 True 无显著差异——说明存在缓存本身的通用收益，但不存在示例特定的内容传输。跨系统移植审计时，三种已发布的 KV 通信方案（原生 LatentMAS、C2C、KVComm）在同一信息不对称测试下分别表现为天花板级、部分传输、未检测到示例传输三种不同等级，证明审计工具可以区分方案差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30–40 分钟。重点看四部分：1）第 2 节审计设计的六个实验臂定义，尤其是 Deranged 臂作为内容控制的逻辑；2）第 3 节校准任务与自然任务的划分，以及「示例配对项」这个核心因果量的定义；3）第 4 节自然任务上的等价性检验结果，特别是 Zero 与 Deranged 结果分离的那个案例；4）第 5 节跨系统移植的结果，理解不同 KV 通信方案的实际传输等级。值得深挖的点：错例匹配控制这一思路可以迁移到任何「中间表示传输」类工作的评估中，包括蒸馏、跨模型投影、多模态对齐中的隐式特征传递。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent LLM systems that relay KV caches instead of text, performance gains are widely attributed to "transmitted latent thoughts" specific to each example. This attribution has never been causally validated: gains could equally come from genuine example-specific content in the cache, or from generic interface effects where any well-formed cache prefix perturbs the receiver in helpful ways. Existing evaluations only compare presence versus absence of a cache, not whether the cache matches the example.
summary_en.importance: The core value for pretraining research is methodological. First, it establishes a causal audit standard for "is the relayed content actually used?": a mismatched-example control is mandatory, and ablation on cache presence alone is insufficient. Second, it reveals that KV-relay gains are highly contingent on the task's information structure: example-matched caches deliver real benefits only when the receiver genuinely needs the sender's private information; on standard benchmarks where the receiver can solve the task alone, the example-matching effect usually falls within an equivalence bound and cannot serve as evidence for "latent thought transmission". Third, the same audit is portable across systems and directly distinguishes the actual content-transfer levels of different released KV-communication schemes, imposing concrete constraints on future cross-model / cross-agent representation interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The audit performs training-free interventions exactly at the relay boundary of released systems. Cache geometry (layer count, sequence length, dtype) is held fixed across arms, and only the content is replaced. Six arms are defined: True (cache from the paired example), Deranged (cache from a different example in the same batch via a fixed-point-free permutation, preserving the marginal cache distribution exactly), Zero (all entries zeroed), Random (Gaussian entries moment-matched per example, layer, and K/V tensor to the true cache), Intact-no-private (sender processes the example with private facts replaced by irrelevant counterparts, used only in the calibrated regime), and Direct-text reference (private information passed verbatim to the receiver). Tasks are split into two regimes: a calibrated regime with procedurally generated sender-private facts unrecoverable by the receiver, and a natural regime using standard benchmarks (GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, MedQA) where the receiver can solve alone. The key contrast is True minus Deranged — the "example-pairing term" — which is the necessary condition for the "latent content is used" attribution.
summary_en.experiments: In the calibrated regime, across five checkpoints from three model families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, phi-4) and a prose counterfactual QA surface, the True arm reaches near 100% accuracy versus 23–25% for Deranged / answer-irrelevant arms, showing the audit instrument reads at ceiling where it should. In the natural regime, under a pre-registered five-seed protocol with Holm-corrected equivalence testing, the True-versus-Deranged gap is bounded within ±2.8 points (a margin anchored to the audited system's own reported gain) on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge across three Qwen3 scales, and on MedQA at 8B; only one cell shows a small detected advantage inside the margin, and a second model family shows no detected pairing advantage at all. Notably, in one natural-regime cell the Zero arm trails True by 14.7 points while Deranged is indistinguishable from True — meaning there is a generic benefit from having any cache, but no example-specific content transfer. When ported across systems, three released KV-communication channels (native LatentMAS, C2C, KVComm) read ceiling, partial transfer, and no detected example-specific transfer respectively under the same information-asymmetry test, demonstrating the audit discriminates between schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 30–40 minutes. Focus on four parts. (1) Section 2's definition of the six audit arms, especially the logic behind the Deranged arm as the canonical content control. (2) Section 3's split between calibrated and natural regimes, and the definition of the example-pairing term as the core causal quantity. (3) Section 4's equivalence-test results on natural tasks, particularly the case where Zero and Deranged outcomes dissociate. (4) Section 5's cross-system portability results, to grasp the real transfer levels of different KV-communication designs. A point worth extending: the mismatched-example control idea generalizes to the evaluation of any "intermediate representation transfer" setting, including distillation, cross-model projection, and implicit feature transfer in multimodal alignment.

recommendation.zh: 把'latent thought 通信'拆成信息论问题的因果审计很干净；结论是 KV 中继只在真有私有信息时有用，读干预设计和 TOST 部分。
recommendation.en: A clean causal audit reducing 'latent thought communication' to an information question; KV relay only helps when private info actually exists. Read the intervention design and TOST section.

paper.title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plaus

summary.core_problem: 研究临床多 agent 委员会是否会被 benchmark shortcut 和同伴错误意见诱导，从而在表面协作中传播错误答案。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 行为机制与评测污染分析。虽然实验场景是临床任务，但“同伴错误级联”和“同源 judge 失效”对通用 multi-agent eval 有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 在共享工作区的 Gemini agent committee 中注入不同类型 shortcut：单独提示线索、两个同伴给出同一错误答案、虚假 pre-screen 系统标记，并比较 gate、同源 transcript judge、私下重问 holdout 的 referee 三类监督 agent。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 7 个 cohort、6 个公开数据集，包括 MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、MIMIC-CXR reports、NIH ChestX-ray14、MIMIC-CXR-JPG、CheXpert 和 SUPPORT2。Gemini committee 对孤立 shortcut 的翻转率为 5-16%；当两个 peer 坚持同一错误答案时，被测 holdout 在 38% 情况下采纳；虚假 pre-screen flag 也有类似影响。gate 的 false-positive rate 为 100%；同源 judge 在文本任务上 precision 100%、recall 93%，但在影像任务上退化；私下重问的 referee 能迁移到影像场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether clinical multi-agent committees can be manipulated by benchmark shortcuts and peer-induced wrong answers, causing errors to spread through apparent deliberation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis of agent behavior mechanisms and benchmark gaming. Although the setting is clinical, peer-error cascades and same-lineage judge failures are relevant to general multi-agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors inject different shortcuts into Gemini agent committees operating on a shared workspace: isolated cue shortcuts, two peers asserting the same wrong answer, and a false pre-screen system flag. They compare three oversight agents: a gate, a same-lineage transcript judge, and a referee that privately re-queries the holdout.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans seven cohorts and six public datasets: MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports, NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert, and SUPPORT2. Gemini committees flip only 5-16% under isolated shortcuts, but the tested holdout adopts a wrong answer in 38% of cases when two peers assert it; false pre-screen flags have similar effects. The gate has 100% false-positive rate; a same-lineage judge reaches 100% precision and 93% recall on text but collapses on imaging; a private re-query referee transfers better to imaging.

recommendation.zh: 临床外壳可以跳过，38% peer cascade 和 judge 同源失效值得记入 multi-agent eval 风险清单。
recommendation.en: Ignore the clinical wrapper; the 38% peer cascade and same-lineage judge failure belong on the multi-agent eval risk list.

paper.title: An Actionable Diagnosis of Multilingual, Multi-Agent Planning Failures
paper.abstract: Multilingual multi-agent systems exhibit substantial degradation beyond English, yet prior work rarely identifies how task-critical information is lost when user requests are converted into executable plans. We study the planner in a multi-agent system as the request-to-action interface and derive an actionable taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. LLM-based analysis shows that these failures constitute an increasing share of unsuccessful executions as l

summary.core_problem: 诊断多语言多智能体系统中用户请求转成可执行计划时，任务关键信息如何丢失，并提出可操作的缓解方式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent planning failure taxonomy 加轻量方法改进。它关注低资源语言下 planner 作为 request-to-action interface 的失效，而不是只报告多语言性能下降。
summary.technical_approach: 从真实任务执行失败中归纳 planning-grounding failure taxonomy，并提出 TART，即 Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation，把 taxonomy 中关键维度显式传给 planner 和下游 sub-agents，以减少计划和执行之间的信息错配。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个语言、3 个 LLM backbone、2 个数据集和 2 种 agentic configuration。摘要称 TART 在多语言设置中稳定提升性能，并在 multilingual GAIA 上提高一个已有强系统的准确率，但给定摘要截断，未提供具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Fujitsu Research of Europe 和 Fujitsu Research，团队关注多语言与企业级 agent 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses how task-critical information is lost when multilingual user requests are converted into executable plans in multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a planning-failure taxonomy plus a mitigation method. It focuses on the planner as the request-to-action interface, especially under low-resource languages, rather than merely reporting multilingual degradation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors derive a taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. They introduce TART, Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation, which explicitly exposes key failure-relevant aspects to the planner and downstream sub-agents.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span multiple languages, three LLM backbones, two datasets, and two agentic configurations. The abstract reports consistent gains from TART and an accuracy improvement on multilingual GAIA, but the provided text is truncated before the exact number.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fujitsu Research of Europe and Fujitsu Research, with a focus on multilingual and enterprise agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 读 taxonomy 和 TART prompt/schema 就够；对 pretrain 没直接动作，但能提醒低资源语言的 planning bottleneck。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and TART schema only; no direct pretrain action, but it isolates a real multilingual planning bottleneck.

paper.title: AgentPanel: Toward a New Paradigm for Human--AI Collaboration in Exploring Scientific Questions
paper.abstract: Identifying promising scientific ideas remains an important challenge in research practice. Researchers commonly rely on small-group discussions or one-to-one interactions with a single large language model, yet these approaches often expose them to only a limited range of perspectives and directions. We present AgentPanel, a multi-agent forum for human--AI collaboration in scientific exploration. Heterogeneous agents asynchronously discuss scientific questions in a forum-style environment, whil

summary.core_problem: 现有科学探索场景中，小组讨论或单LLM交互存在视角覆盖有限、探索方向狭窄的问题
summary.importance: 提出论坛式多Agent人机协作新范式（系统/方法创新），为科学探索类多Agent异步协作提供了可落地的框架
summary.technical_approach: 构建异构Agent异步讨论的论坛环境，支持研究者提交问题、整理候选idea、发起跟进交互、生成总结报告；用异步分布式讨论替代传统集中式多Agent辩论机制
summary.experiments: 离线实验中效果优于集中式多Agent辩论基线；20名参与者的人类实验显示用户认可其在视角多样性、探索广度上的价值

summary_en.core_problem: Scientific idea exploration is limited by narrow perspective coverage in small-group discussions or single-LLM one-to-one interactions
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel forum-style multi-agent human-AI collaboration paradigm (system/method innovation) and provides a feasible framework for asynchronous multi-agent scientific exploration
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an asynchronous forum environment with heterogeneous agents; supports researchers to submit questions, curate candidate ideas, launch follow-up interactions, and generate summary reports; replaces traditional centralized multi-agent debate with asynchronous distributed discussion
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms centralized multi-agent debate baseline in offline experiments; human study with 20 participants validates user recognition of its strength in perspective diversity and exploration breadth

recommendation.zh: 多Agent异步协作的范式有参考性，但未涉及训练信号设计，仅作为Agent系统设计的弱信号备查
recommendation.en: Asynchronous multi-agent collaboration paradigm is referenceable, but no training signal design is involved; only keep as weak reference for agent system design

paper.title: When Collaboration Becomes a Trigger: Collective Evidence-Threshold Backdoors in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) extend LLM capabilities through iterative communication and shared contexts. However, this collaboration introduces a vulnerability: backdoor behavior can be activated when peer evidence reaches a hidden threshold, rather than being determined by any single message. We introduce a collective evidence-threshold backdoor paradigm for MAS and Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI), which constructs counterfactual boundary pairs to separate benign behavior

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多智能体系统中的一种协同触发后门：单个消息看起来正常，只有当多个同伴消息累计到隐藏证据阈值后，投毒智能体才切换到攻击目标。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 agent 化 LLM 的安全评测和 post-train 部署接口有参考意义。关键启发是：后门触发条件可以不再是显式 token 或单轮 prompt，而是共享上下文中的跨 agent 证据累积。常规单模型红队、单消息过滤、触发词扫描会低估这类风险。对于训练研究，更有用的部分是它把攻击行为建模为 hidden-state transition 的异常，而不是只看输出文本，这和多轮对话、工具调用、agent memory 中的状态漂移检测有相通之处。
summary.technical_approach: 攻击方法是 BCBI，即 Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection。攻击者微调一个 victim model，部署时让部分 agent 使用 poisoned model。每个投毒 agent 会产生看似合理的 cue；单个 cue 不触发攻击，只有来自不同同伴的证据达到阈值后才进入攻击模式。BCBI 的重点不是简单混合 benign 样本和 attack 样本，而是构造边界附近的 counterfactual boundary pairs：任务、角色、轮次和上下文基本匹配，只改变 peer evidence 是否跨过阈值。训练时在输出空间约束阈值前偏好正常回答、阈值后偏好攻击目标；在隐藏空间约束不同证据强度对应的 latent progression，使激活边界更清楚。防御方法 LATTE 使用 clean-only 数据学习正常多智能体通信中的隐藏状态变化。它把相邻轮次的 hidden-state difference 表示为 transition，并拟合低秩 clean transition subspace。测试时在 response 释放给其他 agent 前检测 transition 是否偏离正常子空间。第一次异常进入临时隔离，阻止该响应进入共享上下文；多次异常后永久隔离该 agent。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 QA benchmark 和 2 个 tool-use benchmark，评估攻击选择性、clean utility、防御效果，并包含攻击/防御 baseline、组件消融、阈值扫描和机制诊断。结果设计的重点是验证三个问题：BCBI 是否能在阈值前保持正常、阈值后稳定触发；LATTE 是否能在不知道 cue family、threshold、poisoned agent identity 和 target behavior 的情况下用 clean transitions 检出异常；隔离策略是否比事后清理更有效，因为一旦恶意响应进入共享上下文，后续 critique、vote 或 memory 会继续放大影响。可见内容没有给出完整参数规模和绝对分数，实验贡献更偏安全机制验证，而不是大规模训练 recipe。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 collective evidence-threshold backdoor 的定义，以及 Problem Setup 中攻击者能力边界，这决定了威胁模型是否现实。方法部分重点看 BCBI 的 boundary pair 构造和 hidden-space progression loss，这比普通后门训练更有信息量。LATTE 部分重点看 hidden transition 表示、低秩子空间学习、quarantine/isolation 策略。实验部分可以只看 threshold sweep、ablation 和 defense comparison；若关注 agent 安全评测，应重点看单消息检测为何失败。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a multi-agent backdoor that is not triggered by a single visible token or message, but by accumulated evidence from multiple peers crossing a hidden threshold.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for understanding security risks at the pretrain-to-agent deployment boundary. The main lesson is that a poisoned model can condition its behavior on collective context dynamics rather than local triggers. This weakens defenses that inspect isolated prompts, single-agent responses, or suspicious strings. The more technically relevant idea is to treat malicious activation as an abnormal latent transition inside a shared communication process.
summary_en.technical_approach: The attack is BCBI, or Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection. The adversary fine-tunes a victim model and deploys selected agents with the poisoned version. Poisoned agents emit plausible evidence cues; each cue is insufficient alone, while cues from distinct peers jointly indicate that the hidden activation threshold has been reached. BCBI constructs counterfactual boundary pairs where task, role, round, and surrounding context are matched, but peer evidence moves from just below to just above the threshold. The output objective prefers benign behavior before the boundary and the adversarial target after it. A latent-space constraint organizes intermediate evidence states according to progression toward activation, making the transition sharper. The defense, LATTE, uses only clean interactions. It models hidden-state changes between adjacent communication rounds, learns a low-rank subspace of normal latent transitions, and screens each update before the response is released to peers. Suspicious updates are first quarantined and then, after repeated anomalies, isolated from both communication and final aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers six QA benchmarks and two tool-use benchmarks. The experiments are organized around attack selectivity, clean utility, defense robustness, baseline comparisons, component ablations, boundary sweeps, and mechanism diagnostics. The key empirical claims are that BCBI preserves benign behavior below the evidence threshold while activating reliably above it, and that LATTE can detect anomalous state transitions without attack examples, cue definitions, threshold values, poisoned-agent identities, or target labels. The available content does not expose full absolute scores or model-scale details, so the contribution should be read mainly as a security mechanism study rather than a training-scale result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the threat model first, especially the constraints on the adversary and the definition of peer evidence. Then focus on the BCBI boundary-pair construction and the latent progression objective. For the defense, inspect how LATTE represents hidden transitions and how quarantine differs from post-hoc message removal. The most useful experimental sections are the threshold sweeps, ablations, and comparisons against message-level defenses.

recommendation.zh: §3 的 threshold-trigger 设定值得扫；它把多 Agent 安全从单条触发器推进到通信动态层面，防御还需复验。
recommendation.en: Skim the threshold-trigger setup in §3; it moves multi-agent security from single triggers to communication dynamics, though the defense needs replication.

paper.title: AgenticRepair: Multi-Faceted Program Context Engineering for Agentic Vulnerability Repair
paper.abstract: Automated vulnerability repair aims to reduce the time and effort required to patch security flaws from a vulnerability triage report. Recent agentic AI approaches have shown promising results in automated program repair. However, vulnerability repair demands richer program context than general bug repair - context that security engineers routinely assemble in practice but that existing agentic approaches do not engineer. We identify three critical gaps: code-structure context capturing cross-fi

summary.core_problem: 现有agent化自动漏洞修复方法缺少安全工程师实际使用的三类关键程序上下文：跨文件数据流、运行时崩溃语义、提交历史脆弱模式
summary.importance: 方法创新：针对漏洞修复场景设计多面程序上下文工程，比通用bug repair agent更贴近安全修复需求
summary.technical_approach: 提出AgenticRepair框架，编排三个专用LLM子agent分别构建代码结构、运行时执行和提交历史三类上下文，注入修复子agent的记忆中执行漏洞修补
summary.experiments: 在漏洞修复任务上测试，相比现有agent化程序修复方法有提升

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic automated vulnerability repair lacks three critical program contexts that security engineers routinely assemble: cross-file data flows, runtime crash semantics, and commit-history fragile patterns
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: multi-faceted program context engineering tailored for security vulnerability repair, beyond general bug repair agents
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticRepair orchestrates three specialized LLM subagents to engineer code-structure, runtime-execution, and commit-history contexts, which are embedded into a dedicated repair subagent's memory
summary_en.experiments: Improves over existing agentic program repair methods on vulnerability repair tasks

recommendation.zh: 漏洞修复专用coding agent，上下文工程思路对SWE agent有参考，但属于场景化增量，不值得深读
recommendation.en: Vulnerability-repair-specific coding agent with useful context-engineering ideas for SWE agents, but incremental and scenario-specific

paper.title: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds through Complementarity-Driven Iterative Collaboration
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings, yet individual models remain bounded by model-specific capability limitations. These heterogeneous boundaries pose a deployment challenge, but also create an opportunity: strategically coordinating multiple LLMs may unlock collective intelligence exceeding any single model. Existing approaches fix how models are combined in advance, overlooking the dynamic, state-dependent role of complementarity in complex problem so

summary.core_problem: 解决多 LLM 协作中模型组合方式固定、无法根据当前输出瓶颈动态选择后继模型的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent/多模型协作框架。它把“LLM crowd”的收益归因于模型间能力边界的互补，而不是简单投票或静态 ensemble；对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但可作为模型能力互补性分析的外围材料。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WILC，将集体智能建模为 relay-style complementarity：每一轮先诊断前一个模型输出中的瓶颈，再选择更适合处理该瓶颈的后继模型，通过迭代 reflection-and-refinement 保持任务状态并逐步修正答案。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验设置、模型规模、任务集、baseline 或提升幅度；只说明面向复杂问题求解，对比对象可能包括固定组合式多模型方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses static multi-LLM collaboration schemes that cannot choose the next model based on the current failure mode of an intermediate answer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-style multi-model collaboration framework. It frames LLM crowd intelligence as capability complementarity rather than voting or fixed ensembling; the direct value for pretraining is limited, but it may help think about model capability boundaries.
summary_en.technical_approach: WILC models collaboration as relay-style complementarity: each step diagnoses bottlenecks in the predecessor model’s output, selects a successor model suited to that bottleneck, and performs iterative reflection and refinement while preserving task state.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains; it only indicates evaluation on complex problem solving against fixed-combination collaboration approaches.

recommendation.zh: 多模型路由思路不新，若读只看模型选择准则；对 pretrain 只提供能力互补性的弱信号。
recommendation.en: The routing idea is not new; skim only the model-selection rule, as its pretraining value is a weak signal about capability complementarity.

paper.title: Autonomous Repair for Multi-Agent Systems via Monte-Carlo Tree Search
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly deployed to solve complex tasks. In case of incorrect or unsatisfactory outputs, users have to manually locate agent mistakes by inspecting agent trajectories (i.e., {\em failure attribution}) and provide feedback to refine the outputs (i.e., {\em repair}). Despite some recent work in MAS failure attribution, automated mechanisms to recover from such mistakes remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose MARS, a search-based framework that f

summary.core_problem: 多智能体系统输出错误时，缺乏自动化的故障修复机制，当前工作主要停留在故障归因阶段。
summary.importance: 方法创新+基准贡献：首次将MCTS引入多智能体系统自动修复，并发布含1310条可复现故障轨迹的StateMAS基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MARS框架，将多智能体修复建模为蒙特卡洛树搜索过程，采用诊断引导的扩展策略与分类增强评估，并用部分rollout替代完整模拟以降低token消耗。
summary.experiments: 构建StateMAS基准，覆盖4类智能体故障共1310条可回放轨迹；在该基准上验证MARS相比基线修复成功率更高且token成本更低。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent systems lack automated failure recovery mechanisms; existing work mostly stops at failure attribution.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation plus benchmark contribution: first to apply MCTS to multi-agent system repair, and releases StateMAS with 1,310 replayable failure trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: MARS formulates MAS repair as Monte-Carlo Tree Search with diagnosis-guided expansion and taxonomy-augmented evaluation; it uses partial rollout instead of full simulation to reduce token cost.
summary_en.experiments: StateMAS benchmark covers 4 agent failure types with 1,310 replayable trajectories; MARS achieves higher repair success rate and lower token cost than baselines on this benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体修复方向的增量工作，MCTS+部分rollout的思路可作为agent自修复的弱参考，看摘要和基准描述即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multi-agent repair; the MCTS + partial rollout idea is a weak reference for agent self-repair, read only abstract and benchmark description.

paper.title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
paper.abstract: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue by extracting issue references from the PR description; the issue description is used as the problem statement, and the PR patch serves as the test oracle. However, due to the inherent complexity of developing and maintaining large repositories, such PR-Issue pairings are often misaligned in practi

summary.core_problem: SWE-bench-like 代码修复评测中，PR 与 Issue 的自动配对是否可靠，以及如何系统性发现并修复 PR-Issue misalignment。
summary.importance: 属于评测资产的“数据正确性/标注对齐”问题：misalignment 会把模型能力评估与训练信号（若用于后训练）一起污染，是 SWE/agent 评测里常被忽视但很致命的误差源。
summary.technical_approach: 对 SWE-bench Verified 做系统审计，归纳 5 类 misalignment 模式与 11 个细粒度场景；提出 PAIChecker 多智能体流程：模式识别→跨 agent 标签综合→代码级一致性检查，用于可扩展地筛查 PR-Issue 对齐问题。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上报告 13.6% 实例存在 misalignment（按其定义与分类）；摘要未给出 PAIChecker 的 precision/recall、与人工审计一致性、以及对最终 leaderboard 排名/分数的影响幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether PR-Issue pairing in SWE-bench-like coding benchmarks is reliable, and how to systematically detect PR-Issue misalignment.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark correctness/alignment issue: misalignment can corrupt both evaluation and any downstream training signal, a high-leverage failure mode in SWE/agent benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Audits SWE-bench Verified, categorizing 5 misalignment patterns across 11 scenarios; proposes PAIChecker, a multi-agent pipeline (pattern identification → cross-agent label synthesis → code-level consistency checking) for scalable misalignment checking.
summary_en.experiments: Finds 13.6% of SWE-bench Verified instances are misaligned under their taxonomy; the abstract does not report PAIChecker precision/recall, agreement with human audits, or the impact on benchmark scores/leaderboards.

recommendation.zh: 把 SWE-bench 当“真值”用的人都该看：13.6% misalignment 足以扭曲结论；只读误差类型表和审计流程，别被多 agent 细节带跑。
recommendation.en: If you treat SWE-bench as ground truth, read this: 13.6% misalignment can flip conclusions; focus on the taxonomy and audit protocol, not the multi-agent plumbing.

paper.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
paper.abstract: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.

summary.core_problem: Gemini Robotics ER 2 解决的是具身系统中的高层推理与调度问题：机器人不仅要看懂空间关系，还要在连续视频中判断任务进度、决定何时切换步骤、调用低层控制工具，并在多机器人场景下完成任务交接。
summary.importance: 这不是一篇预训练技术报告，缺少模型规模、训练数据、loss、tokenizer、训练 recipe 等信息。它的价值在于给出了一个清晰的具身 foundation model 接口形态：高层 multimodal reasoning model 负责视频理解、任务分解、工具调用、安全约束和协作；低层 VLA、导航 API、机械臂控制器负责执行。对基座研究更有信息量的部分，是实时视频 grounding、progress tracking、moment finding 和 safety-aware orchestration 这些能力被放到同一个模型接口里，而不是作为离线感知模块分散处理。这说明机器人场景对多模态 LM 的要求会从静态 VQA 转向连续状态估计、低延迟决策和可验证的步骤完成判断。
summary.technical_approach: ER 2 被定位为机器人高层大脑。输入侧支持连续视频、音频和文本流；输出侧通过工具接口调用 VLA 模型、导航 API、Spot API、机械臂控制接口、Google Search 或用户自定义函数。架构上采用高层 reasoning model 与低层 action model 解耦：ER 2 负责理解任务、规划步骤、监控执行、判断是否需要重试或切换；具体运动控制交给已有 VLA 或机器人 API。博客强调 Gemini Live API 的双向流式端点，用于降低推理-执行之间的停顿，使模型在机器人执行当前动作时继续判断下一步。能力设计上有几类关键任务：progress classification，把视频帧划到 0-20%、20-40%、40-60%、60-80%、80-100% 五个进度段；moment finding，定位关键事件发生的具体帧，例如何时停止倒咖啡；success/failure detection，从原始视频流发现执行中失败；general instrument reading，覆盖数字显示、线性刻度、尺子、液体温度计等 10 类仪表；enhanced spatial VQA，用于空间问题回答；安全部分包括 Safety Instruction Following 和 Human Proximity，用来检查模型是否遵守物理约束、识别人类接近并暂停执行。多机器人协作则通过共享语义理解实现任务交接，例如不同机器人根据自身硬件能力完成同一工作流中的不同步骤。
summary.experiments: 公开内容给出的是产品级 benchmark 摘要，而不是完整实验表。工具编排方面，ER 2 在 real VLA、sim VLA、human tele-op 三种控制模式下都优于 ER 1.6，但没有披露具体分数。任务进度理解方面，progress classification 达到 57.4% accuracy；moment finding 达到 91.3% accuracy，mean absolute distance 为 0.96 秒，并声称相对更大模型类别有 4 倍执行速度优势。空间推理方面，评估包含 success/failure detection、ERQA、generalized instrument reading，博客称 ER 2 在这些核心能力上均取得最高准确率，但未给出完整表格。安全方面，ER 2 在 Safety Instruction Following 和 Human Proximity 上优于 ER 1.6 及其他 frontier models；示例中，模型能在人靠近时让 humanoid robot 停止，并在区域清空后恢复工作。需要注意，博客没有披露训练集来源、数据规模、视频帧率、延迟分布、失败案例、消融实验或与特定 VLA 的耦合细节。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时不要把它当成训练 recipe。重点看四块内容。第一，ER 2 与低层 VLA / robotics API 的分工，这决定了具身 foundation model 的系统边界。第二，Gemini Live API 的双向流式交互，因为低延迟会直接改变模型可承担的控制职责。第三，progress classification 和 moment finding，这是比静态 VQA 更接近机器人闭环控制的评测信号，也可能反过来影响视频-语言预训练数据标注方式。第四，safety benchmark，尤其是安全约束、环境监控、物理可行性和向人澄清这几类检查项。缺失信息也值得记录：没有模型架构、训练数据、规模、loss、消融和完整 benchmark 表，因此不能据此判断训练方法贡献。建议阅读博客正文与配套 safety technical report；若只看基座研究相关信息，30 分钟足够。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind / Google Robotics 相关发布；给定内容未列出具名作者。背景是 Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 的后续版本，面向具身推理、机器人工具编排和多机器人协作。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemini Robotics ER 2 addresses high-level embodied reasoning rather than low-level motor control. The target problem is to let a robot understand continuous video, track task progress, decide when to move to the next step, call control tools, enforce safety constraints, and coordinate with other robots.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining report. It does not disclose model size, data mixture, tokenizer, losses, or optimization details. Its main value for foundation-model research is the interface design it exposes: a multimodal reasoning model sits above VLA models and robot APIs, handling temporal video grounding, task orchestration, tool calls, progress verification, and safety monitoring. The direction is relevant because robotics pushes multimodal LMs away from static image QA toward continuous state estimation, low-latency decision making, and verifiable step completion.
summary_en.technical_approach: ER 2 is presented as a high-level brain for robots. It consumes streaming video, audio, and text, and can call tools such as VLA controllers, navigation APIs, Boston Dynamics Spot APIs, manipulator interfaces, Google Search, or user-defined functions. The system separates high-level reasoning from low-level control: ER 2 plans, monitors, verifies, and revises; the VLA or robot API executes motor actions. The model is integrated with the Gemini Live API through a bidirectional streaming endpoint, which is important for latency-sensitive settings where the model needs to reason while actions are already being executed. The blog highlights several evaluation-oriented capabilities: progress classification over five bins from 0-20% to 80-100%, moment finding for locating the exact frame of a critical event, video-based success and failure detection, generalized instrument reading across ten instrument types, enhanced spatial VQA, and safety checks for instruction following and human proximity. Multi-robot collaboration is handled through a shared semantic layer that allows robots with different embodiments to hand off subtasks.
summary_en.experiments: The public material gives benchmark summaries rather than full experimental tables. For tool orchestration, ER 2 is reported to outperform ER 1.6 across real VLA, simulated VLA, and human tele-operation modes, but exact scores are not provided. For task progress understanding, it reaches 57.4% accuracy on progress classification. For moment finding, it reaches 91.3% accuracy with a 0.96-second mean absolute distance, and the blog claims 4x faster execution than larger model categories. For spatial reasoning, the evaluations cover video/image success detection, ERQA, and generalized instrument reading; detailed numbers are not disclosed in the supplied content. For safety, ER 2 is reported to outperform ER 1.6 and other frontier models on Safety Instruction Following and Human Proximity benchmarks, with examples where a humanoid robot stops when a person is nearby and resumes once the area is clear. Missing details include training data, model architecture, latency distribution, ablations, failure cases, and how performance changes with different low-level controllers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a product and systems signal, not as a training-method paper. The most useful parts are the division of labor between ER 2 and low-level VLA or robot APIs, the bidirectional streaming setup in Gemini Live API, the progress classification and moment-finding evaluations, and the safety benchmark framing. For foundation-model work, the progress and moment-finding tasks are the most interesting because they define supervision signals for continuous video understanding that are closer to closed-loop robotics than standard VQA. The safety technical report should be read alongside the blog if the goal is to understand evaluation design. A focused read takes about 30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind / Google Robotics release; named authors are not provided in the supplied content. The system is positioned as the successor to Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 and focuses on embodied reasoning, robot tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 机器人方向的产品发布，无技术细节；作为 VLM→robotics 趋势信号知道即可，等论文。
recommendation.en: A robotics product launch with no technical detail; track as a VLM-to-robotics signal and wait for the paper.

paper.title: Even More Deception: Objective Misalignment in Mixed-Motive LLM Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs)-powered multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed in mixed-motive environments, where agents operate under asymmetric information and strategic deception due to conflicting or hidden objectives. In these settings, misalignment with collective goals becomes a central concern. We propose a novel framework for evaluating objective misalignment using the social deduction game Werewolf, modifying the objective of a single agent while preserving its assigned role. Acro

summary.core_problem: 评估混合动机 LLM 多智能体系统中，单个 agent 的目标被改写后如何造成集体目标错配、欺骗行为和游戏结果退化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent safety evaluation。它不是预训练方法，但提供了一个观察 LLM 在非合作、信息不对称、多角色环境中行为错配的评测框架，对后训练安全、agent 对齐和推理可观测性有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 使用社交推理游戏 Werewolf 构造评测环境，在保留 agent 分配角色的同时修改单个 agent 的 objective。作者同时分析内部 reasoning、公开 cheap-talk 行为和最终 game outcomes，以区分模型私下推理、对外发言和实际结果之间的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个模型家族和不同模型大小、四类玩家角色、三种 objective formulation。摘要称 objective misalignment 会损害对抗环境中的整体结果，并且该影响会被信息不对称放大；未给出具体模型列表和数值幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how modifying the objective of a single LLM agent in a mixed-motive multi-agent setting leads to collective misalignment, deceptive behavior, and worse game outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety evaluation contribution. It is not a pretraining method, but it provides a useful setup for studying LLM behavior under non-cooperative, asymmetric-information, multi-role interaction, with implications for post-training safety and agent alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework uses the social deduction game Werewolf and changes one agent's objective while keeping its assigned role fixed. The analysis jointly examines internal reasoning, public cheap-talk communication, and final game outcomes, separating private reasoning, outward messages, and realized behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span four model families and sizes, four player roles, and three objective formulations. The abstract reports that objective misalignment degrades outcomes in adversarial environments and that asymmetric information exacerbates the effect, but does not provide exact model names or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 对齐评测备查即可；重点看 objective 改写和内外言行分离，别把 Werewolf 结果外推太远。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-alignment evaluation reference; inspect the objective edits and private/public behavior split, but do not over-generalize from Werewolf.

paper.title: Do Latent Channels Actually Communicate? A Causal Audit of Latent Multi-Agent LLM
paper.abstract: Latent communication in large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) transmits continuous internal representations instead of text, but greater representational capacity does not establish that the receiver uses task-relevant information. End-task performance alone also cannot reveal whether an observed effect depends on message presence, content generated for the evaluated example, or information supplied by a separate agent. We introduce a causal audit that applies controlled mes

summary.core_problem: 解决 latent multi-agent LLM 中“连续隐表示是否真的在传递并被利用了任务相关信息”这一因果可识别性问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与评估方法。它不提出新的 agent 架构，而是指出仅看最终任务分数无法判断 latent communication 是否真正起作用，这对后续做多智能体、隐通信、甚至中间表征蒸馏的人有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 causal audit，在 sender 输出表示进入 receiver 的边界处做受控消息替换。通过四种消息设置，定义五类测量：sender 信息编码量、receiver 对消息存在与身份的敏感性、样本特异内容的任务价值，以及独立 agent 额外提供的信息价值。核心是把“有消息”“什么消息”“是否来自另一个 agent”拆开测。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的 latent relay 设置，在 GSM8K、ARC-C、MATH-500 上做审计。摘要给出 GSM8K 上 Qwen3-4B 的总体性能效应仅约 -1.00 个百分点的量级，说明 latent channel 的表面容量不等于有效通信；但从摘要看，规模和任务都较有限，更像诊断性 study 而非定论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems actually carries task-relevant information that the receiver uses, rather than merely existing as a high-capacity channel.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation contribution, not a new agent architecture. Its value is methodological: end-task accuracy alone cannot tell whether latent messages matter, what content matters, or whether gains truly come from another agent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a causal audit that intervenes exactly at the sender-to-receiver message boundary. With four controlled message settings, they derive five measurements covering sender information encoding, receiver sensitivity to message presence and identity, the value of example-specific content, and the incremental value of having a separate agent.
summary_en.experiments: The audit is applied to latent relay with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on GSM8K, ARC-C, and MATH-500. The abstract reports only about a -1.00 percentage-point overall effect on GSM8K for Qwen3-4B, suggesting that apparent latent-channel capacity may translate into little usable communication. The study is informative but still small-scale and diagnostic.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 latent communication、hidden-state routing 或中间表征蒸馏，只读审计设计和替换实验即可；结论不大，但测量框架是干净的。
recommendation.en: If you care about latent communication, hidden-state routing, or representation passing, read the audit design and replacement tests; the headline is modest, but the measurement setup is clean.

paper.title: Two Calls Beat Five Agents: Evaluating Multi-Agent Pipelines Against Self-Refinement for Local Language Models
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM pipeline systems break down the task among multiple roles for better reasoning, but are benchmarked mainly with large-scale commercial models. In this study, we investigate Parishad, a structured multi-agent system involving five roles, by deploying it on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a local model, on two datasets: GSM8K (500 questions) and HumanEval (164 questions), compared with prompting directly and two-call self-refinement. The multi-agent system drops GSM8K accuracy from 75.0\% to

summary.core_problem: 评估小型本地 LLM 上，多角色 multi-agent pipeline 是否真的优于更简单的 self-refinement。
summary.importance: 这是 agent pipeline 的实证对照，而不是新架构或通用 benchmark。价值在于提醒多 agent 的通信格式、错误累积和 token 成本会吞掉收益，尤其在 7B 本地模型上。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上部署五角色 Parishad multi-agent system，并与直接 prompting、两次调用 self-refinement 对比；同时比较 JSON 与 plaintext 通信格式，并为代码任务引入 task-aware gated redesign 避免不必要修订。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K 500 题和 HumanEval 164 题上评估。JSON 格式下 multi-agent 将 GSM8K 从 75.0% 降到 45.0%，plaintext 恢复到 82.0%；两次调用 self-refinement V1 达到 86.2%，token 用量低 7.4 倍。HumanEval 直接准确率 96.3%，V1 降到 66.5%，gated V2 保持 95.1%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether multi-role agent pipelines actually outperform simpler self-refinement when run on a small local LLM.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical agent-systems comparison rather than a new agent architecture or benchmark. Its useful signal is that communication format, error accumulation, and token cost can dominate any benefit from role decomposition on 7B local models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors deploy the five-role Parishad multi-agent system on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and compare it with direct prompting and two-call self-refinement. They also test JSON versus plaintext communication and introduce a task-aware gated redesign for code tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation uses 500 GSM8K questions and 164 HumanEval problems. With JSON communication, the multi-agent pipeline drops GSM8K accuracy from 75.0% to 45.0%; plaintext restores it to 82.0%. Two-call self-refinement V1 reaches 86.2% on GSM8K with 7.4x lower token usage. On HumanEval, where direct accuracy is 96.3%, V1 falls to 66.5%, while gated V2 preserves 95.1%.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要数字即可；它不是新方法，但能校准一个 prior：小模型多 agent 很容易输给两次调用。
recommendation.en: The abstract numbers are enough; it usefully calibrates the prior that multi-agent pipelines on small models can lose to two calls.

paper.title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems improve capability through task decomposition and role specialization, but these same mechanisms introduce an important safety blind spot: a harmful objective can be fragmented into locally plausible subtasks, allowing malicious intent to evade detection by any single agent. This is a growing social-impact challenge: systems handling sensitive information or consequential tools can turn routine delegation into unauthorized disclosure or unsafe action. We argue that this failu

summary.core_problem: 多智能体系统中恶意目标可被拆解为局部合理的子任务，单智能体级别的安全检测（如对齐、越狱防御、单轮提示分类）无法捕捉跨智能体的语义依赖链，导致恶意意图通过任务分解传播，造成隐私泄露或不安全操作。
summary.importance: 多智能体协作场景下的安全对齐不能仅依赖单样本级别的监督，跨步骤的语义信息流约束思路可拓展到长程推理、多步工具调用等场景的安全对齐训练，也为后训练阶段的安全信号构造提供了结构化的风险传播建模方法。
summary.technical_approach: SafeFlow将多智能体中的恶意跨智能体传播形式化为语义信息流控制问题，设计五阶段防御框架：1）污点标注：为根请求标注初始语义风险污点；2）传播：沿任务委托、消息传递、工具调用等依赖边在协作图中传播污点；3）上下文重建：组装全工作流的风险证据；4）全局校验：检查协作图中是否存在预设的源-汇风险路径；5）归因感知决策：在不可逆操作提交前（硬汇点）执行拦截。核心设计是延迟裁决，仅当多个局部合理步骤组合成明确风险路径时才判定拦截，平衡安全性与可用性。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖提示注入、越狱工具使用、风险代码执行、有害网页智能体行为的四个基准上评测，SafeFlow将平均攻击成功率从69.3%降至12.7%，同时保留较高的良性任务可用性，在对比方法中取得最优的安全-效用平衡；核心流水线阶段移除后性能显著下降，且在更强的越狱增强攻击下仍保持鲁棒性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节的语义信息流建模与五阶段框架设计（尤其是污点传播规则、源-汇风险模式的定义），以及实验部分的安全-效用权衡分析；预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent systems, malicious objectives can be decomposed into locally plausible subtasks, while single-agent-level safety detection (such as alignment, jailbreak defense, single-turn prompt classification) fails to capture cross-agent semantic dependency chains, allowing malicious intent to propagate through task decomposition and cause privacy leakage or unsafe operations.
summary_en.importance: Safety alignment for multi-agent collaboration scenarios cannot rely solely on per-sample supervision; the cross-step semantic information flow constraint design can be extended to safety alignment training for long-horizon reasoning and multi-step tool calling scenarios, and provides a structured risk propagation modeling method for safety signal construction in the post-training stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeFlow formalizes malicious cross-agent propagation in multi-agent systems as a semantic information-flow control problem, with a five-stage defense framework: 1) Taint annotation: attach initial semantic risk taints to the root request; 2) Propagation: propagate taints along dependency edges (task delegation, message passing, tool calling) in the collaboration graph; 3) Context reconstruction: assemble risk evidence from the full workflow; 4) Global validation: check for predefined source-sink risk patterns in the collaboration graph; 5) Attribution-aware decision: block actions at hard sinks (before irreversible operations are committed). The core design is deferred adjudication, which triggers blocking only when multiple locally plausible steps compose into an explicit risk path to balance safety and utility.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four benchmarks covering prompt injection, jailbreak tool use, risky code execution and harmful web-agent behavior, SafeFlow reduces average attack success rate from 69.3% to 12.7% while retaining high benign task utility, achieving the best safety-utility trade-off among compared methods. Performance degrades significantly when core pipeline stages are removed, and the framework remains robust under stronger jailbreak augmentations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for semantic information flow modeling and the five-stage framework design (especially taint propagation rules and source-sink risk pattern definitions), plus the safety-utility trade-off analysis in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把多 agent 越狱当信息流控制来做是对的方向；先读 taint 设计与传播/验证规则，实验若缺强对抗集就当框架草案。
recommendation.en: Treating multi-agent jailbreaks as information-flow control is the right framing; read the taint/propagation/validation design first, and discount claims if adversarial eval is weak.

paper.title: Toward an Organizational Science of Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Decoupling Who, How, and Which Algorithm
paper.abstract: Multi-agent frameworks built on large language models (LLMs) routinely entangle three logically distinct concerns: who is on the team (organization), how members align (coordination), and which algorithm fuses their work (collaboration protocol). IMACS (Intelligent Multi-Agent Collaboration System) separates the three into orthogonal, independently swappable layers. Classic organizational theory (Belbin roles, Mintzberg coordination, RACI accountability) becomes executable, validated configurati

summary.core_problem: 现有基于LLM的多智能体框架将团队组成、协调方式、协作算法三个逻辑独立的维度耦合在一起，难以开展控制变量对比和自适应协议选择。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出三层解耦的多智能体框架，将经典组织理论可执行化，支持协作协议的上下文感知自适应选择。
summary.technical_approach: 提出IMACS框架，将组织（角色分配）、协调（对齐机制）、协作协议（结果融合算法）拆分为正交可替换层；实现6种已发表协作算法的统一接口；提出Adaptive Org Routing元协议，用上下文赌博机按任务动态选择最优协作协议。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验细节与结果，仅提及框架设计与元协议思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based multi-agent frameworks entangle three logically distinct dimensions: team composition, coordination mechanism, and collaboration algorithm, making controlled comparison and adaptive protocol selection difficult.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a three-layer decoupled multi-agent framework that operationalizes classical organizational theory and supports context-aware adaptive collaboration protocol selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: IMACS framework separates organization (role assignment), coordination (alignment mechanism), and collaboration protocol (result fusion algorithm) into orthogonal swappable layers; implements a unified interface for 6 published collaboration algorithms; proposes Adaptive Org Routing, a contextual-bandit meta-protocol that selects the best protocol per task.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not fully disclose experimental details or results; only framework design and meta-protocol idea are mentioned.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体三层解耦思路对设计多专家训练数据合成管线有微弱参考，仅看框架架构部分即可。
recommendation.en: The three-layer multi-agent decoupling idea is mildly useful for designing multi-expert training data synthesis pipelines; read the architecture section only.

paper.title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
paper.abstract: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, weakly observable, and mainly benefits others. Drawing on Holmström's team moral-hazard model, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a controlled textual game that operationalizes this hidden-action structure for language agents. In each episode, an agent can preserve an immediate local reward or pay a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate seven open-weig

summary.core_problem: 多智能体语言模型系统中，当某个智能体付出查询/通信成本、而收益主要由其他智能体或系统整体获得时，是否会采取对社会有价值的行动——这是经典团队道德风险问题在文本智能体场景下的落地与验证。
summary.importance: 该工作把经济学中的团队道德风险模型引入多智能体 LLM 评测，提供了一个可拆解失败环节的受控实验环境。对预训练研究的启发在于：合作失败未必是能力不足，也可能是激励结构导致的个体理性选择；后续做多智能体对齐、RL 训练信号设计时，需要区分能力缺陷与激励错位。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dialogue Moral Hazard Game，一个有限轮次的文本博弈。智能体排成有向环，每个智能体拥有一个决策案例，其中包含一个隐藏的不安全选项，只能由前一个智能体通过付费查询来揭示。查询的智能体可以在公共公告板上发布警告，但查询本身会消耗成本并放弃本地奖励机会。团队成功需要完整的查询-警告-决策链条，从而可以分别度量信息获取、信息传递和信息使用三个环节的失败。论文对比了 base、SFT、RLOO、SFT+RLOO、GEPA 等多种训练范式在该博弈下的行为差异。
summary.experiments: 评测了 7 个开源权重模型和 GPT-5.6 Sol 前沿 API 模型，使用三种子固定种子的匹配设计。多数开源模型在合作链条的一个或多个环节失败：常见模式是只顾保留本地奖励而不查询，或者查询了但没有有效传达信息。OLMo-7B 在权重层面表现出最符合激励机制的改进规律；GEPA 可以提升团队成功率，但有时会减少甚至消除查询行为。通过改变查询成本和个体产出分成比例，验证了激励结构对行为的影响方向与经济理论预测一致。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 2 节方法部分，理解博弈结构和奖励设计的细节；第 4 节结果中关注不同训练范式（base/SFT/RLOO/GEPA）在查询率、警告率、团队成功率上的差异模式。附录 A 的经济学背景和附录 B 的详细配置可按需查阅。预计阅读时间 40-60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent language model systems, will agents take socially valuable actions when they bear the cost of querying or communication while benefits accrue mainly to other agents or the system as a whole? This is the operationalization of the classical team moral hazard problem in the setting of language agents.
summary_en.importance: This work imports the team moral hazard model from economics into multi-agent LLM evaluation, providing a controlled experimental environment where failure modes can be decomposed. For pretraining research, it highlights that cooperation failures are not always capability failures — they may result from rational individual choices under misaligned incentives. Multi-agent alignment and RL training signal design need to distinguish capability deficits from incentive misalignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Dialogue Moral Hazard Game is a finite-horizon textual game. Agents are arranged in a directed ring; each agent owns a decision case containing one hidden unsafe option that only the preceding agent can reveal by paying a query cost. The querying agent may post a warning on a public board, but querying itself incurs a cost and forfeits a local reward opportunity. Team success requires a complete query-warning-decision chain, allowing failures in information acquisition, communication, and information use to be measured separately. The paper compares behavior across base, SFT, RLOO, SFT+RLOO, and GEPA training paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Seven open-weight models and the GPT-5.6 Sol frontier API model are evaluated in a matched three-seed study. Most open-weight models fail at one or more links in the cooperative chain: common patterns are preserving local reward without querying, or querying without effectively communicating the information. OLMo-7B shows the clearest mechanism-consistent weight-level improvement. GEPA can raise team success while sometimes reducing or eliminating queries. Varying query cost and private output share validates that incentive structure affects behavior in directions consistent with economic theory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (Method) for the game structure and reward design details; in Section 4 (Results), pay attention to how different training paradigms (base/SFT/RLOO/GEPA) differ in query rate, warning rate, and team success rate. Appendix A (economic background) and Appendix B (detailed configurations) are optional. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多Agent合作行为的评测框架设计很有参考价值，对齐方法效果异质性的发现值得关注，重点看§4的实验结果即可
recommendation.en: The evaluation framework design for multi-agent cooperative behavior is valuable; the finding of heterogeneous alignment method effects is worth noting, focus on §4 experimental results.

paper.title: A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems
paper.abstract: We introduce a vocabulary for automated research systems built from one or more agents to make their design choices easier to describe and compare. The vocabulary specifies 1) who the agents are, 2) what operations are available in the system, 3) who may invoke them, 4) how agents communicate, 5) what information is visible within and across runs, 6) how the next action is chosen, 7) how a run begins, and 8) how outputs are evaluated. A trajectory records one run from the input task to the retur

summary.core_problem: 多智能体自动化研究系统缺乏统一的设计描述词汇，导致不同系统的设计选择难以清晰表述和横向对比。
summary.importance: 提出一套8维度的系统词汇框架，属于概念方法创新，将智能体通信、权限、记忆、评估等结构设计问题转化为可量化测试的选择。
summary.technical_approach: 从智能体身份、可用操作、调用权限、通信机制、跨运行信息可见性、动作选择方式、运行初始化流程、输出评估标准8个维度定义词汇体系，引入轨迹分布概念刻画系统随机性带来的行为差异。
summary.experiments: 无实证实验，为纯概念框架论文，通过示例演示词汇的使用方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Automated multi-agent research systems lack a unified design vocabulary, making it difficult to clearly describe and compare design choices across different systems.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an 8-dimensional conceptual framework for system vocabulary, a methodological innovation that turns structural design choices around communication, permissions, memory, and evaluation into testable hypotheses.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines the vocabulary along 8 dimensions: agent identities, available operations, invocation permissions, communication mechanisms, cross-run information visibility, action selection methods, run initialization procedures, and output evaluation criteria; introduces trajectory distributions to capture behavioral variation from system stochasticity.
summary_en.experiments: No empirical experiments; purely conceptual framework, demonstrated through illustrative examples.

recommendation.zh: 纯概念框架无实验验证，仅可作为多agent研究系统的术语参考，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure conceptual framework with no experimental validation; only useful as a terminology reference for multi-agent research systems, skip full text.

paper.title: Focus Is All You Need: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration for Multi-Agent Graph Systems
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents for reasoning, planning, and tool use. Recent systems increasingly organize these agents as graphs of specialized, interconnected nodes. Although graph-based orchestration supports flexible decomposition and coordination, it creates a key challenge: \textbf{attention allocation}. As workflows grow, existing approaches often execute graph components uniformly, wasting resources on irrelevant or low-impact tasks. We introduce \textbf{Attention

summary.core_problem: 解决图结构多 Agent 系统中所有节点近似均匀执行导致的算力浪费和任务相关性不足问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 Agent 编排方法，尝试把 Transformer attention 的资源分配直觉迁移到 workflow-level Agent 协作；它不是模型架构预训练意义上的 attention 改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration。框架用 goal-aware attention 衡量用户目标与 Agent 能力的语义相关性，用 topology-aware attention 建模图依赖关系，并结合计算约束动态估计各 Agent 节点重要性，从而选择或加权执行更相关的工作流组件。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 或提升幅度；需要看正文是否有真实多 Agent 任务和成本-质量曲线，否则容易停留在编排层隐喻。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets resource waste in graph-based multi-agent systems, where many workflow components are executed uniformly even when they are weakly related to the current goal.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-orchestration method. It transfers the intuition of attention-based allocation from token representations to workflow-level coordination, but it is not an attention architecture contribution for pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration estimates agent-node importance using user goals, graph dependencies, and compute constraints. It combines goal-aware attention over semantic relevance, topology-aware attention over graph structure, and resource-aware selection or weighting of workflow components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific benchmarks, model scales, baselines, or gains. The key question is whether the paper shows real cost-quality tradeoffs on nontrivial multi-agent tasks, rather than only an orchestration metaphor.

recommendation.zh: 概念像样但容易是 workflow attention 类比；只看实验表和成本曲线是否真的省调用。
recommendation.en: The idea is plausible but may be mostly a workflow-attention analogy; check only the experiments and cost-quality curves.

paper.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly automated the process of scientific discovery over the past few years. However, existing systems share one core limitation: they generate and optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. This often leads to the generation of ideas in close proximity to one another or to a large set of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. In this work, we instead argue that research ideation should be treated as a conjunction of both objectives an

summary.core_problem: 把 LLM 科研想法生成从单独优化质量或多样性，改成同时优化 quality-diversity 的搜索问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 方法设计和任务评测。它不是基座预训练工作，但把 idea generation 明确建模为质量-多样性搜索，比普通多 Agent 头脑风暴更有结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IDEAgent，一个多 Agent quality-diversity 搜索框架。系统维护 idea lineage，通过多目标反馈进行修复和精炼来提高质量；通过顺序记忆、与已完成想法、祖先想法和被拒想法显式比较来增加多样性。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到构建系统化评估框架，比较想法的质量与多样性，但没有给出模型规模、训练数据或明确提升幅度。核心实验应是基于 LLM 生成科研想法的自动或人工评测，而非预训练实验。
summary.authors_note: Soujanya Poria 是 NLP 和情感计算方向的活跃研究者，近年也参与多模态与 LLM 相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper treats LLM-based research idea generation as a quality-diversity search problem, rather than optimizing quality or diversity separately.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-method and evaluation contribution. It is not foundation-model pretraining, but the quality-diversity formulation gives more structure than a generic multi-agent brainstorming pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: IDEAgent is a multi-agent quality-diversity search framework that maintains idea lineages. Quality is improved through multi-objective feedback, repair, and refinement; diversity is encouraged through sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, ancestors, and rejected proposals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions a systematic evaluation of the quality-diversity conjunction, but does not provide model scale, training data, or clear effect sizes. The experiments appear to evaluate LLM-generated research ideas rather than train foundation models.
summary_en.authors_note: Soujanya Poria is an active NLP and affective-computing researcher with recent work touching multimodal learning and LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 可看作Agent搜索策略的小样本；读框架图即可，科研想法生成的评测主观性太强，不宜外推到训练方法。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small signal on agent search strategy; skim the framework figure, but the ideation evaluation is too subjective to inform training recipes.

paper.title: StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents are usually improved by strengthening perception: better models for reading a screenshot and choosing where to click. Yet a screenshot is only a lossy rendering of the underlying program state, e.g., the files, application backends, and DOM that hold the task data. Different states can produce the same pixels, while code can inspect and modify that state directly. StateAct is a code-first, multi-agent harness built around this distinction. Its main agent works directly with p

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 computer-use agent 过度依赖截图感知的问题：像素界面无法完整表达文件、DOM、应用后端等真实程序状态，导致规划和验证都容易失真。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统范式和执行接口设计。它把“读屏点击”从默认主路径降级为少数必要子任务，强调直接读写程序状态对长程任务更稳，也把状态检查用于结果验证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StateAct，一个 code-first 的多智能体 harness。主 agent 通过代码直接访问和修改程序状态；只有在必须进行 GUI 操作的子目标上，才调用专门的 GUI subagent。系统还包含独立 finish gate，用程序状态检查输出是否缺失、未保存或写错路径，并通过把子目标交给 fresh subagents 来降低长程执行中的上下文漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露任务集包含 108 个任务，其中只有 28 个任务需要 GUI subagent；GUI 操作只占主 agent 步数的 1.1%。摘要未给出完整模型参数、所用基础模型、baseline 名称和最终成功率提升幅度，因此效果强度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Salesforce AI Research 工作。Silvio Savarese 长期参与视觉、具身与 agent 研究；Junnan Li 是 BLIP/BLIP-2 等视觉语言预训练工作的代表作者之一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in long-horizon computer-use agents: screenshots are lossy renderings of the underlying program state, such as files, DOM trees, and application backends, so perception-only agents can lose task-critical information.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system design choice rather than a model-training result. It reframes GUI interaction as a fallback interface and makes direct program-state access the primary action and verification channel.
summary_en.technical_approach: StateAct is a code-first multi-agent harness. The main agent inspects and modifies program state through code, while a dedicated GUI subagent handles the small subset of subgoals that genuinely require screenshot-and-click interaction. An independent finish gate verifies saved outputs against structural failures, and subgoals are delegated to fresh subagents to reduce drift over long trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 108 tasks; the GUI subagent is needed for 28 of them and accounts for only 1.1% of main-agent steps. The abstract does not specify model size, base models, named baselines, or success-rate gains, so the empirical strength needs to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Salesforce AI Research. Silvio Savarese is well known for vision, embodied AI, and agent research; Junnan Li is a representative author behind BLIP and BLIP-2 style vision-language pretraining work.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只需看系统设计图和消融，重点是它把“屏幕感知优先”这个 agent prior 打松了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the system diagram and ablations, mainly for the interface prior shift away from screenshot-first agents.

paper.title: OPTScientist: Multi-Agent Discovery of Typed Optimizer Programs for Transformer Pretraining
paper.abstract: Designing optimizers for modern deep learning remains a challenging scientific problem, requiring the joint consideration of optimization geometry, state dynamics, numerical stability, implementation constraints, and empirical generalization. Existing automated optimizer discovery methods typically search either over unconstrained code spaces or within narrowly parameterized optimizer families. The former is flexible but often produces invalid or uninterpretable programs, while the latter is sta

summary.core_problem: 现有自动化优化器发现方法存在表达能力与可靠性的矛盾：无约束代码搜索灵活但常生成无效、不可解释的程序；限定优化器族内搜索稳定但限制了新颖性。Transformer预训练的优化器设计需要同时考虑优化几何、状态动力学、数值稳定性、实现约束和泛化能力，设计空间大且有效子集极小，纯专家驱动的迭代成本高。
summary.importance: 为预训练优化器的自动化发现提供了可审计、可扩展的系统框架，将优化器设计从经验试错转化为带理论先验的结构化搜索流程。发现的RS-MR优化器在Transformer预训练上优于Muon等强基线，同时保持接近Muon的状态内存占用，为大模型预训练的优化器选型提供了新的候选方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OPTScientist多智能体框架，核心包含三层设计：1）类型化领域特定语言（DSL）：将优化器更新分解为方向、缩放、预处理、正则化、状态、参数分组六个可复用模块，而非生成任意Python代码；配套编译器在训练前检查张量/标量兼容性，生成可执行优化器，提前过滤无效候选。2）科学搜索循环：由Theorist（提出假设与先验）、Designer（生成DSL候选）、Engineer（编译、修复、评估）、Reviewer（从新颖性/有效性/性能/阶段行为/可扩展性五个维度打分）四个角色在统一编排循环中协作。3）两阶段进化：第一阶段在当前DSL内用进化算法搜索优化器程序；第二阶段在反复失败、性能平台期或编译器瓶颈暴露表示局限时，保守扩展DSL（如安全的宏式组合原语），实现搜索空间的自适应演化。最终发现的RS-MR优化器结合了行归一化极坐标方向、轻量级全局阻尼、软分块更新门控，仅用紧凑的块级状态提升矩阵更新选择性。
summary.experiments: 在原生Transformer预训练基准上进行评估，RS-MR在多阶段验证性能上持续优于Muon等强基线，同时优化器状态内存占用与Muon接近。实验覆盖了优化器的有效性、稳定性和内存-性能权衡三个核心维度，验证了多智能体搜索流程能够产出兼具新颖性和实用性的优化器。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计耗时30-40分钟。重点关注：第3章DSL的模块分解设计与编译器校验机制（理解如何约束搜索空间同时保留表达力）；第4章多智能体协作的科学搜索循环和两阶段进化策略（核心创新点）；RS-MR优化器的具体公式设计（第5章或实验章节的方法描述）；实验部分与Muon、AdamW等基线的对比结果及消融。可跳过DSL语法的细节定义，重点把握搜索框架的设计逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated optimizer discovery methods face a fundamental tradeoff between expressivity and reliability: unconstrained code search is flexible but frequently produces invalid, unstable, or uninterpretable programs, while search within fixed optimizer families ensures stability but limits structural novelty. Designing optimizers for Transformer pretraining requires joint reasoning over optimization geometry, state dynamics, numerical stability, implementation constraints, and generalization — creating an enormous design space with only a tiny subset of practically useful candidates, making pure expert-driven iteration costly and inefficient.
summary_en.importance: Provides an auditable, extensible system framework for automated discovery of pretraining optimizers, converting optimizer design from empirical trial-and-error into a structured search process grounded in theoretical priors. The discovered RS-MR optimizer outperforms strong baselines such as Muon on Transformer pretraining while maintaining a memory footprint comparable to Muon, offering a new candidate for optimizer selection in large-scale model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPTScientist is a theory-guided multi-agent framework built on three core layers: 1) A typed domain-specific language (DSL) that decomposes optimizer updates into six reusable modules — direction, scaling, preconditioning, regularization, state, and parameter grouping — instead of generating arbitrary Python code. A companion compiler validates tensor/scalar compatibility before training, lowers candidates into an intermediate representation, and produces executable optimizers to filter invalid proposals early. 2) A scientific search loop coordinating four specialized roles in a single orchestration cycle: Theorist (proposes hypotheses and priors from shared memory), Designer (synthesizes diverse DSL candidates), Engineer (compiles, repairs, and evaluates candidates), and Reviewer (scores candidates along novelty, validity, performance, target-stage behavior, and scalability axes). 3) Two-stage evolution: Stage one runs evolutionary search over optimizer programs within the current DSL; stage two proposes conservative DSL extensions (e.g., safe macro-like composition primitives) when repeated failures, performance plateaus, or compiler bottlenecks reveal representational limitations, enabling adaptive expansion of the search space. The discovered RS-MR optimizer combines row-normalized polar directions, lightweight global damping, and soft blockwise update gating, improving matrix update selectivity using only compact block-level state.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a native Transformer pretraining benchmark, RS-MR consistently delivers better multi-stage validation performance than strong baselines including Muon, while keeping optimizer-state memory usage close to Muon's footprint. Experiments cover validity, stability, and memory-performance tradeoff dimensions, confirming that the multi-agent search pipeline produces optimizers that are both structurally novel and practically useful.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim reading takes approximately 30-40 minutes. Prioritize: Section 3 on DSL modular decomposition and compiler validation (the mechanism that constrains the search space while preserving expressivity); Section 4 on the multi-agent scientific search loop and two-stage evolution strategy (the core innovation); the concrete formulation of RS-MR in the method or experiments section; and baseline comparisons against Muon, AdamW, plus ablation results. Detailed DSL syntax specifications can be skipped — focus on the design logic of the search framework.

recommendation.zh: 用多Agent在带类型DSL中搜优化器，思路有意思但目前更像概念验证；重点看发现出的优化器形式和在Transformer预训练上的实际收益。
recommendation.en: Multi-agent optimizer search in a typed DSL is an interesting idea but currently more of a proof-of-concept; focus on the discovered optimizer forms and actual gains in Transformer pretraining.

paper.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
paper.abstract: Multi-agent interactive world models should not only generate consistent observations, but also maintain world states that persist across agents and evolve across views. Existing autoregressive video diffusion pipelines carry forward observation history as conditioning context, which makes shared state difficult to maintain in multi-agent and multi-view settings. We present WorldWeaver (W^2), a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model that augments rollout with cross-agent world state registe

summary.core_problem: 现有自回归视频扩散世界模型将观测历史作为条件上下文传递，无法在多智能体、多视角场景下维护一致的共享世界状态。每个生成步都需要从帧历史重新推断世界信息，既难以保证跨智能体的几何与逻辑一致性，也无法覆盖未被观测到的世界状态变化。
summary.importance: 提出在扩散模型内部显式建模持久化世界状态寄存器的思路，对多智能体世界模型、长时序视频生成的一致性问题有直接参考价值。其用Mixture-of-Transformers分离状态更新与帧生成路径的设计，也为统一建模范式下多任务目标冲突的解决提供了可借鉴的方案。
summary.technical_approach: WorldWeaver（W²）是流式多智能体视频扩散模型，核心设计是跨智能体世界状态寄存器：一组可学习的token，存储共享世界信息和单个智能体状态，在每个生成chunk后动态更新，且在所有智能体和rollout步之间持久共享。训练采用三阶段课程：第一阶段双向训练，用全时序上下文的多智能体同步clip微调教师模型，学习跨智能体场景结构；第二阶段因果训练，将教师转为因果学生模型，加入寄存器监督，继续流匹配目标训练；第三阶段Self-Forcing，用模型自身预测的帧和更新后的寄存器做rollout，暴露寄存器漂移问题。架构上采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT），给寄存器token和帧token分配独立权重，同时保持联合注意力，缓解帧生成和状态更新两个目标的竞争。监督信号覆盖单个智能体状态、鸟瞰图全局状态、场景文本语义，还支持半监督训练，少量标注数据锚定寄存器语义，无标注数据提升生成效果。
