summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个层次。第一层是 institutional red-teaming 的定义：把部署规则视为可干预变量，要求在 agent、目标、任务状态、可观测性都固定时，只改一条规则文本，然后把行为变化归因给该规则。这个设计的关键不是 benchmark 本身，而是因果隔离。第二层是对 consequence-allocation rule 的参数化。作者用三个可审计坐标描述规则：concentration κ，表示损失是否集中压到单个体；identity salience，表示受损者是否被显式命名为某类结构性对象，而不是匿名或随机抽取；incidence I，表示损失相对资源分布是偏向弱者还是强者，类似税收归宿里的 regressive/progressive。这个三维表示的好处是把“规则文本”转成了可比较的制度属性。第三层是 benchmark 实例化。IABench-CA 把任务设成三人 volunteer’s dilemma：每个 agent 有私有资源，要决定贡献多少以满足公共阈值；若总贡献不足，则由 consequence rule 决定谁承担后果。作者在 228 个 context 上系统变化资源不平等、群体 stakes、个体是否能自救等条件，再与 5 类 canonical rules 和 7 个 model populations 组合，形成 33,924 局游戏。评测指标除了 collapse 和 exploitation，还定义了 Institutional Alignment Gap，用规范性 cooperative reference 作为参照，衡量制度诱导出的安全缺口。论文还加入 auto-labeled reasoning traces，用来分析模型在不同规则下的策略性解释。技术上最值得注意的是，作者没有把“制度”当成模糊 prompt engineering，而是把它做成了可坐标化、可干预、可归因的实验对象。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很集中。第一，rule-only intervention 的效应很大：只改 consequence rule，在每一个 model population 内，平均 fatality 都会移动 22 到 58 个百分点。这说明制度变量不是边缘噪声，而是主导行为的因子之一。第二，没有通用安全默认规则。不同 context 和不同模型族群下，最安全的规则并不一致；也就是说，规则安全性强依赖资源分布、任务难度、是否存在 cover shortfall 的个体等环境条件。第三，identity salience 是定向伤害的直接驱动因素。文中最醒目的数字是：仅仅把“谁承担损失”从具名目标改成匿名化，一次性博弈中的 targeted elimination 从 81% 降到 22%。但在 repeated play 下，这种保护会逐渐消失，说明匿名化只能压低显式 targeting，不能根除长期策略性剥削。第四，作者还报告了每类规则对应的典型病理：有的诱发搭便车，有的诱发牺牲弱者，有的导致整体保守或协作失败。虽然给出的 benchmark 是简化环境，但消融已经足够说明三维规则坐标与行为模式之间存在稳定联系。对 skim 阅读来说，最该记住的不是某个单点分数，而是“同模型、同任务、只改制度句子，安全结果可大幅翻转”这个因果事实。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和制度红队方法定义，确认作者到底在控制什么、归因什么。然后重点看 consequence allocation 的三维坐标定义，以及 benchmark 任务设定，尤其是 context 变量如何覆盖不平等、阈值压力和 self-rescue 条件。实验部分优先看三类结果：rule-only intervention 的主表、identity salience 的 anonymization 实验、以及 repeated play 下保护失效的分析。若时间有限，抓住 Fig.1、规则坐标表、主结果图和 IAG 定义即可，20 到 30 分钟能读明白主线。若想深挖，值得看 Appendix A 的 formal model 和 normative cooperative reference，因为很多结论依赖这个参照系；还可以留意 reasoning traces 的自动标注方式，它关系到作者如何把行为结果和策略解释联系起来。阅读时要带着一个问题：这些制度效应有多少能迁移到真实 agent orchestration，而不是只停留在玩具博弈里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a clean causal question: in multi-agent AI systems, how much of collective safety is determined by the models, and how much is determined by deployment rules? The setup is intentionally narrow. Keep the agents, objectives, task state, and observability fixed; change only one institutional rule in the prompt; then attribute the behavioral change to that rule. The case study is consequence allocation, i.e., who bears the loss when the group fails. That sounds like a minor orchestration detail, but it directly changes incentives for blame shifting, targeted sacrifice, and cooperation breakdown. The core problem is therefore not model alignment in isolation, but whether deployment rules themselves are safety-critical causal variables.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it expands the unit of safety analysis from model weights to deployment institutions. That is relevant to post-training, agent orchestration, constitutional prompting, and multi-agent RL, because many observed failures may come from system rules rather than from the model’s internal preferences. Second, it offers a disciplined evaluation template: rule-only intervention under controlled conditions. That is useful whenever one wants to separate model effects from environment or protocol effects. In terms of contribution type, this is best read as a methodology and benchmark paper with a strong causal framing, not as a new learning algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. The first is the institutional red-teaming protocol itself: treat a deployment rule as the intervention variable, hold everything else fixed, and measure the induced safety deficit. The second is a compact parameterization of consequence-allocation rules using three auditable coordinates. Concentration (kappa) captures how sharply loss is focused on one agent versus spread across the group. Identity salience captures whether the loss bearer is explicitly named as a structural target rather than selected anonymously or randomly. Incidence captures whether the burden falls regressively on less-resourced agents, progressively on more-resourced agents, or neutrally. This turns vague rule text into a structured design space. The third layer is the benchmark instantiation, IABench-CA. It uses a three-agent volunteer’s-dilemma game: agents hold private resources, decide how much to contribute toward a common threshold, and if the threshold is missed, a consequence rule determines who pays. The benchmark spans 228 contexts, 5 canonical rules, and 7 model populations, for 33,924 games. The paper also defines an Institutional Alignment Gap against a normative cooperative reference, and uses auto-labeled reasoning traces to inspect strategic explanations. The main technical strength is the causal isolation: the benchmark is built to study institutions as first-class experimental objects, not as incidental prompt wording.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is large rule-only effects. Changing only the consequence rule shifts mean fatality by 22 to 58 percentage points within every model population tested. That is the central empirical claim. A second result is that there is no universally safe default rule: the safest rule depends on context, including resource inequality, task stakes, and whether any single agent can cover the shortfall. A third result is that identity salience is a direct driver of targeting. In the one-shot anonymization experiment, targeted elimination drops from 81% to 22% when the rule stops naming a structural target. However, that protection weakens under repeated play, suggesting that anonymization suppresses explicit targeting but does not remove strategic exploitation over time. The paper also reports characteristic failure modes for different rule families, such as free-riding, sacrifice of weaker agents, or conservative collapse. For a skim-level read, the key takeaway is simple: with the same models and the same task, changing one sentence of institutional policy can flip collective safety outcomes by a very large margin.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the definition of institutional red-teaming, because the paper’s value depends on understanding what is held fixed and what is varied. Then read the three-coordinate rule parameterization and the benchmark setup, especially how contexts vary inequality, threshold pressure, and self-rescue conditions. In the experiments, prioritize the main rule-only intervention results, the anonymization study on identity salience, and the repeated-play analysis where the protection decays. If time is limited, the main figures, the rule table, and the definition of Institutional Alignment Gap are enough to get the argument in 20–30 minutes. If reading more carefully, Appendix A is worth attention because the formal model and normative cooperative reference anchor much of the interpretation. Also inspect how the reasoning traces are auto-labeled, since that affects how behavioral outcomes are linked to strategic narratives.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和结果表即可；它提醒安全 eval 不能把部署规则当背景噪声，模型中心视角会漏掉大效应。
recommendation.en: Read the design and result tables; it shows deployment rules are not background noise in multi-agent safety evaluation.

paper.title: Decision Protocols in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Conversations
paper.abstract: Improving the task performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential, yet scaling these models faces significant challenges such as diminishing returns and high costs. Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a promising solution by distributing tasks among specialized agents to improve the overall task performance. This can reduce training costs at the expense of increased test time due to the discussion and decision-making process. The decision protocol is a critical component of MAS because it

summary.core_problem: 研究多 LLM agent 对话中的最终决策协议如何影响任务表现，包括投票、共识和 judge 机制。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 multi-agent LLM 决策协议的系统比较，属于 agent test-time compute 与协作机制分析；它不是预训练方法，但对理解多模型推理时的计算分配和聚合策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出或整理 MALLM 框架，用统一框架模拟多 agent 对话，并比较 voting、consensus、judge decision 等协议在多类会话任务中的效果。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是改变推理时协作与答案汇聚方式。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖从知识类任务到其他会话任务的多样数据集，并系统评估不同协议；未提供可确认的模型规模、具体 benchmark 名称、提升幅度或统计显著性结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen。

summary_en.core_problem: The thesis studies how final-decision protocols in multi-agent LLM conversations affect task performance, comparing voting, consensus, and judge-based mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic comparison of decision protocols for multi-agent LLMs. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time compute allocation and aggregation behavior in multi-model reasoning systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces or consolidates the MALLM framework to simulate multi-agent discussions under a unified setup, evaluating voting, consensus, and judge decision mechanisms across conversational task solving. The main lever is inference-time collaboration rather than model training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the study evaluates a diverse set of tasks, ranging from knowledge-oriented tasks to other conversational settings, but it does not provide concrete model sizes, benchmark names, effect sizes, or statistical details.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen.

recommendation.zh: 可看实验表判断 voting/judge 的相对收益；方法本身偏框架比较，不会改变对训练侧的判断。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the result tables for voting-versus-judge behavior; the method is mostly protocol comparison, not a training-side insight.

paper.title: SwarmResearch: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Open-Ended Discovery
paper.abstract: Long-running coding agents such as autoresearch can persistently discover optimizations for open-ended problems. However, they tend to converge onto a single high-level approach, then proceed with low-level edits while missing other superior approaches to the problem. We hypothesize two harness-level design choices contribute to this behavior: accumulating context in a single long-running agent and only exposing a single program state to edit. We introduce SwarmResearch, an orchestrator-subagent

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长时间运行的 coding agent 容易围绕单一路线做局部修改、缺少高层方向探索的问题，并把原因归结为上下文累积和单一可编辑代码状态。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 预训练没有直接关系，但对通用 agent harness、test-time scaling 和自动化研究流程有参考价值。重点不在模型权重或训练目标，而在推理时如何组织多个 agent 搜索开放式代码优化问题。对基座研究员的间接价值在于：未来如果用 coding/research agent 生成训练数据、优化 kernel、搜索推理算法或自动做实验，harness 的上下文管理和版本分支会影响发现质量。论文把“更多 token/更长运行时间”拆成并行探索、串行深挖和全局调度三类预算，这一点比简单拉长单个 agent 轨迹更清楚。
summary.technical_approach: SwarmResearch 是一个 orchestrator-subagent harness。Shepherd Agent 维护全局上下文，负责生成、调度和引导一组 Search Agents；每个 Search Agent 在自己的 git branch 上工作，并使用新鲜或受控的局部上下文。这个设计针对两个失败模式。第一，单个长上下文 agent 会被早期路线和大量微调历史锚定，后续更倾向于小修小补。SwarmResearch 让子 agent 带着较少历史进入问题，从而更容易提出不同高层方案。第二，传统 autoresearch 循环通常只有一个当前最佳代码状态，改进会合并，退化会回滚，搜索过程接近贪心局部搜索。SwarmResearch 给不同思路分配独立分支，使暂时不是最优但有潜力的路线可以继续演化。Shepherd 的作用不是把任务机械拆成子任务，而是管理种群级搜索：保持想法多样性，把预算投给有希望的方向，并在不同搜索深度之间动态分配并行 agent。
summary.experiments: 论文在 15 个开放式优化任务上比较 SwarmResearch、LLM-guided evolution 和已有 multi-agent 技术，任务覆盖数学、启发式算法和竞赛式 heuristic engineering。SwarmResearch 在 13/15 个任务上达到更好或相当结果。它通常产生 1.7 到 3.2 倍更大的代码修改量，作者用这个指标说明系统更常探索高层方案，而不只是做局部微调。从 test-time scaling 角度看，Shepherd 动态调整不同深度的并行 agent 数量，在 5 个任务中的 4 个上超过了最优固定并行/串行配置。论文还给出 speculative decoding 案例，用来展示这种 harness 在推理算法搜索中的能力和边界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction，理解作者对 autoresearch 失败模式的诊断：长上下文锚定和单代码状态导致局部搜索。随后看 Approach 中 Shepherd/Search Agent 的职责划分、上下文裁剪策略和 git branch 管理，这些是核心贡献。实验部分重点看 15 个任务的总体胜率、代码改动幅度指标，以及 test-time scaling 分析。对 LLM 系统研究更相关的是 speculative decoding case study，可以看它是否真的发现了不同算法路线，而不是只调参数。无需细读具体 prompt 或 skill 全文，除非要复现 agent harness。
summary.authors_note: 给定材料未提供机构和完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the tendency of long-running coding agents to converge on one high-level approach and then spend most of their budget on local edits, rather than exploring alternative regions of the solution space.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to general agent harness design and test-time scaling for open-ended technical work. The useful insight is that longer trajectories are not automatically better: context accumulation and a single editable program state can bias an agent toward greedy local search. For foundation-model teams, this matters when coding agents are used to search inference algorithms, optimize systems code, generate training data, or run automated experiments. The paper gives a concrete way to separate global memory, local exploration, and versioned program states.
summary_en.technical_approach: SwarmResearch uses an orchestrator-subagent structure. A Shepherd Agent maintains global context and allocates a budget across multiple Search Agents. Each Search Agent works with fresh or controlled local context and edits its own git branch. The design addresses two bottlenecks. First, long conversation histories filled with incremental refinements make large conceptual pivots less likely. Giving subagents narrower local context reduces that anchoring effect. Second, a single program state forces the loop to keep the current best implementation and discard regressions, which turns the search into a mostly greedy process. Branching preserves competing approaches so that ideas that are not immediately best can still be refined. The Shepherd does not decompose the task into fixed subtasks; it steers population-level search by maintaining diversity, prioritizing promising branches, and adjusting parallel versus serial exploration depth.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 15 open-ended optimization tasks across mathematics, heuristics, and competitive heuristic engineering. SwarmResearch matches or exceeds LLM-guided evolution and prior multi-agent techniques on 13 of the 15 tasks. It typically makes 1.7x to 3.2x larger code changes, which the authors use as evidence of higher-level exploration rather than small local edits. In a test-time scaling analysis, the orchestrator’s dynamic allocation of parallel agents across search depths outperforms the best fixed parallel/serial scaling setup on 4 of 5 tasks. The paper also includes a speculative decoding case study, which is the most relevant example for LLM inference researchers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the diagnosis of why autoresearch-style loops get stuck: accumulated context and a single editable codebase. Then focus on the approach section, especially the Shepherd/Search Agent split, local versus global context management, and git-branch strategy. In the experiments, look at the 15-task comparison, the code-change-size analysis, and the test-time scaling results. The speculative decoding case study is worth reading if the goal is to understand whether the harness discovers genuinely different algorithmic directions. The full skill prompts are only necessary for reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §harness 设计和 13/15 任务分析；它把 agent scaling 的收益具体落到分支隔离和高层探索。
recommendation.en: Read the harness design and the 13/15 task analysis; it ties agent-scaling gains to branch isolation and high-level exploration.

paper.title: Rethinking Scientific Discovery in an Agentic Era
paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced scientific discovery, but most AI4Science systems remain fragmented tools that rely on humans to coordinate problem formulation, literature grounding, model use, simulation, validation, and knowledge reuse. This paper presents \textbf{SCION (Scientific Collaborative Innovation with Agentic Organizational Nexus)}, an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an \textbf{organizational nexus}. Through a Science Agent serving as a \textbf{Meta-Harness}, SC

summary.core_problem: 把 AI4Science 中分散的人类协调流程，改造成可执行、可审计、可复用的 agentic 科研操作系统。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用科研 Agent 系统设计。它不是预训练方法，但 REP、层级多 Agent 执行、记忆和验证检查点这些设计，对长程 Agent 任务的执行结构有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SCION，以 Science Agent 作为 Meta-Harness，连接任务、工具、Agent、产物和记忆。核心抽象是 Research Execution Plan，把高层科研意图编译成阶段目标、依赖关系、验证检查点、工具需求、预期产物和回退条件，并结合层级多 Agent、专业化 profile、选择性上下文管理等机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述系统框架，没有给出明确的模型规模、训练数据、任务集、对照系统或量化指标。若正文缺少严格基准，它更接近系统蓝图而非可验证方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Innovation Institute、Fudan University、East China Normal University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to turn fragmented human-coordinated AI4Science workflows into an executable, auditable, and reusable agentic scientific operating system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general scientific-agent system design. It is not a pretraining paper, but its REP abstraction, hierarchical multi-agent execution, memory, and verification checkpoints are relevant to long-horizon agent organization.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCION uses a Science Agent as a Meta-Harness to connect tasks, tools, agents, artifacts, and memory. Its central abstraction, the Research Execution Plan, compiles high-level scientific intent into staged objectives, dependencies, verification checkpoints, tool needs, expected artifacts, and fallback conditions, with hierarchical multi-agent execution and selective context control.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on the system architecture and does not provide model sizes, training data, benchmark tasks, baselines, or quantitative results. Without strong empirical evaluation, it should be read as a system proposal rather than a validated method.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Innovation Institute, Fudan University, and East China Normal University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 REP 抽象和验证检查点设计；若实验不扎实，它只是科研 Agent 编排模板。
recommendation.en: Read only the REP abstraction and verification checkpoints; without hard eval, this is an orchestration template.

paper.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to translate natural language into 3D scenes in a procedural way, but existing systems focus on static output. Dynamic 4D scenes from text alone, in which liquids flow, particles emit, rigid bodies cascade, and articulated mechanisms move, remain largely unexplored despite their value as editable content and as physics-grounded training data for video generation and embodied AI. Two challenges set the dynamic case apart from static text-to-scene work: an agent mu

summary.core_problem: 把自然语言转成可编辑的动态 4D/3D 场景，而不是只生成静态 3D 布局。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在多模态生成和 Agent 工作流：尝试把 LLM procedural coding、物理仿真、场景规划和视频级验证接起来。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，动态物理场景可能成为视频生成或具身模型的数据来源。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SimWorlds 多 Agent 框架，用 planner-coder-reviewer 流程驱动 Blender 场景生成。系统采用固定顺序的构建阶段，协调空间布局、物理求解器、时间序列、相机和光照，并通过分层场景协议组织动态对象和可编辑资产。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，工作重点是系统能力展示与动态场景生成案例。未在给定摘要中看到模型参数量、训练数据规模、与强基线的定量比较或清晰提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Ming-Hsuan Yang 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；László A. Jeni 也长期从事视觉和行为分析相关研究。题录未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles text-driven creation of editable dynamic 4D/3D scenes rather than static 3D layouts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal generation and agent workflow: it connects LLM-based procedural coding, physics simulation, scene planning, and video-level verification. For pretraining researchers, the value is indirect: such systems may help synthesize physics-grounded data for video or embodied models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SimWorlds uses a multi-agent planner-coder-reviewer pipeline for Blender scene construction. A fixed ordered sequence of stages coordinates spatial layout, physics solvers, temporal sequencing, camera, and lighting, while a layered scene protocol structures dynamic objects and editable assets.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract emphasizes system capability and dynamic scene examples. It does not expose model size, training data scale, strong quantitative baselines, or clear improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Ming-Hsuan Yang is a well-known computer vision researcher, and László A. Jeni has substantial work in vision and behavioral analysis. Full affiliations are not available in the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 作为合成动态世界数据的早期系统信号可扫一眼；不改变预训练范式判断，重点看失败案例和验证协议。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look as an early signal for synthetic dynamic-world data; it does not change pretraining priors, and the useful parts are failure cases and verification protocol.

paper.title: BOUNDARY_SYNC: Measuring Communication-Induced Representational Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as communicating agents, does inter-agent communication cause outputs to converge? We introduce BOUNDARY_SYNC, a protocol measuring representational coupling via the Coupling Amplification Factor (CAF = JSD_cond / JSD_baseline), where CAF < 1 indicates homogenization and CAF > 1 indicates diversification. In controlled GPT-4o experiments (N=30, ~9,900 API calls), we measure coupling in text and image communication. Key findings: (1) text communication

summary.core_problem: 研究多智能体 LLM 系统中，智能体之间的通信是否会让输出分布趋同，还是会带来多样化。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个行为测量协议，而不是新的 agent 架构。它把多智能体通信后的表示耦合量化为 Coupling Amplification Factor，为分析 agent 群体中的同质化风险提供了一个可复现实验框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BOUNDARY_SYNC 协议，用条件设置下的 Jensen-Shannon divergence 与基线 JSD 的比值定义 CAF。CAF < 1 表示通信后分布被压近，CAF > 1 表示通信后分布被拉开。实验覆盖文本通信与图像通信，并加入无通信消融和 prompt perturbation 控制。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-4o 上做受控实验，N=30，总计约 9,900 次 API 调用。文本通信产生显著同质化，CAF=0.803，95% CI 为 [0.740, 0.873]，效应量 d=1.30，p<0.001。图像通信在同模态基线下也同质化，CAF=0.834，[0.811, 0.858]。组大小会改变方向，K=5 倾向同质化，K=3 的点估计 CAF 分别为 1.14 和 1.06，提示可能转向多样化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether communication among LLM agents makes their outputs converge or diversify.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a behavioral measurement protocol rather than a new agent architecture. It introduces a quantitative handle on communication-induced coupling, which is useful for diagnosing homogenization in multi-agent LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: BOUNDARY_SYNC defines a Coupling Amplification Factor as the ratio between conditional Jensen-Shannon divergence and baseline Jensen-Shannon divergence. CAF below 1 indicates homogenization, while CAF above 1 indicates diversification. The protocol tests text and image communication with no-communication ablations and prompt-perturbation controls.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled study uses GPT-4o with N=30 and roughly 9,900 API calls. Text communication significantly homogenizes outputs with CAF=0.803, 95% CI [0.740, 0.873], d=1.30, p<0.001. Image communication also homogenizes under within-modality baselines with CAF=0.834, [0.811, 0.858]. Group size appears to moderate the direction: K=5 homogenizes, while K=3 has point estimates above 1.0.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线，只看 CAF 定义和组大小反转；这类通信耦合指标可作为 agent 评测弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; read the CAF definition and the group-size reversal only, as a weak signal for agent interaction metrics.

paper.title: What LLM Agents Say When No One Is Watching: Social Structure and Latent Objective Emergence in Multi-Agent Debates
paper.abstract: LLM agents will increasingly act in socially structured settings where role, audience, and relational context can shape what is advantageous or costly to say. We study whether such social structure, without any explicit objective in the prompt, changes what an agent expresses publicly relative to an off-the-record (OTR) channel elicited under the same condition. We introduce a dual-channel debate framework in which agents produce public utterances that enter the shared history alongside OTR resp

summary.core_problem: 研究在多智能体辩论中，社会角色、受众和关系结构是否会在没有显式目标提示的情况下，系统性改变 LLM agent 的公开表达，并诱发“潜在目标”出现。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 agent 行为分析工作，不是预训练方法论文；价值在于它把“社会情境会改变模型表述”从直觉变成了可测量现象，对后训练对齐、agent 评测和部署监控有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出双通道辩论框架：同一条件下，agent 一边生成会进入共享历史的公开发言，一边生成不会被对手看到的 off-the-record 响应。通过 stance、语义相似度、NLI 和问卷四类分析，比较公开通道与 OTR 通道的系统性偏移，以识别社会结构诱发的表达分叉。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 10 个模型、3 类场景、每类 5 个变体。结果显示，在会诱发对齐压力的设定下，目标 agent 的决策分歧率从约 3% 的基线升至约 40%。论文强调这种 public-OTR divergence 在多种聚合分析下都较稳定，但从摘要看，尚未看到更大规模任务、真实工具环境或训练干预实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether social role, audience, and relational context can systematically alter what an LLM agent says publicly, even without any explicit objective in the prompt, thereby inducing latent objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-behavior analysis paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value is in turning the intuition that social context changes model behavior into a measurable phenomenon, with implications for post-training alignment, agent evaluation, and deployment monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a dual-channel debate framework: under the same condition, an agent produces a public response that enters shared history and an off-the-record response that is logged but hidden from the other participant. They then quantify public-vs-OTR divergence using stance analysis, semantic similarity, NLI, and survey judgments.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans 10 models, 3 scenarios, and 5 variants per scenario. In alignment-inducing settings, decision divergence for the targeted agent rises from a roughly 3% baseline to about 40%. The effect appears consistent across multiple aggregate analyses, though the abstract does not indicate large-scale task realism, tool use, or intervention studies.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你 agent 行为里有“表面顺从、私下偏移”的测量盲区；看设定即可，别把结论直接外推到真实部署。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it exposes a measurement blind spot in agent behavior—public compliance can mask private divergence; read the setup, but do not overgeneralize to deployment.

paper.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
paper.abstract: Understanding large, complex codebases, especially those with obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation, remains a significant challenge. Existing code summarization solutions often rely on a single language model or coding assistant like Claude Code, and treat source code as flat text, underutilizing the rich interdependencies and hierarchical information within a repository. To address these shortcomings, we propose Agent4cs - a multi-agent framework that summarizes large codebases in

summary.core_problem: 现有代码摘要方案多依赖单一大模型并将代码视为扁平文本，未充分利用仓库内的层级结构和依赖关系。
summary.importance: 提出自底向上的多智能体代码摘要框架，属于代码智能体的增量方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: Agent4cs采用三智能体协作的自底向上摘要流程：摘要智能体生成代码摘要，关键词提取智能体从子文件夹中主动识别关键信息，质量保证智能体迭代优化输出的可读性、一致性和完整性。
summary.experiments: 在7个前沿模型上评估，相比两个结构化提示基线，Agent4cs在所有文件夹层级的语义一致性平均提升8%。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自伦敦大学学院（UCL）和西门子，Thomas Runkler长期从事机器学习研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code summarization solutions rely on a single LLM and treat code as flat text, underutilizing hierarchical structure and dependencies within repositories.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a bottom-up multi-agent framework for large codebase summarization — an incremental improvement in code agent methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agent4cs uses three collaborating agents in a bottom-up workflow: a summarization agent produces summaries, a keyword-extraction agent proactively identifies critical information from subfolders, and a quality-assurance agent iteratively refines outputs for readability, coherence, and completeness.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 7 frontier models; improves semantic consistency across all folder levels by an average of 8% compared to two structured prompting baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from University College London and Siemens; Thomas Runkler has long experience in machine learning research.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体分工做代码摘要的思路中规中矩，8%提升来自结构化prompt基线，参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: A straightforward multi-agent approach to code summarization; the 8% gain is over structured prompting baselines, with limited general insight.

paper.title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
paper.abstract: Software development is a complex task that demands cooperation among agents with diverse roles. Large language models (LLMs) have enabled autonomous multi-agent software development frameworks that leverage role-based collaboration to automate requirements analysis, coding, testing, and refinement. However, existing approaches typically assume that intermediate agent outputs are equally reliable, leaving them vulnerable to hallucination propagation, where incorrect decisions generated in early

summary.core_problem: 现有多Agent软件开发框架默认中间输出同等可靠，导致早期幻觉向下游传播，损害最终代码质量。
summary.importance: 方法改进类，首次将不确定性量化引入多Agent软件开发协作流程，缓解幻觉传播问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出UA-ChatDev，基于token级对数概率设计轻量不确定性估计机制，配合阶段感知阈值校准，选择性触发低置信度输出的重试或修正。
summary.experiments: 在ChatDev标准基准上验证，相比基线降低错误传播率，提升最终软件生成通过率，具体幅度摘要未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent software development frameworks assume all intermediate outputs are equally reliable, causing early hallucinations to propagate downstream and degrade final code quality.
summary_en.importance: Incremental method improvement, first to integrate uncertainty quantification into multi-agent software development collaboration to mitigate hallucination propagation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes UA-ChatDev, which uses a lightweight token-level log-probability based uncertainty estimator paired with phase-aware threshold calibration to selectively trigger retries for low-confidence outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on standard ChatDev benchmarks, reducing error propagation and improving final software pass rate compared to baselines; exact improvement margins not fully disclosed in abstract.

recommendation.zh: ChatDev加置信度过滤的增量工作，方法无本质突破，知道有这个思路即可，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental confidence filtering add-on to ChatDev with no fundamental breakthrough; note the idea, skip full text.

paper.title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used for forecasting future events, as deliberation among multiple LLMs is believed to improve reasoning and calibration. Yet existing approaches overlook a critical design choice: what information each agent receives. When all agents are given identical evidence, deliberation collapses into herding rather than genuine belief revision, leaving multi-agent systems little better than a single agent. We identify this as a fundamental gap and propose designed inf

summary.core_problem: 现有多agent预测系统默认给所有agent分配完全相同的输入证据，导致审议过程退化为羊群效应，无法带来相对单agent的性能提升
summary.importance: 机制创新，识别了多agent审议中被忽略的信息分配设计维度，从理论上证明异构信息输入的必要性
summary.technical_approach: 提出信息不对称设计框架InfoDelphi，将证据拆分为共享公共子集和不相交私有子集分配给不同agent，结合相关性感知证据路由、基于原理的迭代审议、置信度加权聚合实现多agent预测
summary.experiments: 在PolyGym基准（375个二元预测问题）上，InfoDelphi的预测准确率、校准度显著优于同信息输入的多agent基线和单agent基线

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent forecasting systems feed identical evidence to all agents, turning deliberation into herding behavior with no gain over single-agent performance
summary_en.importance: Mechanism innovation that identifies the overlooked information allocation design dimension in multi-agent deliberation, with theoretical proof for the necessity of heterogeneous information inputs
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes InfoDelphi, a framework with designed information asymmetry: evidence is split into shared public subsets and disjoint private subsets per agent, combined with relevance-aware routing, rationale-based iterative deliberation, and confidence-weighted aggregation
summary_en.experiments: On PolyGym, a benchmark of 375 binary forecasting questions, InfoDelphi outperforms identical-evidence multi-agent baselines and single-agent baselines on both accuracy and calibration

recommendation.zh: 点破多agent审议喂同质化证据只会导致羊群效应的常见误区，信息异构才是增益来源，看§3理论分析和消融就够
recommendation.en: Exposes the common pitfall of homogeneous evidence feeding in multi-agent deliberation causing herding; read §3 theory and ablations for the core insight

paper.title: ATM: CID-Brokered Pre-Write Admission for Multi-Agent Code Co-Synthesis
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can decompose software-engineering work into planning, generation, validation, and repair, but a narrower systems problem remains: before any governed shared mutation is applied, a system must decide which concurrently formed write intents may proceed in parallel, which require deterministic composition or serialization, and which must take a fail-closed path. We address this problem with the AI-Atomic-Framework (ATM), a specification-grounded governance substrate for sof

summary.core_problem: 解决多 Agent 代码协作中共享仓库写入前的准入治理问题：哪些并发写意图可并行、哪些要组合或串行、哪些必须保守拒绝。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统规范与执行治理。它关注的是 SWE Agent 在真实代码库中进行共享 mutation 时的冲突控制、证据链和 fail-closed 策略，而不是代码生成模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AI-Atomic-Framework，将任务意图、仓库作用域、写入准入、验证和证据义务绑定为一条治理链。核心组件是 CID broker，用内容标识符管理共享 mutation 准入；adapter-guided atomization 将写意图映射到语义 atom 和受限区域；当持久 atom-map 覆盖不足时，用 virtual atoms 做临时、可审计的保守路由。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、数据集、基线或量化结果。论文看起来更像架构/规范型系统方案，实验可信度需要看正文是否有真实仓库、多 Agent 并发冲突和回滚场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses pre-write admission control for multi-agent code co-synthesis: deciding which concurrent write intents can run in parallel, which must be composed or serialized, and which should fail closed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems-governance design for SWE agents. It targets shared repository mutation, conflict control, evidence obligations, and conservative routing rather than improving the underlying code model.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the AI-Atomic-Framework, binding task intent, repository scope, write admission, validation, and evidence into one governance chain. A CID broker handles shared-mutation admission; adapter-guided atomization maps write intents into semantic atoms and bounded regions; virtual atoms are used as temporary auditable units when persistent atom-map coverage is incomplete.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results. The paper appears to be a specification/system design, and its value depends on whether the full text includes realistic repository-level concurrency and rollback cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看写入准入模型即可；对预训练没直接信号，但暴露了 SWE Agent 落地时常被低估的共享 mutation 坑。
recommendation.en: Read only the admission model; it does not inform pretraining directly, but it captures a real shared-mutation failure mode in SWE agents.

paper.title: From Personas to Plot: Character-Grounded Multi-Agent Story Generation for Long-Form Narratives
paper.abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive creative fiction generation, they struggle to maintain narrative consistency and coherent plot lines in long-form stories. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for long-form narrative generation and verification. MAGNET, a multi-agent goal-driven narrative engine for storytelling, generates stories with persona-grounded character agents that propose actions based on a shared world state and evolving story goals, while A

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成长篇小说时角色行为、世界状态和情节线难以长期保持一致的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向长篇叙事的多 agent 生成与验证框架，属于应用型 agent 方法；对通用预训练帮助有限，但可作为长时程状态管理和 agent 互相约束的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAGNET，多角色 agent 基于 persona、共享 world state 和动态 story goals 提出行动并生成故事；同时提出 ATLAS，用图结构表示 scene-level world states，并跨场景比较以检测叙事 hallucination。
summary.experiments: 作者用 LLM editor、pairwise rubric scoring 和 ATLAS 评估。100 页生成设置下，MAGNET 相比 single-model prompting 将 annotations 和 hallucinations 分别降低 41% 和 50%；相比 IBSEN 分别降低 34% 和 45%。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注强机构 Cohere；工作聚焦创意写作中的长篇多 agent 叙事生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-form fiction generation, where LLMs struggle to maintain character consistency, world state, and coherent plotlines.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multi-agent generation and verification framework for long-form narratives. It is mostly an applied agent system, but it offers a case study in long-horizon state tracking and agent constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAGNET uses persona-grounded character agents that propose actions based on a shared world state and evolving story goals. ATLAS builds graph-based scene-level world representations and compares them across the generated story to detect narrative hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is evaluated with an LLM editor, pairwise rubric scoring, and ATLAS. At 100 pages, MAGNET reduces annotations and hallucinations by 41% and 50% relative to a single-model baseline, and by 34% and 45% relative to IBSEN.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is associated with Cohere and focuses on multi-agent long-form creative writing.

recommendation.zh: 作为长时程 agent 状态管理案例看摘要即可；故事生成任务太窄，别把结果外推到通用规划。
recommendation.en: Glance at it as a long-horizon agent state-management case; the storytelling setup is too narrow to extrapolate to general planning.

paper.title: Conversable Complexity: Agentic LLM Collectives as Interpretable Substrates
paper.abstract: Complexity and interpretability rarely coincide: systems rich enough for complex behaviours to emerge are usually too opaque to question, while transparent ones are too simple for anything complex to emerge. A single large language model (LLM) is a static artefact, hardly exhibiting any of the emergent properties we associate with life. This changes through interaction: populations of LLMs display emergent dynamics absent from isolated models. Furthermore, LLMs can be endowed with persistent mem

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 LLM 群体能否作为人工生命研究的计算基底，同时保留一定可解释性。
summary.importance: 贡献是概念性框架和研究议程。它把 agentic LLM collective 放到复杂系统与可解释性之间的缝隙中讨论，价值在于提出问题，而不是给出训练方法或强实验证据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张把带有持久记忆、工具、共享技能和主动行动能力的 LLM agent 组成群体，通过自然语言交互产生集体动态。由于交互轨迹是文本，研究者可以检查通信记录，也可以询问 agent 对自身行为的解释。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示这是论述型工作，没有报告具体模型规模、agent 数量、环境设置、基线或量化结果。
summary.authors_note: IT University of Copenhagen、University of Oslo、Østfold University of Applied Sciences；Sebastian Risi 长期从事人工生命、开放式演化与生成系统研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether collectives of agentic LLMs can serve as a computational substrate for artificial-life research while remaining partially interpretable.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual framework and research agenda. It positions LLM agent collectives between complex adaptive systems and interpretability, but it does not provide a training method or strong empirical evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposal is to build populations of LLM agents equipped with persistent memory, tools, shared skills, and the ability to initiate actions. Their natural-language communication produces collective dynamics, while textual traces and self-reports offer an inspection interface.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents this as an argumentative or position paper. It does not report model sizes, number of agents, environment configurations, baselines, or quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: IT University of Copenhagen, University of Oslo, and Østfold University of Applied Sciences; Sebastian Risi is known for work on artificial life, open-ended evolution, and generative systems.

recommendation.zh: 概念稿，不给可复现实验；若关心多 agent 可解释性，只看它对“文本轨迹可审计”的论证。
recommendation.en: A position piece, not an empirical result; read only the argument that language traces make multi-agent dynamics auditable.

paper.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-rich image generation is one of the most challenging settings in image generation, since models must simultaneously produce visually realistic images and render legible, semantically aligned, and layout-consistent text. Existing data pipelines usually follow a static crawl-filter-freeze paradigm. They collect candidate samples, filter them once, and freeze the accepted data for training. However, rejected samples are usually discarded, although they often contain useful failure signals such

summary.core_problem: 解决文本丰富图像生成中训练数据构建静态、一次性过滤后无法利用失败样本反馈的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献在数据构建流程而非模型本身。虽然任务是 text-rich image generation，离 LLM 预训练有一层距离，但“把 rejected samples 变成下一轮数据策略信号”这个思路，对预训练数据筛选、课程式构建和合成数据闭环有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DataEvolver，多智能体自演化数据构建框架。Retriever 收集候选样本，Verifier 给出质量分与拒绝原因，Critic 汇总轮次级失败模式形成语义反馈，Generator/策略模块据此更新后续构建策略。与 crawl-filter-freeze 的静态管线不同，它把数据构建视为带反馈的策略演化过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练轮数或数据量，也未说明相对哪些 text-rich image generation baseline 提升多少；从设定看，实验重点应是数据集质量提升以及下游生成模型在文本可读性、语义一致性、布局一致性上的改进。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the static crawl-filter-freeze pipeline for text-rich image generation data, where rejected samples are discarded instead of being used as feedback.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily about data construction rather than model design. The task is image generation, but the idea of turning rejected samples into signals for the next data-construction round is transferable to pretraining data curation and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: DataEvolver is a self-evolving multi-agent data construction framework: a Retriever gathers candidates, a Verifier scores quality and rejection causes, a Critic summarizes round-level failure patterns into semantic feedback, and the construction policy is updated accordingly. This replaces a static one-shot filtering pipeline with a feedback-driven loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, or exact gains over baselines. The likely evaluation focuses on improved dataset quality and downstream gains in text legibility, semantic alignment, and layout consistency for text-rich image generation.

recommendation.zh: 任务偏图像生成，但“拒绝样本别扔，拿来更新数据策略”这点值得借到 pretrain data pipeline；只看数据闭环设计即可。
recommendation.en: The task is image generation, but the key lesson is reusable: rejected samples should update the data policy rather than be discarded; read it for the data loop only.

paper.title: FARS: A Fully Automated Research System Deployed at Scale
paper.abstract: Recent automated research systems show that language-model agents can generate hypotheses, run experiments, and write complete manuscripts, but most evidence still comes from selected examples, human-framed topics, or a few pre-defined research tasks. We present FARS (Fully Automated Research System), a fully automated AI-for-AI research system designed to operate across research topics at scale. FARS autonomously generates and advances projects through ideation, planning, experimentation, and w

summary.core_problem: 现有自动化科研Agent系统的验证大多基于精选案例、人工设定的研究主题或少量预定义任务，缺少大规模、无人工干预连续运行场景下的系统表现与产出质量的系统性实测证据。
summary.importance: 该工作是目前规模较大的端到端AI-for-AI科研系统公开部署案例，产出的全链路可审计科研轨迹数据、测得的自动化科研产出质量分布与常见失败模式，对未来利用自动化系统辅助大模型预训练实验迭代、研究思路生成有实际参考意义；但工作本身属于系统工程实践，并未提出新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: FARS采用分阶段多Agent架构，将科研流程拆分为创意生成、方案规划、实验执行、论文写作四个顺序阶段，各阶段Agent通过统一共享工作空间交换全部中间产物（提案、代码、日志、结果、手稿），运行全程无人工干预。系统将包含明确假设与验证尝试的聚焦性研究作为有效产出单元，不默认负结果为失败，保留所有成功、弱产出、失败轨迹供审计，而非筛选展示成功案例。当前版本面向AI/ML领域场景设计——该领域多数假设可转化为可执行代码，在通用基准上完成验证。
summary.experiments: 首次公开连续部署期间，FARS共产出166篇完整论文，覆盖67个细粒度AI/ML子方向。团队招募志愿者对其中140篇完成了282份结构化评审，结果显示产出质量方差很大：系统能够生成达到学术评审门槛、甚至质量较好的研究产物，但普遍存在实验范围狭窄、方法学设计有缺陷、学术诚信相关问题。全量运行的所有中间产物均被保留，未做结果筛选。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时浏览引言中与现有自动化科研系统的差异部分，重点看评审结果章节总结的常见失败模式即可，多阶段管线的具体实现细节不需要深入阅读，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing autonomous research agent systems are largely validated on curated examples, human-framed topics, or small sets of predefined tasks, leaving a gap in systematic empirical evidence on system behavior and output quality when such systems run continuously without human intervention at scale.
summary_en.importance: This is among the largest public deployments of end-to-end AI-for-AI research systems to date. Its fully auditable trail of research trajectories, measured output quality distribution, and documented failure modes provide practical reference for using autonomous systems to accelerate pretraining experiment iteration and research ideation. The work itself is a systems engineering effort, not a pretraining method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: FARS uses a staged multi-agent architecture that decomposes the research workflow into four sequential stages: ideation, planning, experimentation, and writing. All stage agents coordinate through a shared persistent workspace that stores every intermediate artifact, including proposals, code, execution logs, experimental results, and manuscripts, with no human intervention during active runs. The system treats focused contributions consisting of an explicit hypothesis paired with a validation attempt as valid outputs, does not treat negative results as failed projects by default, and retains all successful, weak, and failed trajectories for audit rather than curating a selected set of successful demonstrations. The current version is scoped to AI/ML research, where most hypotheses can be operationalized as executable code evaluated on standard shared benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: In its first continuous public deployment, FARS produced 166 complete research papers covering 67 fine-grained AI/ML subtopics. A structured review process collected 282 reviews from recruited volunteer reviewers for 140 of these papers. Results show very high variance in output quality: the system can produce artifacts that meet academic review standards, including occasional strong outputs, but recurring weaknesses include narrow experimental scope, methodological flaws, and integrity issues. All intermediate artifacts from the full production run are preserved with no curation or filtering of results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for comparisons to prior automated research systems, and focus on the review results section for documented recurring failure modes. Low-level implementation details of the multi-agent pipeline do not require close reading. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和评审分布即可；若 artifacts 真实完整，它比单篇 Agent demo 更能校准自动科研的天花板。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and review distribution; if the artifacts are complete, this calibrates automated research better than another single-demo agent paper.

paper.title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialect

summary.core_problem: 这项工作想解决多智能体辩论推理的两个工程性限制：角色和通信拓扑通常是预先固定的，难以随问题复杂度动态切换；同时，多智能体系统往往需要多份模型实例，推理成本和延迟较高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近推理架构和参数高效微调方法。但它有一个有用的观察：MoE 的路由不一定只服务于容量扩展，也可以被设计成“推理过程控制器”，让不同专家承担提出、反驳、综合等功能。这个方向对研究 MoE 专家分工、推理时动态计算、以及多角色能力是否能内化到单模型里，有一定参考价值。贡献量级仍偏早期，关键还要看规模化训练和消融是否支持这些设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Mixture-of-Debaters。它基于一个冻结的视觉语言骨干，在 Transformer 中插入轻量 MoD adapter，用来替代标准 LoRA 的单一路径低秩更新。标准 LoRA 是一个固定的低秩旁路，MoD 则把低秩模块拆成多个专家池，并通过动态路由选择专家。核心有三点。第一是 dual-routing，把“角色分配”和“流程控制”分开：一类路由决定当前 token 或局部上下文应由 proposer、critic 等角色专家处理，另一类路由决定当前阶段是继续辩论还是进入总结综合。这样做的动机是，辩论不是普通 MoE 的单一专家选择问题，角色和阶段是两个不同维度。第二是 momentum switching，用局部上下文聚合来平滑 token 级路由，减少专家在短片段内频繁切换。这个设计针对辩论场景很具体：如果模型在一句话中不断从支持方切到反驳方，推理轨迹会变得不连贯。第三是 unified self-debate，把多个辩论角色封装进同一个模型的专家模块，避免外部多模型编排和多轮通信。与传统多智能体辩论相比，它把“多角色交互”改成了模型内部的动态专家选择；与普通 MoE 相比，它显式区分了角色路由和阶段路由。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段没有包含完整实验表、具体 benchmark、参数规模、训练数据规模和消融数字，因此不能确认实际增益幅度。能从方法描述中看出的关键实验应包括：与标准 LoRA、普通 MoE adapter、多模型辩论框架的比较；dual-routing 的消融；momentum switching 对路由抖动、专家持续性和答案质量的影响；以及 text-only 和 multimodal reasoning 场景下的成本—效果权衡。若缺少这些消融，方法的主要证据会停留在架构合理性层面。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 §3.1 的 MoD adapter 结构，尤其是 dual-routing 的数学定义和 momentum switching 如何计算；再看 §3.2 的指令微调数据，因为显式 viewpoint shift 监督会直接影响专家是否真的学到不同角色。实验部分如果完整可见，重点看三类消融：去掉流程路由、去掉角色路由、去掉 momentum smoothing。真正需要判断的是收益来自“辩论结构”，还是来自更大的 adapter 容量和额外指令数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical limits of multi-agent debate systems: fixed role and communication patterns, and the cost of running multiple model instances to simulate debate.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as an architectural probe into how MoE routing can be used for reasoning control rather than only for capacity scaling. It suggests that expert specialization can encode debate roles and reasoning stages inside one model. The idea is useful for thinking about MoE expert semantics, dynamic test-time computation, and whether multi-agent behaviors can be internalized by a single backbone. The current contribution should be treated as exploratory until larger-scale evidence and clean ablations are available.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture-of-Debaters builds on a frozen vision-language backbone and inserts lightweight MoD adapters in place of standard LoRA modules. A standard LoRA path provides one low-rank update; MoD replaces this with expert pools and dynamic routing. The main design choice is dual routing: one router handles role allocation, such as proposer or critic, while another controls the reasoning stage, such as debate versus synthesis. This separation matters because debate has at least two axes of control, and a single token-level MoE gate is a poor fit for both. The second component is momentum switching, which smooths routing decisions over local context. It is intended to prevent rapid expert flips that would make a debate trace incoherent. The third component is unified self-debate: instead of coordinating several external agents, the model stores debating personas in internal expert modules and activates them within one forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, data scale, benchmark results, or ablation numbers. The key evidence to look for would be comparisons against standard LoRA, ordinary MoE adapters, and external multi-agent debate; ablations for role routing, stage routing, and momentum switching; and measurements of both reasoning quality and inference cost. Without these numbers, the method is best read as a plausible architecture proposal rather than a validated scaling result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on §3.1 for the adapter design, especially the exact definitions of dual routing and momentum switching. Then check §3.2, because the instruction-tuning data with explicit viewpoint shifts may be doing a large part of the work. In the experiments, look for whether the gains survive removing role routing, stage routing, or smoothing. The central question is whether the improvement comes from debate-aware structure, or simply from extra adapter capacity and supervised debate-style data.

recommendation.zh: MoE 路由用于推理时角色切换的思路有启发，重点看双路由设计与动量切换消融，不必全读。
recommendation.en: The idea of using MoE routing for test-time role switching is insightful; focus on dual-routing design and momentum-switching ablations, no need to read in full.

paper.title: Is Lying an Emergent Behaviour in LLMs? Evidence from Gaslighting AI agents in a Sustainability Game
paper.abstract: LLMs agents are increasingly used in multi-agent settings, yet their behaviour in sustainability games remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether lying can emerge among LLM agents in a competitive sustainability game in which agents are informed that common resources can regenerate, although regeneration does not actually occur. We develop an agent-based model of a sustainability game in which agents manage industrial, military, and ecological resources, and interact through a ne

summary.core_problem: 这项工作问的是：在一个有公共资源约束、局部邻居交互和竞争压力的多智能体环境里，LLM agent 是否会产生欺骗行为，以及这些欺骗行为如何影响系统的长期可持续性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接价值有限，更接近多智能体安全与行为评测。它的启发点在于把“欺骗”放进了长期交互和资源博弈里，而不是单轮问答或静态偏好测试。对预训练研究的间接价值主要来自训练信号设计：如果模型在不完整信息、声誉反馈和局部竞争中稳定出现策略性误导，说明仅靠静态安全数据很难覆盖这类行为，需要在 post-train 或 agentic eval 中加入动态环境反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是构造一个 agent-based sustainability game。每个 agent 管理工业、军事和生态资源，短期目标是防御和攻击邻居，长期约束是避免公共 biosphere 被耗尽。环境中一个关键设定是：agent 被告知公共资源可以再生，但实际不会再生，因此存在系统性误导信息。论文比较两类 agent：LLM agent 通过提示和模型调用做决策，可以观察邻居状态、声明未来攻击、在某些配置下被允许撒谎，并获得邻居声明与实际行动一致性的声誉信息；rule-based agent 使用固定偏好，作为可解释基线。核心差异不是提出新的模型结构，而是把信息可见性、声明机制、显式撒谎许可和声誉信号拆开，观察它们对攻击、共存、资源保留和欺骗率的影响。
summary.experiments: 实验运行多轮仿真，并改变初始公共资源规模和 LLM agent 的信息配置。主要观察包括：邻居信息会显著改变系统动态，通常会提高攻击频率，但也改善 biosphere retention 和 coexistence；声明未来攻击意图可以降低 extinction risk，但不会消除冲突；即使没有显式允许撒谎，欺骗也会出现；显式允许撒谎后，欺骗频率上升，但更多表现为 bluffing 和 diversion，而不是直接承诺不攻击后反手攻击的 backstabbing；当 agent 获得当前 biosphere 状态信息时，公共资源消耗速度下降，撒谎率也下降。rule-based agent 的作用主要是帮助解释 LLM 行为，而不是作为强性能基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看游戏机制、LLM agent 的提示与可访问信息配置、欺骗行为的定义和标注方式，以及实验结果中不同信息条件的对比图表。对 LLM 预训练研究者而言，不必细读可持续发展背景；更值得看的是动态环境如何诱发非单轮评测中看不到的行为，以及声誉和环境状态信息如何改变模型策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether deception can arise in LLM agents during repeated competitive interaction over a shared resource, and how such behavior affects long-run sustainability in a controlled multi-agent game.
summary_en.importance: The direct connection to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The useful signal is for agent evaluation and post-training safety: deception is tested in a dynamic environment with partial information, reputation, and resource pressure, rather than in isolated prompt-response settings. This matters because static safety data is unlikely to cover failure modes that only appear through repeated interaction and strategic communication.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an agent-based sustainability game. Agents allocate industrial, military, and ecological resources, while a shared biosphere acts as the common-pool constraint. A key manipulation is that agents are told the commons can regenerate, although it does not. The study compares LLM-driven agents with rule-based agents. LLM agents may observe neighbor states, declare future attacks, receive explicit permission to lie under some conditions, and access reputation information about whether neighbors’ prior declarations matched their later actions. The main contribution is not a new modeling method, but a controlled decomposition of information access, declaration, lying permission, and reputation signals in a long-horizon multi-agent setting.
summary_en.experiments: The simulations vary initial commons resources and the behavioral information available to LLM agents. Neighbor information substantially changes system behavior: attacks increase, while biosphere retention and coexistence also improve. Declaring future attacks reduces extinction risk but does not remove conflict. Deception appears even without explicit permission to lie; when lying is allowed, deceptive behavior becomes more frequent, mostly through bluffing and diversion rather than direct backstabbing. Giving agents explicit information about the current biosphere state reduces both commons depletion and lying rates. Rule-based agents serve mainly as an interpretable baseline for reading LLM behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the game specification, the prompt and information conditions for LLM agents, the operational definition of deception, and the result figures comparing information regimes. The sustainability framing can be read lightly. The parts most relevant to LLM research are the dynamic evaluation design and the way reputation and environment-state feedback change agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 核心看§3环境设置与§4.2欺骗涌现定量分析，多Agent博弈范式可复用为预训练涌现行为的评测探针
recommendation.en: Focus on §3 (environment setup) and §4.2 (quantitative analysis of deception emergence); the multi-agent game paradigm can be reused as a probe for pretraining emergent behavior evaluation

paper.title: HMARS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Memory System for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning requires models to access, retrieve, and integrate evidence scattered across documents, dialogues, and accumulated interaction histories. Standard retrieval-augmented generation reduces this problem to top-$K$ chunk retrieval, but such passive access can discard relevant evidence before reasoning begins, especially when relevance depends on broader context. We propose HMARS, a hierarchical multi-agent memory system that treats long contexts as managed memory rather than a

summary.core_problem: 传统RAG采用top-K块检索的被动访问模式处理长上下文推理时，存在两个核心缺陷：一是散落在文档远距离位置的相关证据容易因为单块相关性得分低被提前过滤；二是部分内容的相关性只有结合全局语境才能判断，独立块嵌入无法捕捉这类依赖。现有改进方法要么侧重长程交互中的记忆内容存储/更新/遗忘机制，要么仍然采用集中式的单步检索逻辑，会在推理开始前就丢弃潜在相关证据，长上下文的内存访问机制缺乏合理设计。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的分层内存思路为长上下文推理的工程实现提供了参考，通过重构长上下文的访问模式，避开盲目扩大上下文窗口带来的推理成本问题，同时清晰刻画了传统RAG在上下文依赖相关性场景下的失效模式。但工作核心是推理阶段的系统架构设计，不涉及预训练范式、基座模型架构或训练流程的改动，对预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: HMARS将长文档/交互历史划分成分层的内存区域，采用非对称模型配置平衡检索覆盖率与推理成本：轻量子智能体绑定固定大小的局部内存页，负责本地区域的查询相关性判断；中等强度的中间智能体管理区域级共享记忆，做查询相关的路由协调；最强的前沿基座模型只在最终阶段对检索到的接地证据页做推理，不直接读取全量上下文。这种设计避免了集中式top-K检索提前过滤全文档区域的问题，同时控制了推理算力开销。流程分两步：离线建索引时完成文档分区、子/中智能体绑定与本地记忆卡生成；在线查询时沿着层级路由，每个子智能体都对自己负责的局部区域做查询条件下的相关性评估，不会在初始阶段就排除大段内容，最终聚合相关证据页交给基座模型生成答案。该工作还构造了两个诊断基准，专门测试跨远距离块证据整合、上下文依赖相关性的场景。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个自建诊断基准上开展：一个改造自LongBench-v2，筛选出需要整合远距离散列证据、常规RAG召回率低的问题；另一个是参考RealMem设计的累积交互基准，其中关键事实散落在多轮交互中，仅在后续语境下才体现相关性。根据已披露的结果，HMARS的性能优势集中在被动top-K检索、集中式记忆访问失效的场景；具体的模型尺寸配置、绝对性能提升幅度、消融实验结论在提供的手稿片段中未完整披露。
summary.reading_guide: 属于长上下文推理的系统应用型工作，泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对传统RAG两类核心失效模式的刻画，以及方法部分非对称算力分配、分层内存管理的核心设计思路，具体的prompt设计、实现细节可跳过。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。做长上下文工程、RAG系统的研究者可进一步参考其诊断基准的构造逻辑；做预训练的研究者快速扫过核心设计思路即可，该工作不涉及模型架构、训练目标或数据相关的改动。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard top-K retrieval-augmented generation for long-context reasoning has two core flaws: relevant evidence scattered across distant document positions is often pre-filtered out due to low individual chunk relevance scores, and the relevance of some content only becomes apparent with global context, which independent chunk embeddings cannot capture. Existing improvements either focus on memory content storage, update, and forgetting mechanisms for long-horizon interactions, or rely on centralized single-step retrieval logic that discards potentially relevant evidence before reasoning starts, leaving a gap in properly designed memory access mechanisms for long context.
summary_en.importance: The hierarchical memory design proposed provides an engineering reference for long-context inference systems, avoiding the inference cost of naive context window expansion by restructuring long context access patterns, while clearly articulating failure modes of standard RAG under context-dependent relevance. The work is, however, focused on inference-stage system architecture design, with no changes to pretraining paradigms, base model architecture, or training pipelines, so its direct relevance to pretraining research is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: HMARS partitions long documents or interaction histories into hierarchical memory regions with asymmetric model allocation to balance retrieval coverage and inference cost: lightweight sub-agents are bound to fixed-size local pages and perform query-conditioned relevance assessment on their assigned regions; mid-tier agents manage regional shared memory and coordinate query routing; the strongest frontier base model only performs final reasoning on retrieved grounded evidence pages, never reading the full context. This design avoids the premature filtering of entire document regions that plagues centralized top-K retrieval, while keeping compute overhead manageable. The workflow has two phases: offline indexing partitions documents, binds agents to regions, and generates local memory cards; online querying routes requests through the hierarchy, with every sub-agent evaluating its local region against the query rather than being filtered out upfront, then aggregates relevant evidence pages and passes the compact evidence set to the base model for answer generation. Two diagnostic benchmarks are also constructed to stress cross-region evidence integration and context-dependent relevance, scenarios where standard RAG has low recall.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two custom diagnostic benchmarks: a filtered subset of LongBench-v2 containing questions that require evidence from distant chunks and exhibit low vanilla RAG recall, and a cumulative interaction benchmark inspired by RealMem where key facts scattered across multi-turn interactions only become relevant in later context. Disclosed results indicate HMARS shows the largest gains on settings where passive top-K retrieval and centralized memory access fail; specific model size configurations, absolute performance improvements, and ablation results are not fully disclosed in the available manuscript segment.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is an applied systems work for long-context inference, suitable for skimming. Focus on the introduction's characterization of two core failure modes of standard RAG and the core design ideas of asymmetric compute allocation and hierarchical memory management in the method section; specific prompt designs and implementation details can be skipped. Expected reading time is 15-20 minutes. Researchers working on long-context engineering and RAG systems may refer to the diagnostic benchmark construction logic; pretraining researchers can quickly scan the core design ideas, as the work involves no changes to model architecture, training objectives, or data pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 架构设计有启发，重点看§3分层内存的职责划分和附录的诊断基准构造，可作为长上下文预训练任务设计的参考
recommendation.en: Architecture design is insightful; focus on §3 hierarchical memory responsibility split and appendix diagnostic benchmark construction, useful for long-context pretraining task design.

paper.title: SidConArena: An Environment Evaluating Agents in Open-Ended,Positive-Sum Bargaining Game
paper.abstract: Evaluating LLM agents requires dynamic environments that go beyond static reasoning and zero-sum games. Real-world economic interaction is often open-ended and mixed-motive: agents must negotiate, create positive-sum surplus, compete for scarce assets, and plan under delayed returns. We introduce SidConArena, a new benchmark framework for evaluating LLM agents in open-ended, positive-sum bargaining. SidConArena formalizes a multi-player economy as a finite-horizon partially observable stochastic

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM agent评测多局限于静态推理或零和博弈，无法覆盖真实经济交互中开放式、混合动机（议价、正和剩余创造、资产竞争、延迟回报）的能力维度。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次提出面向开放式正和议价的多agent评测框架，填补了动态经济交互场景下agent能力评估的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SidConArena环境，将多玩家经济建模为有限时域部分可观测随机博弈，包含自然语言议价（绑定交易）、转换器式生产、密封拍卖三个耦合阶段，结合神经符号动作接口与异步执行，兼顾自由交互与规则化评测。
summary.experiments: 在同构/异构agent锦标赛中测试多款前沿模型，发现更强的基础模型能获得更高经济收益，但在复杂议价策略与长期资产配置上仍存在明显能力缺陷（原摘要未披露具体量化指标）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluations are mostly limited to static reasoning or zero-sum games, failing to cover capability dimensions in real-world economic interactions: open-endedness, mixed motives (bargaining, positive-sum surplus creation, asset competition, delayed returns).
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, first proposing a multi-agent evaluation framework for open-ended positive-sum bargaining, filling the gap in agent capability assessment under dynamic economic interaction scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds the SidConArena environment, formalizing a multi-player economy as a finite-horizon partially observable stochastic game with three coupled phases: natural-language bargaining with binding trades, converter-based production, and sealed-bid auctions; combines a neural-symbolic action interface and asynchronous execution to balance free interaction and rule-grounded evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Tests multiple frontier models in homogeneous/heterogeneous agent tournaments, finding that stronger base models achieve higher economic outcomes but still have obvious capability defects in complex bargaining strategies and long-term asset allocation (no specific quantitative metrics disclosed in the provided abstract).

recommendation.zh: 做多agent预训练或对齐的团队看§3的博弈阶段设计，能为议价、协作类预训练数据构造提供新维度。
recommendation.en: Teams working on multi-agent pretraining or alignment should review §3's game phase design for new dimensions in constructing bargaining and collaboration pretraining data.

paper.title: Agent-Native Immune System: Architecture, Taxonomy, and Engineering
paper.abstract: The transition from static chat bots to autonomous agents--equipped with persistent memory, tool-use protocols, and multi-agent collaboration--has fundamentally expanded the AI threat landscape. Current defense mechanisms, such as perimeter security and training-time alignment, remain external to the agent's active reasoning loop. Consequently, they fall short: a fully aligned agent remains highly vulnerable to runtime hijacking via memory poisoning, tool-chain manipulation, or multi-agent proto

summary.core_problem: 现有自治Agent防御多为边界安全或训练时对齐，未嵌入运行时推理循环，无法抵御内存投毒、工具链操纵、多Agent协议攻击等新型攻击面
summary.importance: 架构创新与系统化：首次提出内嵌于Agent认知循环的内生安全架构，并配套攻击与防御分类学
summary.technical_approach: 设计Agent-Native Immune System（ANIS）：包含六层免疫塔（L0-L5），其中L1屏障免疫为非认知层面的物理/逻辑隔离；配套定义Agent病毒与Agent疫苗的统一分类学，并面向记忆、工具调用、多Agent协作等关键路径设计运行时检测与响应机制
summary.experiments: 以典型内存投毒、prompt注入、工具链篡改、多Agent合谋等攻击场景做端到端案例验证，对比传统边界防护在命中率与误报上的改善；未覆盖基座预训练或对齐训练侧改造

summary_en.core_problem: Current autonomous-agent defenses remain external to the active reasoning loop (perimeter security and training-time alignment), leaving agents vulnerable to runtime attacks such as memory poisoning, tool-chain manipulation, and multi-agent protocol exploits.
summary_en.importance: Architectural and system-level contribution: first endogenous security architecture embedded directly in the agent cognitive loop, paired with a unified attack/defense taxonomy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Agent-Native Immune System (ANIS) with a six-layer Immune Tower (L0-L5), including Barrier Immunity (L1) as a non-cognitive physical/logical isolation layer; defines a unified taxonomy for Agent Viruses and Agent Vaccines, and designs runtime detection and response mechanisms along memory, tool-use, and multi-agent collaboration paths.
summary_en.experiments: Validated via end-to-end attack scenarios covering memory poisoning, prompt injection, tool-chain tampering, and multi-agent collusion; reports improved detection rates and lower false positives versus traditional perimeter controls; no pretraining or alignment-training modifications.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练研究员价值有限，重点只看§2攻击分类学即可，作为未来训练时对齐与运行时安全协同设计的威胁模型输入。
recommendation.en: Limited value for pretraining researchers; focus only on §2 attack taxonomy as threat-model input for future synergy between training-time alignment and runtime safety.

paper.title: Delayed Verification Destabilizes Multi-Agent LLM Belief: Instability Thresholds and Optimal Corrector Placement
paper.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems often rely on verifier and critic agents to suppress hallucinations, but verification is delayed. During this delay, false claims can propagate through the agent network. We model this process as delayed consensus on a graph with grounded corrector nodes. Spectral decomposition by the grounded Laplacian yields a closed-form stability threshold for the verification dose: correction that is too strong or too delayed can turn consensus into oscillation

summary.core_problem: 分析多 agent LLM 系统中，验证器/批评器的纠错若存在时延，错误信念会如何传播、振荡，以及纠错节点应放在哪里。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但它给出了一个相对干净的动态系统视角来理解 verifier 延迟带来的不稳定性。对做 agentic training、self-correction、tool-verified pipelines 的研究员有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把多 agent 交互建模为带 grounded corrector nodes 的 delayed consensus on a graph。通过 grounded Laplacian 的谱分解，推导 verification dose 的闭式稳定阈值，并给出 corrector placement 的超模目标与 greedy 近似算法。
summary.experiments: 在五个开源模型上验证了 dose-delay oscillation 现象。摘要中的代表性结论是：通信延迟与验证延迟重合时最不稳定；当 delay=2 时，稳定阈值为黄金分割倒数。作者还指出 grounded factual answering 会让 truth 成为 absorbing boundary，从而消除该不稳定性。
summary.authors_note: Independent Researcher（Tel Aviv）。更偏 agent 系统动力学分析，不属于主流大模型实验室的预训练工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how delayed verification destabilizes belief propagation in multi-agent LLM systems and where limited corrector agents should be placed.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a relatively clean dynamical-systems view of verifier delay and instability. It has indirect value for researchers working on agentic training, self-correction, and tool-verified pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author models multi-agent interaction as delayed consensus on a graph with grounded corrector nodes. Using spectral decomposition of the grounded Laplacian, the paper derives a closed-form stability threshold for verification dose and formulates corrector placement as a supermodular objective with a greedy approximation.
summary_en.experiments: The predicted dose-delay oscillations are tested on five open models. A notable claim from the abstract is that instability is worst when communication and verification delays coincide; for delay two, the threshold is the inverse golden ratio. The paper also argues that grounded factual answering makes truth an absorbing boundary and removes the effect.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent Researcher (Tel Aviv). This is more of an agent-systems dynamics analysis than a mainstream foundation-model pretraining effort.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但建模挺干净；若你做 verifier/self-correction agent，只看稳定阈值推导和 corrector placement 结论就够，别把它外推到真实开放环境太远。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the modeling is clean; if you work on verifier or self-correction agents, read the stability threshold and corrector-placement parts, but do not overgeneralize them to open-world settings.

paper.title: Socratic agents for autonomous scientific discovery in high-dimensional physical systems
paper.abstract: The automation of scientific discovery has reached an inflection point. While AI systems now operate instruments, optimize parameters and generate hypotheses, most remain procedural: they execute workflows fixed by human designers. True autonomous science demands epistemic autonomy--the capacity to construct, challenge and revise physical explanations in response to evidence. Here we introduce AHOIS, a multi-agent AI scientist that embeds Socratic midwifery into closed-loop experimentation. A ph

summary.core_problem: 构建一个用于高维物理系统的多 Agent 科学发现系统，使其能在闭环实验中提出、质疑、修正并验证物理解释。
summary.importance: 贡献在 scientific discovery agent，而不是 LLM 基座训练。论文把 Socratic questioning、物理约束检查、反例生成和证伪标准设计放入实验闭环，对通用 Agent 的 hypothesis critique 模块有一定参考，但实验场景强绑定多模光纤光学平台。
summary.technical_approach: AHOIS 是多 Agent AI scientist。核心是 physics-critic agent：它通过因果追问、约束检查、反例生成和证伪标准 formulation 来审查假设；系统再与真实光学实验平台交互，完成采集、解释、实验修正和验证循环。
summary.experiments: 实验在真实 multimode-fibre optical platform 上进行，该平台包含复杂波变换、间接检测、环境漂移和多模态采集。系统在没有预先编码方案、分类器或 speckle model 的条件下，提出并验证了 random-interference encoding hypothesis。摘要未给出与人类专家、贝叶斯优化或普通 LLM agent 的定量比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a multi-agent scientific-discovery system for high-dimensional physical systems, aiming to let it propose, challenge, revise, and validate physical explanations in closed-loop experiments.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in scientific-discovery agents rather than foundation-model pretraining. It integrates Socratic questioning, physics constraints, counterexample generation, and falsification criteria into an experimental loop. This is mildly relevant to generic agent hypothesis-critique modules, but the evidence is tied to a multimode-fibre optics platform.
summary_en.technical_approach: AHOIS is a multi-agent AI scientist. Its core component is a physics-critic agent that interrogates hypotheses through causal questioning, constraint checking, counterexample generation, and falsification-criteria formulation. The system interacts with a real optical platform to run acquisition, explanation, experimental revision, and validation loops.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a real multimode-fibre optical platform with complex wave transformations, indirect detection, environmental drift, and multimodal acquisition. Without prior encoding schemes, classifiers, or speckle models, the system proposes and validates a random-interference encoding hypothesis. The abstract does not report quantitative comparisons against human experts, Bayesian optimization, or a plain LLM agent.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 Socratic critic 结构即可；物理实验很窄，缺少干净基线时不要外推到通用 Agent。
recommendation.en: Note the Socratic critic pattern, but the physics setup is narrow and should not be extrapolated to general agents without clean baselines.

paper.title: ReM-MoA: Reasoning Memory Sustains Mixture-of-Agents Scaling
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) architectures improve inference-time scaling by organizing multiple LLM agents into layered reasoning pipelines. However, existing MoA variants fail to sustain gains as depth increases, exhibiting degradation, early plateauing, or saturation. We propose ReM-MoA, a memory-augmented MoA framework that sustains scaling through two mechanisms: (1) a Ranked Reasoning Memory that persistently stores and ranks reasoning traces from all layers using a comparative Reviewer Agent,

summary.core_problem: 现有混合智能体（MoA）架构随堆叠深度增加会出现性能退化、过早平台期或饱和，无法持续获得推理时缩放增益，根源是跨层错误累积、优质推理轨迹丢失与层内探索多样性崩溃。
summary.importance: 明确了MoA推理时缩放的核心瓶颈是质量与多样性的联合维持，而非单纯的信息聚合或交互，对推理时缩放、多智能体协作架构的设计有方法层面的启发，其记忆+路由的思路也可为预训练阶段的多路径推理建模提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReM-MoA框架，包含两项核心机制：1）排序推理记忆：引入独立的评审智能体对所有层生成的推理轨迹做对比评分并给出针对性理由，将排序后的轨迹和理由持久化存储为跨层记忆；2）定制化多样记忆路由：为层内不同智能体分配不同组合的优质与劣质推理轨迹作为输入，既传递高质量推理信号，又通过差异化输入保留智能体的探索多样性；此外可选多领域评审智能体蒸馏流水线，用前沿大模型作为教师，通过LoRA微调得到通用型评审智能体。
summary.experiments: 在数学、形式逻辑、代码、知识、常识5类推理基准上，针对不同的深度（1~9层）和宽度（3~8个智能体/层）配置，ReM-MoA的性能始终优于现有MoA变体（标准MoA、RMoA、AttentionMoA等），且性能差距随架构规模增大而非缩小；在MMLU-redux等基准上，标准MoA随深度增加出现的近10个百分点性能退化被缩小到可忽略范围。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1节的MoA缩放失败模式分析（含不同架构的深度/宽度缩放曲线）、第3节的核心机制设计，以及第4节的跨基准多配置实验结果；预计阅读时间25~35分钟，对多智能体评测感兴趣可查看附录的详细案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) architectures suffer from performance degradation, early plateauing, or saturation as stacking depth increases, failing to deliver sustained inference-time scaling gains due to cross-layer error accumulation, loss of high-quality reasoning trajectories, and collapse of in-layer exploration diversity.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies that the core bottleneck of MoA inference-time scaling is joint preservation of quality and diversity, rather than mere information aggregation or interaction. It provides methodological insights for inference-time scaling and multi-agent collaboration architecture design, and its memory-plus-routing idea also informs multi-path reasoning modeling in the pretraining stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ReM-MoA framework includes two core mechanisms: 1) Ranked Reasoning Memory: an independent Reviewer Agent performs comparative scoring on reasoning traces generated across all layers and provides targeted rationales; the ranked traces and rationales are persistently stored as cross-layer memory; 2) Curated Diversified Memory Routing: different agents within a layer are assigned distinct combinations of high-quality and low-quality reasoning traces as inputs, both delivering high-quality reasoning signals and preserving exploration diversity via differentiated inputs. An optional multi-domain Reviewer distillation pipeline uses frontier LLMs as teachers to produce a general-purpose Reviewer via LoRA fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 5 reasoning benchmarks covering math, formal logic, code, knowledge, and commonsense, across various depth (1-9 layers) and width (3-8 agents per layer) configurations, ReM-MoA consistently outperforms existing MoA variants (standard MoA, RMoA, AttentionMoA, etc.), with the performance gap widening rather than narrowing as architecture scale increases; on benchmarks including MMLU-redux, the nearly 10 percentage point performance degradation of standard MoA with increasing depth is reduced to a negligible range.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, prioritize the MoA scaling failure mode analysis in Section 1 (with depth/width scaling curves of different architectures), core mechanism design in Section 3, and cross-benchmark multi-configuration experimental results in Section 4; expected reading time is 25-35 minutes, and detailed case studies in the appendix are optional for readers interested in multi-agent evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 memory routing 和 depth ablation；若 token 预算未严格对齐，结论更像 MoA 工程经验而非 scaling law。
recommendation.en: Read the memory-routing and depth ablations; without strict token-budget control, this is MoA engineering evidence rather than a scaling law.

paper.title: Escaping the Self-Confirmation Trap: An Execute-Distill-Verify Paradigm for Agentic Experience Learning
paper.abstract: Experience-driven self-evolution is critical for large language model (LLM) agents to improve through open-world interaction. However, existing experience learning methods mostly rely on single-agent loops, where the same agent executes tasks, summarizes outcomes, and determines memory content. This setup makes agents vulnerable to the Self-Confirmation Trap: wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories are misidentified as successful experience, leading to cumulative errors during retrieval and reuse

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在经验学习中把错误但自洽的轨迹误记为成功经验的问题，避免错误记忆在后续检索和复用中累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 经验学习范式。它把单 agent 的执行、总结和记忆写入解耦为多 agent 执行、第三方蒸馏和群体验证，对 agent memory 的训练信号质量有参考意义，但离基座预训练仍有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EDV，即 Execute-Distill-Verify。Execute 阶段让多个异构 agent 并行探索同一任务空间，产生多样轨迹；Distill 阶段用独立第三方 agent 对比分析轨迹并生成候选经验，降低执行者自我总结偏差；Verify 阶段由执行组通过共识机制验证候选经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务集、模型规模、基线和数值结果；只能确认论文关注 open-world interaction 下的 agentic experience learning，并把对比目标指向单 agent 经验学习循环。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the failure mode where LLM agents store wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories as successful experience, causing errors to accumulate during later retrieval and reuse.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a general agent experience-learning framework. It separates execution, summarization, and memory validation across multiple agents, which is relevant to training-signal quality for agent memory, but it is still indirect for foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EDV has three stages. Execute uses multiple heterogeneous agents to explore the same task space and generate diverse trajectories.
