Distill uses a third-party agent to compare trajectories and form candidate experiences, reducing executor-centric bias. Verify asks the execution group to validate candidates through consensus.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete tasks, model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results. It positions the comparison mainly against single-agent experience-learning loops in open-world interaction settings.

recommendation.zh: 看框架图和验证协议即可；真正有用的是把 memory 写入当成有噪声训练标签处理。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework and verification protocol; the useful idea is treating memory writes as noisy training labels rather than trusted summaries.

paper.title: Agentic Collaborative Cognition for Zero-Shot 3D Understanding
paper.abstract: Recent advancements have explored agentic zero-shot 3D understanding by reformulating it as video keyframe understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, existing methods face an intrinsic bottleneck due to the finite observation perspectives inherent in videos and the implicit perception of 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework that assigns a Planning Agent to handle high-level viewpoint planning and supplement novel perspectives, and

summary.core_problem: 现有基于MLLM的零样本3D理解方法受限于视频观测视角有限、3D场景感知隐式的瓶颈，无法全面理解3D场景。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出协作式多智能体框架，通过规划智能体补全视角、感知智能体构建结构化认知图，实现零样本3D理解。
summary.technical_approach: 采用双智能体分工机制：1. 规划智能体分析当前认知图，确定查询相关视角并补全缺失关键视角；2. 感知智能体为不同视角的对象分配一致实例ID，整合碎片化观测到全局认知图。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据与基线对比数值，仅说明框架解决了视角有限与感知隐式的核心问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM-based zero-shot 3D understanding methods are bottlenecked by limited video observation perspectives and implicit 3D scene perception, preventing comprehensive 3D scene understanding.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a collaborative multi-agent framework with a planning agent for view supplementation and a perception agent for structured cognitive map construction, enabling zero-shot 3D understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-agent labor division: 1. Planning agent analyzes current cognitive map to identify query-relevant views and fill missing critical perspectives; 2. Perception agent assigns consistent instance IDs to objects across views, integrating fragmented observations into a global cognitive map.
summary_en.experiments: Exact model size, training data, and baseline comparison metrics not disclosed in abstract; framework is claimed to resolve limited view and implicit perception issues.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体分工的思路可做弱参考，但属于3D领域特定应用，无通用预训练相关insight，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The multi-agent labor division idea is a weak reference, but it is a 3D-specific application with no general pretrain insights; read abstract only.

paper.title: Post-Training Recipe, More Than Model Family, Shapes Multi-Agent LLM Conversational Behavior
paper.abstract: Multi-LLM systems use multiple language models to deliberate, judge each other's outputs, or coordinate as agents. Their value depends on the models producing measurably different conversational behaviors when given the same input. Prior offline studies recommend drawing one model per family for behavioral diversity, because LLMs prefer outputs from their own family when rating one another in isolation. Whether the same family label predicts behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, the setting

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在真实的多 LLM 交互里，模型“家族”是否仍然能预测行为差异，还是 post-training recipe 和运行配置才是更强的解释变量。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 post-train 与多模型系统设计有启发。它提醒读者不要把 family label 当成模型行为的稳定代理变量。同一个 base model 经过不同指令微调、推理蒸馏或 runtime 开关后，在交互中的话语风格可能比跨家族差异还大。这对构造 judge panel、debate system、multi-agent workflow 时的模型选择有实际意义，也间接说明 post-training 会显著改写模型的可观测行为分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造两轮论坛式交互链：给定同一 seed post，模型 A 先回复，模型 B 再基于 seed 和 A 的回复生成第二轮回复。作者用同一批 10,000 个 Moltbook 论坛 seed 复用到不同有序模型对上，便于做 paired statistics。行为指标来自 conversation analysis，主要看三类表面会话动作：challenge、repair、hedging。其中 hedging 与 LLM-judge 标注一致性最好，因此作为主指标。核心设计不是训练新模型，而是把模型差异拆成 family、参数规模、base architecture、post-training recipe、runtime configuration 几个轴，再比较哪个轴最能解释交互行为变化。最关键的是 same-base Llama-3.1-8B factorial：固定 base，改变 post-training recipe，用来隔离 post-training 的影响。
summary.experiments: 主实验包含 940,000 条两模型交互链，覆盖 4 个模型家族、11 个 open-weight checkpoint；另有 1.6M 条 same-base Llama factorial 链用于隔离 post-training recipe。生成设置包括 temperature 0.7、max tokens 300、使用原生 chat template，默认无 system prompt。canonical-4 子集选取 Qwen 2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Chat 做较可比的跨家族分析。关键结果是：在同一 Llama-3.1-8B base 上，reasoning-distilled responder 的 hedging 会因同家族、不同 recipe 的首轮回复者而变化 18.22%。这个差距超过 canonical-4 中任意两个不同家族模型之间测到的最大 hedging gap。作者还做了 Qwen、closed-API、runtime-control 等支持性分析，但这些部分样本更小或检测器更弱，因此证据权重低于 same-base Llama 实验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 RQ 设定和主结论边界，再看 Methods 里 chain/cell 的构造、hedging detector 的验证方式、same-base factorial 的设计。结果部分优先看 family vs post-training recipe 的对比图表，以及 18.22% hedging shift 的统计检验。无需深读 challenge 和 repair 结果，它们更像表面 cue 的补充检查。需要注意局限：实验是两 agent、短交互、论坛回复场景，不能直接推出长程 deliberation 或 judge accuracy 会随 conversational diversity 改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether model family is a reliable predictor of behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, or whether finer factors such as post-training recipe and runtime configuration explain more of the observed conversational variation.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding the behavioral impact of post-training. It shows that provider or family labels can be a weak proxy once models interact with each other. A shared base model with different post-training recipes can produce larger conversational differences than models drawn from different families. This matters for LLM judge panels, debate systems, and multi-agent workflows, where diversity is often approximated by picking one checkpoint per family.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study builds two-turn forum-style chains. A seed post is followed by a first reply from model A, then a second reply from model B conditioned on both the seed and A’s reply. The same 10,000 Moltbook forum seeds are reused across cells, enabling paired comparisons at the seed level. Each reply is scored for three conversational moves: challenge, repair, and hedging. Hedging is used as the headline metric because it has the strongest agreement with an LLM-judge annotator. The main methodological contribution is the factorization of model identity into family, scale, base architecture, post-training recipe, and runtime configuration. The cleanest test is a same-base Llama-3.1-8B factorial, where the base model is fixed and only the post-training recipe varies.
summary_en.experiments: The main corpus contains 940,000 two-agent chains over 11 open-weight checkpoints from four families: Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek. A separate 1.6M-chain same-base Llama factorial isolates post-training effects. Generation uses temperature 0.7, a 300-token cap, native chat templates, and no system prompt by default. A canonical-4 subset compares one roughly 7B-class instruction-tuned model per family: Qwen 2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, and DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Chat. The key number is a 18.22% hedging shift for a reasoning-distilled Llama responder depending on which same-family recipe replies first. This exceeds the largest cross-family hedging gap measured in the canonical-4 comparison. Qwen, closed-API, and runtime-control analyses broaden the observation, but the paper treats them as supporting checks rather than the strongest evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the research questions, the chain/cell construction, the validation of the hedging detector, and the same-base Llama factorial design. The most important result is the comparison between family-level gaps and post-training-recipe gaps, especially the 18.22% hedging shift. The challenge and repair metrics are less central and can be read as surface-cue checks. Keep the scope limitation in mind: the experiments use short two-agent exchanges and do not show that greater conversational diversity improves long-horizon deliberation or downstream judging quality.

recommendation.zh: 它会修正“跨 family 才有多样性”的经验法；同底座 factorial 设计值得复现到内部模型池。
recommendation.en: This weakens the “use different families for diversity” heuristic; the same-base factorial design is worth replicating on an internal model pool.

paper.title: Hypothesis-Disciplined Multi-Agent Automated Formalization of Asymptotic Statistical Theory
paper.abstract: Asymptotic statistical theory is a challenging domain for AI-assisted formalization: its central results mix convergence statements, asymptotic expansions, functional analysis, and regularity conditions that have a large gap from existing infrastructure in Lean 4 formalization. To address these challenges, we propose a hypothesis-disciplined Lean 4 formalization pipeline built from multiple agents: a manager that coordinates seven specialist roles for proof planning, skeleton scaffolding, Mathli

summary.core_problem: 渐近统计理论的形式化与现有Lean4基础设施差距大，现有多Agent形式化流程存在假设随意强化、缺乏源文本锚定的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出假设约束的多Agent形式化流水线，首次系统实现渐近统计理论的Lean4形式化
summary.technical_approach: 设计7种专业角色的多Agent协作流程，核心是审计Agent的假设约束机制：所有主定理假设必须锚定原始数学文本、证明为编码适配器、标记为源文本隐含或判定为无效强化
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露具体量化指标，仅提及通过该流水线实现了渐近统计理论核心结果的系统Lean4形式化

summary_en.core_problem: Asymptotic statistical theory formalization has a large gap with existing Lean4 infrastructure, and existing multi-agent formalization pipelines suffer from unanchored, arbitrarily strengthened theorem hypotheses
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a hypothesis-disciplined multi-agent formalization pipeline, achieves the first systematic Lean4 formalization of asymptotic statistical theory
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a 7-role specialist multi-agent collaboration pipeline, with a core hypothesis-disciplined audit mechanism: all main theorem hypotheses must be anchored to source math prose, justified as encoding adapters, marked as source-implied, or rejected as unsupported strengthening
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not fully disclose quantitative metrics; only notes the pipeline enables systematic formalization of core asymptotic statistical theory results in Lean4

recommendation.zh: 多Agent定理证明的假设审计机制有一定参考性，与预训练核心问题无关，仅作为Agent推理方向的文献备查
recommendation.en: Hypothesis auditing mechanism for multi-agent theorem proving has limited reference value, unrelated to core pretraining, only for agent reasoning literature reference

paper.title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document. Compared with function-level code generation, this task demands longer planning horizons, stable interfaces across files, and iterative debugging of cross-file inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose CodeTeam, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that separates planning, decision making, and implementation into distinct, co

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言到完整软件仓库生成（NL2Repo）中长程规划、跨文件接口一致性与迭代调试的核心挑战
summary.importance: 代码Agent架构创新，提出多角色分离的多Agent协作框架，为仓库级代码生成提供新范式
summary.technical_approach: CodeTeam框架分三阶段：多Architect agent生成竞争的软件设计草图，CTO agent筛选并规范化为可机器检查的接口契约，Developer agent按依赖调度生成代码，配合轻量Git协作机制
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体使用的LLM模型、测试数据集与基线效果对比的量化结果

summary_en.core_problem: Address core challenges of long-horizon planning, cross-file interface consistency and iterative debugging in NL2Repo (natural language to full software repository generation)
summary_en.importance: Coding agent architecture innovation, proposes a role-separated multi-agent collaboration framework as a new paradigm for repository-level code generation
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeTeam has three stages: multiple Architect agents draft competing software design sketches, CTO agent selects and normalizes them into machine-checkable interface contracts, Developer agents generate code under dependency-aware scheduler with lightweight Git coordination
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM models, test datasets or quantitative baseline comparison results disclosed in abstract

recommendation.zh: 仓库级代码生成的多Agent角色划分有参考价值，仅看框架图Fig1和§3的流程设计即可
recommendation.en: Role-separated multi-agent design for repo-level code generation is reference-worthy; only check Fig 1 and §3 pipeline design.

paper.title: Specialize Roles, Mix Deployments: Pushing the Cost-Accuracy Frontier of LLM Agent Teams
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as multi-role teams, where tasks are divided across specialized roles such as planner, executor, and verifier. In these systems, cost and accuracy are no longer properties of a single model: they depend on which model fills each role and where it is hosted, including API, self-hosted, and hybrid deployment. Existing agentic benchmarks typically evaluate fixed models or fixed agent configurations, and therefore offer limited guidance for cost-accuracy-optimal

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是多角色 LLM agent team 的评测与部署选择问题：在 planner、executor、verifier 等角色被不同模型承担时，准确率和成本不再属于单个模型，而属于角色分配、部署方式和任务域的组合。现有固定模型或固定 agent 配置的 benchmark 很难回答哪个模型该放在哪个角色、用 API 还是自托管。
summary.importance: 这篇是 agent 评测与部署 benchmark，和预训练关系较远，但对 post-train 后的模型能力分析有参考价值。它把 agent 系统的成本-准确率问题拆成角色级贡献，有助于判断模型能力瓶颈来自规划、执行还是验证。对基座研究的间接价值在于：同一个模型在不同 agent role 中的边际收益不同，这比单一任务分数更接近实际使用中的能力画像。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AgentCARD，围绕 Cost、Accuracy、Role assignment、Deployment mode 做 role-aware evaluation。它不是新增一个静态任务集，而是把已有 agentic benchmarks 改造成角色分解评测。系统包含四部分：planner-executor 或 planner-verifier-executor 的评测 harness；统一 API、自托管、混合部署的 per-task cost model；基于 Pareto frontier 的成本-准确率分析；基于 Shapley value 的 role-criticality diagnostic，用来估计哪个角色是瓶颈，从而减少模型组合搜索。这个设计的关键区别在于，它评估的是 team configuration，而不是单模型能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五类已有任务域：开放域工具使用、金融、医学推理、代码和数学。论文评估四个 API 模型之间的 16 种 planner-executor 分配，并加入自托管与混合部署配置。主要结果包括：异构 team 在合适角色分配下准确率最高可提升 44%；同一对模型反向分配可能降低 36%；Pareto frontier 经常由异构 team 占据；合适的异构配置可以用 1.4x 到 12x 更低的 per-task cost 匹配最强同构 team；planner 与 executor 的能力回报在不同领域最多相差 40%；三角色 plan-verify-execute pilot 在相近成本下比最强两角色 baseline 高 9.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–25 分钟。重点看 benchmark 设计、cost model、Pareto frontier 分析和 Shapley role-criticality diagnostic。实验表格里应优先看角色互换导致的性能变化，以及不同 domain 中 planner/executor 哪个更关键。对预训练研究员，主要价值不是 agent 框架本身，而是它提供了一种更细粒度的能力诊断方式：模型的规划、执行、验证能力可能不能用一个总分概括。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation and deployment selection for multi-role LLM agent teams. Once roles such as planner, executor, and verifier are assigned to different models, accuracy and cost are no longer properties of a single model; they depend on the role assignment, deployment mode, and task domain. Standard fixed-model or fixed-agent benchmarks do not answer which model should fill which role under a given cost budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation and deployment benchmark, not a pretraining paper. Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic: it separates model capability by role and shows that the same model can have different marginal value as a planner, executor, or verifier. That is a more deployment-relevant capability profile than a single aggregate benchmark score, and it can inform post-training evaluation and model selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgentCARD, a role-aware benchmark framework covering Cost, Accuracy, Role assignment, and Deployment mode. Rather than creating a new static task suite, it converts existing agentic benchmarks into role-decomposed evaluations. The framework includes a planner-executor and planner-verifier-executor harness, a unified per-task cost model for API, self-hosted, and hybrid serving, Pareto-frontier analysis for cost-accuracy tradeoffs, and a Shapley-based role-criticality diagnostic to identify the bottleneck role. The key design choice is to evaluate team configurations rather than individual models.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans five domains: open-domain tool use, finance, medical reasoning, coding, and mathematics. It tests all 16 planner-executor assignments among four API models, along with self-hosted and hybrid variants. The main findings are that heterogeneous teams can improve accuracy by up to 44% when models are assigned to suitable roles, while reversing the same pair can reduce accuracy by 36%. Heterogeneous teams often occupy the Pareto frontier and can match the strongest homogeneous team at 1.4x to 12x lower per-task cost. Planner and executor upgrade returns differ by up to 40% across domains. A three-role plan-verify-execute pilot adds up to 9.4% accuracy over the strongest two-agent baseline at comparable cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction, cost model, Pareto analysis, and the Shapley role-criticality diagnostic. In the results, prioritize the role-swap comparisons and the domain-specific planner-versus-executor bottleneck analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the useful point is not the agent framework itself, but the finer capability decomposition: planning, execution, and verification may need separate measurement rather than a single aggregate score.

recommendation.zh: 关注点在异构 agent team 的算力/成本分配而非建模范式，Shapley 瓶颈诊断和 Pareto 图值得 serving/agent 团队看图即可。
recommendation.en: The value is in heterogeneous agent-team cost allocation rather than modeling; read the Shapley bottleneck diagnostic and Pareto plots if you work on agent serving.

paper.title: Hidden Anchors in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM deliberation, where agents exchange and revise answers over several rounds, is increasingly used to improve reasoning and accuracy, yet how and why it works is rarely modelled. Such deliberation mirrors how humans reach decisions. As social animals we are pulled both by the group, the herd effect that classical opinion-dynamics models such as DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen capture, and by our own internal belief, which they do not. We model multi-agent deliberation as a closed-loo

summary.core_problem: 解释多Agent LLM协商中为何会出现超出初始意见凸包的信心提升，以及经典共识模型为何解释不了这种现象。
summary.importance: 这是对多Agent deliberation机制的分析工作，不是新agent框架。价值在于给出一个可检验的动力系统视角，帮助理解协商增益来自哪里。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把每个agent建模为同时受邻居意见和自身隐藏内部信念anchor牵引的闭环动力系统；并声称可仅从协商轨迹中恢复该anchor，再用它预测held-out deliberation行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和规模。核心实验应是：从协商日志恢复anchor，验证其对未见运行的泛化预测能力，并展示正确答案信心可超过所有初始值。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to explain why multi-agent LLM deliberation can increase confidence beyond the convex hull of initial opinions, something classical consensus models cannot capture.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism paper rather than a new agent system. Its value lies in offering a testable dynamical-systems account of where deliberation gains may come from.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each agent is modeled as being pulled by both neighbors and a hidden internal belief, an anchor. The paper claims this anchor can be recovered from deliberation traces alone and used to predict held-out runs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify models or datasets. The key evidence appears to be anchor recovery from deliberation logs, held-out prediction, and demonstrations of confidence moving beyond all initial beliefs.

recommendation.zh: 不是做法论文，而是给多agent协商补了个可检验机制；若你关心deliberation为何偶尔真有增益，可只看模型假设和held-out预测部分。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper but a mechanistic patch for multi-agent deliberation; read the model assumptions and held-out prediction test if you care why deliberation sometimes truly helps.

paper.title: AutoPass: Evidence-Guided LLM Agents for Compiler Performance Tuning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code compilation tasks, but applying them to runtime performance tuning is difficult due to complex microarchitectural effects and noisy runtime measurements. We present AutoPass, a multi-agent framework for compiler performance tuning that uses compiler and runtime evidence to guide LLM-generated optimization decisions. Rather than treating the compiler as a black box like prior auto-tuning schemes, AutoPass opens up the compiler to the LLM, enablin

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 用于编译器性能调优时难以处理微架构效应、运行时噪声和编译器内部状态不可见的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / compiler agent 方法创新。它不推进基座预训练，但提供了一个较干净的 tool-use 场景：LLM 不只生成代码或参数，而是读取编译器内部证据并闭环修正。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoPass，多 Agent 框架在无需训练和无需微调的 inference-only 设置下运行。系统允许 LLM 查询编译器内部优化状态、分析中间表示，并结合实际运行时测量，迭代诊断性能回退和调整编译选项。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整平台、benchmark 和提升幅度。可确认的是它以运行时延迟为反馈，和把编译器当黑盒的自动调优方案形成对比，并强调可迁移到新 benchmark 和硬件平台。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of using LLMs for compiler performance tuning under complex microarchitectural effects, noisy runtime measurements, and hidden compiler-internal states.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent method for compiler optimization. It does not advance foundation pretraining, but it offers a relatively clean tool-use setting where the LLM reads compiler evidence rather than merely emitting code or flags.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoPass is an inference-only, training-free multi-agent framework. It lets LLMs query compiler-internal optimization states, inspect intermediate representations, and use measured runtime feedback to diagnose regressions and iteratively refine optimization configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full platform details, benchmarks, or exact gains. It states that AutoPass is evaluated through runtime feedback and contrasted with black-box auto-tuning schemes, with emphasis on portability to new benchmarks and platforms.

recommendation.zh: 看系统接口设计即可；把编译器状态暴露给 LLM 比纯 prompt 搜索更靠谱，但这是工具闭环，不是训练范式。
recommendation.en: Read the system-interface design only; exposing compiler state to the LLM is cleaner than prompt-only search, but this is a tool loop, not a training paradigm.

paper.title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Bias Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
paper.abstract: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their systematic evaluation biases propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator biases spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator bias profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-based), we measure the Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3 and find that evaluator biases consistent

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多 Agent 系统中充当 evaluator 时，自身评价偏差会如何沿 Agent 交互网络传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评估可靠性分析与形式化建模。它把“LLM-as-judge 的偏差”从单点误差扩展到网络传播问题，对多 Agent 评审、辩论、委员会式决策有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contagion Networks，用跨 Agent 传染矩阵 Gamma_3 度量评价偏差传播强度，并用谱半径 rho(Gamma_N) 划分传播、临界、抑制三类 regime。方法偏分析框架，不是新的 Agent 训练或推理架构。
summary.experiments: 在受控 3-Agent 设置中使用 DeepSeek-chat，构造 structured、balanced、evidence-based 三类 evaluator bias profile。测得同模型 Agent 间 contagion coefficient 为 0.157 到 0.352；相比 prior work MM-EPC 中跨模型约 0.85 到 1.3 的系数弱 3-5 倍。将 evaluator committee size 从 k=1 增至 k=3 后，有效传染下降 72.4%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how systematic LLM evaluator biases propagate through interacting agents in multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an analysis framework for evaluator reliability in agent networks. It moves LLM-as-judge bias from a single-node issue to a network-level propagation problem, which is relevant for debate, committee evaluation, and multi-agent review pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Contagion Networks and a cross-agent contagion matrix Gamma_3 to quantify bias transfer. The spectral radius rho(Gamma_N) is used to define propagation regimes. The work is primarily a diagnostic and formalization effort rather than a new agent training method.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled experiment uses three DeepSeek-chat agents with structured, balanced, and evidence-based evaluator bias profiles. Same-model agents show contagion coefficients between 0.157 and 0.352, about 3-5x weaker than the cross-model coefficients around 0.85-1.3 reported in MM-EPC. Increasing the evaluator committee from k=1 to k=3 reduces effective contagion by 72.4%.

recommendation.zh: 可看 abstract 和实验表；小规模 setup 偏窄，但“同模型偏差传播弱于跨模型”这个信号值得记下。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and experiment table only; the setup is small, but the weaker same-model contagion signal is worth remembering.

paper.title: SIGMA: Skill-Incidence Graphs for Compositional Multi-Agent Design
paper.abstract: Existing graph-based multi-agent system (MAS) designers mainly improve collaboration by optimizing communication topologies over predefined agents, roles, or groups. However, because each node remains a closed-set entity, these methods struggle to generalize to tasks that require unseen combinations of capabilities. We propose SIGMA, a skill-incidence graph framework that constructs agents as task-conditioned bundles of reusable skills. Given a task and a skill library, SIGMA predicts a skill-ag

summary.core_problem: 现有基于图的多智能体设计方法依赖预定义的智能体/角色/分组，难以泛化到需要未见能力组合的任务。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出将智能体建模为可复用技能组合的图框架，而非固定节点，提升多智能体协作的组合泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SIGMA技能关联图框架：给定任务与技能库，预测技能-智能体关联矩阵，从选中技能组合构造智能体节点嵌入，再解码通信拓扑；执行阶段通过技能专属邮箱按关联结构路由消息。
summary.experiments: 在6个推理与代码基准上测试3种基座LLM，平均性能最优，相对最强非组合拓扑基线CARD分别提升2.06、2.36及未显示完整数值的幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing graph-based multi-agent designers rely on predefined agents, roles, or groups, failing to generalize to tasks requiring unseen capability combinations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: models agents as composable bundles of reusable skills instead of fixed nodes, improving compositional generalization in multi-agent collaboration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SIGMA, a skill-incidence graph framework: given a task and skill library, it predicts a skill-agent incidence matrix, composes agent node embeddings from selected skills, and decodes a communication topology; skill-specific mailboxes route messages during execution.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 6 reasoning and coding benchmarks with 3 base LLMs, achieving best average performance and outperforming the strongest non-compositional baseline CARD by 2.06, 2.36, and additional unreported margins.

recommendation.zh: 技能组合式多智能体构造思路有新意，但属于多智能体协作的增量改进，与预训练核心问题距离较远，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: The compositional skill-based agent construction idea is novel, but it is an incremental multi-agent advance distant from core pretraining problems; keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: Phoenix: Safe GitHub Issue Resolution via Multi-Agent LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Phoenix, a multi-agent LLM system that resolves GitHub issues from triage through pull-request creation, combining seven layered safety controls with a baseline-aware test evaluation strategy. Phoenix decomposes the work across six specialized agents. Planner, reproducer, coder, tester, failure analyst and Pull Request (PR) agent, all coordinated by a label-based GitHub webhook state machine. Every change is checked against a baseline test run before a pull request is opened. On a 24-

summary.core_problem: 现有GitHub问题自动解决系统缺乏安全控制，易引入代码回归，需端到端安全的多Agent解决方案。
summary.importance: 工程系统类贡献，提出7层安全控制+基线感知测试策略，保障代码修改的正确性无回归。
summary.technical_approach: 拆分6个专用Agent（规划/复现/编码/测试/故障分析/PR），由基于GitHub webhook的标签状态机协调，每步变更与基线测试结果比对后才提交PR。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Lite的24条curated切片上oracle解决率75%，成功运行无pass-to-pass回归（作者明确说明该切片不可直接与全榜单对比）；42个真实仓库问题上100%正确性保留。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated GitHub issue resolution systems lack safety controls and easily introduce code regressions, requiring an end-to-end secure multi-agent solution.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution, proposes 7-layer safety controls and a baseline-aware test evaluation strategy to ensure zero regression in code modifications.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes work into 6 specialized agents (planner/reproducer/coder/tester/failure analyst/PR agent) coordinated by a label-based GitHub webhook state machine; all changes are checked against baseline test runs before PR creation.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 75% oracle resolution rate on a 24-instance curated SWE-bench Lite slice with no pass-to-pass regressions (authors explicitly state the slice is not comparable to full leaderboard); 100% correctness preservation on 42 real repository issues.

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent的工程实现参考，7层安全控制模块设计有少量借鉴价值，看§3的安全机制部分即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering reference for coding agents, minor value in the 7-layer safety control design; read §3 safety mechanism section only.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
paper.abstract: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of ag

summary.core_problem: 分散部署的多Agent群体中，每个Agent产生的轨迹（procedural knowledge）通常用完即丢，新Agent反复重解已有问题，缺乏群体级记忆共享基础设施。
summary.importance: 把RAG从'Agent检索人类产出物'扩展到'Agent群体共享自身产出轨迹'的transactive memory框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MATM（Multi-Agent Transactive Memory）：producer Agent将解决任务的轨迹写入群体级存储，后续Agent通过检索这些Agent生成的轨迹复用程序性知识，而不是只依赖人类文档或重新探索。
summary.experiments: 论文为框架性提案，摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据或定量SOTA结果。

summary_en.core_problem: In decentralized multi-agent populations, agent trajectories encoding reusable procedural knowledge are typically discarded after single use, forcing new agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions.
summary_en.importance: Extends RAG-style retrieval of human-authored artifacts to population-level storage and reuse of agent-generated trajectories via a transactive memory framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MATM (Multi-Agent Transactive Memory), where producer agents contribute their trajectories to a population-level memory, and downstream agents retrieve and reuse this agent-generated procedural knowledge instead of relying only on human-authored documents or rediscovering solutions.
summary_en.experiments: A framework proposal; the abstract does not report concrete model scales, datasets, or quantitative SOTA results.

recommendation.zh: 把'Agent轨迹当语料'做群体级记忆是个干净的想法，对长期运行Agent系统的数据回流有启发，但当前是框架论文无硬结果，知道即可。
recommendation.en: A clean framing of treating agent trajectories as first-class retrievable artifacts for population memory; conceptually relevant to data flywheels, but framework-only with no hard results—know the idea, skip the details.

paper.title: Characterizing Opinion Evolution of Networked LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with one another in multi-agent systems, from simulations of human discourse to influence operations and fully LLM-driven social platforms. These interactions give rise to new regimes of opinion propagation that are not yet well understood. We investigate whether classical opinion dynamics models, which have long been used to explain how interactions shape collective beliefs in human societies, can capture the behavior of LLM networks. We find t

summary.core_problem: 研究多个 LLM 在网络中交互时，群体意见如何演化，以及经典人类社会意见动力学模型是否能解释这种行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把 LLM multi-agent 系统中的意见传播问题形式化为可拟合的动力学模型，对理解 LLM 代理社会、模拟舆论、影响操作和多代理平台的稳定性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较了朴素平均式意见动力学模型与加入 bias 项的改进模型。bias 表示每个 LLM agent 会回归到某种内生意见倾向，而不是只被邻居观点平均牵引。核心观察是：LLM 的意见更新不能简单看成 DeGroot 式邻居平均，模型自身的偏置需要显式建模。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖不同模型家族、讨论主题和网络结构。摘要报告称，加入 bias 后，累计估计平均意见误差最高降低 88%。未从摘要中看到具体模型列表、网络规模、提示协议和统计显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: Ufuk Topcu 是德州大学奥斯汀分校教授，长期研究控制、形式化方法、多智能体系统与 AI 安全相关问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how opinions evolve when LLM agents interact over a network, and whether classical opinion dynamics models can capture that behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis contribution. It frames opinion propagation in LLM multi-agent systems as a dynamical modeling problem, which is relevant to LLM societies, influence operations, and stability analysis of agent platforms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare naive averaging-style opinion dynamics against modified models with an explicit bias term. The bias represents an innate opinion that an LLM agent tends to regress toward, rather than being driven only by neighboring agents. The key modeling point is that LLM opinion updates are not well described by simple DeGroot-style averaging.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span model families, discussion topics, and network structures. The abstract reports up to an 88% reduction in cumulative estimated mean opinion error after adding bias. The abstract does not expose the full model list, network sizes, prompting protocol, or significance tests.
summary_en.authors_note: Ufuk Topcu is a professor at the University of Texas at Austin, known for work on control, formal methods, multi-agent systems, and AI safety.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 LLM-agent 群体动力学的弱信号；只读实验设定和 bias 项定义，别把 88% 当通用规律。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a weak signal on LLM-agent collective dynamics; read the setup and the bias term, not the 88% number as a universal law.

paper.title: SAGE: Stochastic Prompt Optimization via Agent-Guided Exploration
paper.abstract: Context engineering has emerged as a primary lever for improving AI systems without parameter updates. Recent work showing that textual gradients do not function as real gradients motivates treating automatic prompt optimization (APO) as black-box search. We introduce SPO (Stochastic Prompt Optimization), a framework for stochastic search over prompt space, and compare three strategies of increasing sophistication: error-informed random search, a genetic algorithm with evolutionary operators, an

summary.core_problem: 解决无需参数更新时，如何把自动提示优化从不可靠的“文本梯度”转成更稳健的黑盒搜索问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇面向 agent 化 prompt optimization 的方法论文，贡献不在基座训练本身，而在于把 prompt search 明确建模为随机搜索，并比较不同搜索策略在不同误差地形下的适用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPO（Stochastic Prompt Optimization）框架，包含三类策略：基于错误信息的随机搜索、带进化算子的遗传算法，以及 SAGE——一个带多 agent 诊断和代码执行的探索流水线。核心思想是让系统先诊断失败类型，再据此生成候选 prompt，并通过连续 A/B 测试迭代更新。
summary.experiments: 在三个 benchmark 上比较三种搜索策略，结论是否定单一最优法：不同任务的 prompt landscape 与错误类型决定哪种策略更有效。另在心理健康聊天机器人上做连续优化，累计 8 轮带噪 A/B 测试后提升次日留存。摘要未给出模型规模、统一基座或大规模训练设置，因此对 pretrain 的直接外推有限。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to turn automatic prompt optimization, where textual gradients are unreliable, into a more robust black-box search problem without updating model parameters.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-style prompt optimization paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper. Its value lies in reframing prompt search as stochastic search and showing that different search strategies fit different error landscapes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SPO (Stochastic Prompt Optimization) with three strategies: error-informed random search, a genetic algorithm with evolutionary operators, and SAGE, a multi-agent exploration pipeline with diagnostic code execution. The key idea is to diagnose failure modes first, then generate and test prompt edits under a continuous optimization loop.
summary_en.experiments: The authors compare the three strategies on three benchmarks and find that no single method dominates; effectiveness depends on task landscape and error type. They also deploy SAGE on a mental-health chatbot and report statistically robust gains in next-day retention over eight noisy A/B cycles. The abstract does not provide model scale or training-scale evidence, so the direct relevance to pretraining is limited.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，更多是 context engineering；若你关心 test-time search，可只看“无单一最优策略”这个结论，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is mostly context engineering, not pretraining; if you care about test-time search, the only takeaway is that no single prompt-search strategy dominates.

paper.title: Enhancing Decision-Making with Large Language Models through Multi-Agent Fictitious Play
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated great potential in solving tasks with execution complexity, by distributing subtasks across cooperative agents. However, this divide-and-conquer paradigm falls short on decision-making tasks that are also prevalent in the real world. These tasks require simultaneous reasoning from the stances of all involved stakeholders whose decisions are mutually dependent and thus cannot be solved in isolation. We characterize this

summary.core_problem: 解决多智能体系统在多方利益相关、决策相互依赖的任务中，传统分工协作范式难以处理“立场纠缠”的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 agent 方法而非基座预训练。新意在于把 game-theoretic fictitious play 引入 LLM 多智能体决策，用于建模相互依赖的 stakeholder stance。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-Agent Fictitious Play（MAFP）：把不同利益相关方的立场表示为不同 agent，每轮让每个 agent 对其他 agent 历史决策的经验混合分布做 best response，迭代逼近某种均衡式决策，而不是简单并行分解子任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调该方法适用于 decision-making 而非 execution complexity 任务，但未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 和量化结果。当前信息不足以判断结论强度。
summary.authors_note: 作者中 Tat-Seng Chua 来自新加坡国立大学，长期从事信息检索、多模态与智能体相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of standard multi-agent LLM systems on decision-making tasks where stakeholders' choices are mutually dependent, creating what the authors call stance entanglement.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-method paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining contribution. Its novelty is importing game-theoretic fictitious play into LLM multi-agent decision-making to model interdependent stakeholder stances.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Multi-Agent Fictitious Play (MAFP): different stakeholder stances are represented as agents, and each agent iteratively best-responds to the empirical mixture of other agents' past decisions, aiming for an equilibrium-like decision process instead of simple task decomposition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for decision-making rather than execution-complexity tasks, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains. Based on the abstract alone, the strength of evidence is unclear.
summary_en.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua is from the National University of Singapore and is well known for work in information retrieval, multimodality, and agent-related systems.

recommendation.zh: 有一点方法味道，但离 pretrain 很远；如果你关心 multi-agent 决策，可只看 fictitious play 这个建模映射，实验强度先别太信。
recommendation.en: There is some real method here, but it is far from pretraining; if you care about multi-agent decision-making, just inspect the fictitious-play formulation and reserve judgment on the empirical strength.

paper.title: Skill-MAS: Evolving Meta-Skill for Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has become a crucial frontier for tackling complex tasks. However, existing methods face a dilemma between model capability and experience retention. Inference-time MAS leverages frozen frontier LLMs but repeats identical searches without learning from past experience. Conversely, Training-time MAS internalizes experience via gradient updates but is constrained by the low capability ceiling of smaller models, and is

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 自动多智能体系统生成中“前沿大模型能力强但不会积累经验”和“小模型可训练但能力上限低”之间的矛盾。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 方向而非预训练论文，但它讨论了如何在不更新大模型参数的情况下保留经验，对 post-train 与 inference-time adaptation 的接口有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Skill-MAS，把高层 orchestration 能力抽象成可进化的 Meta-Skill，而不是写回模型参数。系统通过闭环优化迭代：先做 Multi-Trajectory Rollout 采样行为分布，再用 Selective Reflection 选择优先任务进行反思与更新，从而持续改进多智能体架构知识。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体基座模型、任务集、基线或提升幅度。可推测实验会与 inference-time MAS 和 training-time MAS 两类方法比较，重点看经验保留、可扩展性和复杂任务完成率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the trade-off in automatic LLM-based multi-agent system generation: frontier models are strong but do not retain experience, while trainable smaller models retain experience but hit a capability ceiling.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is mildly relevant to the interface between post-training and inference-time adaptation because it externalizes experience without updating frontier model weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Skill-MAS, which treats high-level orchestration as an evolvable Meta-Skill instead of storing experience in model parameters. The system iterates through multi-trajectory rollout and selective reflection to refine architectural knowledge in a closed loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or gains. The likely comparison is against inference-time MAS and training-time MAS methods on complex task-solving benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“把经验放到可演化外部技能而非参数里”这个接口设计值得记一下；读方法图和 ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of storing experience in an evolvable external meta-skill rather than weights is worth noting; the method figure and ablations should suffice.

paper.title: On the Reliability of Networks of AI Agents: Density Evolution, Stopping Sets, and Architecture Optimization
paper.abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly solve a task not with a single model call but with several imperfect agents working together: some propose pieces of a solution, others verify them, and the results are combined. These systems often outperform any single model, yet it is rarely clear why they succeed or when they will fail. We model such a system as message passing on a sparse graph, the structure that underlies low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, and extend the density-evolution machinery of co

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图回答：由多个不完美 AI agent 组成的协作网络，为什么有时比单次模型调用更可靠，以及它会在什么结构条件下系统性失效。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在分析框架而不在模型能力本身。它把多 agent 系统抽象成稀疏因子图，并借用编码理论里的 density evolution 和 stopping sets 来刻画误差传播与失败模式，属于方法论上的机制分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把任务表示为一组耦合的二值子命题，把 agent 架构表示为带角色类型的稀疏 factor graph。proposal agent、verifier 和通信边都可能产生 erasure，消息以集合值形式在图上传播；随后将 LDPC 码分析中的 density evolution 扩展到含噪布尔校验节点的 setting，用来预测迭代推理的收敛与失败，并讨论架构优化。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验重点应是理论预测与仿真的一致性，以及不同图结构、校验函数和 erasure 机制下的可靠性边界，而不是大规模 LLM 训练或标准 agent benchmark 刷分。没有看到与主流 LLM agent 系统的大规模实证对比、模型参数量或预训练数据规模等信息，因此对基座预训练的直接证据较弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why networks of imperfect AI agents can be more reliable than a single model call, and under what structural conditions they fail systematically.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly analytical rather than capability-driven. It recasts multi-agent systems as sparse factor graphs and imports density evolution and stopping-set ideas from coding theory to characterize error propagation and failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tasks are modeled as coupled binary subclaims, and an agent architecture is represented as a role-typed sparse factor graph. Proposal agents, verifiers, and communication edges can all induce erasures, while set-valued messages are passed over the graph. The paper extends LDPC-style density evolution to noisy Boolean verifier nodes and uses it to study convergence, failure, and architecture optimization.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments are likely centered on agreement between theory and simulation, plus reliability boundaries under different graph structures, verifier functions, and erasure mechanisms, rather than large-scale LLM training or mainstream agent benchmarks. There is no clear evidence of large empirical studies on modern LLM agent stacks, model scales, or pretraining regimes, so the direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把多 agent 可靠性写成可分析的图模型这点有意思；只需看建模假设和 failure mode，别把结论外推到真实 LLM 系统。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the graph-theoretic treatment of multi-agent reliability is worth a glance; read the assumptions and failure modes, but do not overgeneralize to real LLM systems.

paper.title: State-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthetic Data Generation for Tool-Augmented LLMs
paper.abstract: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large corpora of multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data that is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production settings, and largely absent from public datasets. We present StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations by orchestrating a four-role LLM loop: a persona-conditioned user simulator, an agent under test, a state-grounded tool simulator, and a multi-axis LLM j

summary.core_problem: 训练工具增强 LLM agent 需要大量多轮、工具接地的对话数据，但标注昂贵、存在隐私限制且公开数据集稀缺。
summary.importance: 方法创新 + 系统创新：提出 StateGen 合成数据平台，通过四角色 LLM 循环（用户模拟器、被测 agent、状态接地工具模拟器、多轴 LLM 评审）自动生成带推理轨迹的高质量训练对话；核心创新是权威状态管理器消除工具调用幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 核心架构：权威状态管理器维护跨轮结构化 world-state 对象，强制后端即事实不变式；四角色 LLM 循环：人格条件用户模拟器 + 被测 agent + 状态接地工具模拟器 + 多轴 LLM 评审；天然支持多 agent 层级扩展（子 agent 声明为工具，共享单一状态对象）。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个生产语料上评估 64,698 轮对话；工具调用幻觉分数大幅降低；但未提供具体基线对比数值或 SOTA 结论（摘要中未详述）。
summary.authors_note: 未明确列出机构；从作者名看可能涉及业界研究团队，但无法确认具体知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data, which is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production, and largely absent from public datasets.
summary_en.importance: Methodological + system innovation: presents StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations via a four-role LLM loop; key innovation is the authoritative state manager that eliminates tool-call hallucinations by construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core architecture: an authoritative state manager maintains a structured world-state object across turns, enforcing a backend-is-truth invariant; four-role LLM loop: persona-conditioned user simulator + agent under test + state-grounded tool simulator + multi-axis LLM judge; naturally extends to hierarchical multi-agent settings by declaring sub-agents as tools sharing a single state object.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 64,698 conversations across three production corpora; tool-call hallucination scores substantially reduced; specific baseline comparison numbers or SOTA claims not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions not explicitly listed; likely involves industry research teams, but no well-known authors identifiable from given information

recommendation.zh: 状态管理器消除工具幻觉的设计思路对后训练数据合成有启发，特别是结构化 world-state 强制一致性；建议看 §3 的架构细节。
recommendation.en: The state-manager design eliminating tool hallucinations is instructive for post-training data synthesis, especially the structured world-state enforcing consistency; suggested to read §3 architecture details.

paper.title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
paper.abstract: GPU kernel optimization represents a paradigm where functional correctness is assumed and execution efficiency is the objective. We present daVinci-kernel, a reinforcement learning framework that couples skill discovery with skill exploitation through a dynamically evolving skill library. daVinci-kernel jointly trains three agents sharing one LLM backbone: a Skill Selection Agent that retrieves relevant techniques via BM25 and LLM reranking, a Policy Agent that generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton k

summary.core_problem: 解决GPU kernel优化中，现有LLM方法难以同时实现技能发现、复用与高效生成的问题
summary.importance: 属于系统方法创新，提出共享LLM backbone的三Agent RL框架，实现技能库的动态演化与复用，提升GPU kernel生成的效率与性能
summary.technical_approach: 提出daVinci-kernel框架，包含三个共享同一LLM backbone的Agent：1）技能选择Agent（BM25检索+LLM重排相关优化技巧）；2）策略Agent（基于选中技能生成多轮CUDA/Triton kernel）；3）技能总结Agent（将成功rollout蒸馏为可复用技能）；采用结构化SFT冷启动，后用多轮REINFORCE+ per-agent优势估计端到端联合训练，技能仅在执行验证有可复现加速时加入库
summary.experiments: 在KernelBench基准上测试，14B参数的daVinci-kernel-14B模型取得37.2%的加速提升（摘要未披露完整指标与基线细节）

summary_en.core_problem: Resolves the difficulty of existing LLM methods for GPU kernel optimization to simultaneously achieve skill discovery, reuse, and efficient generation
summary_en.importance: System and methodological innovation; proposes a three-agent RL framework with a shared LLM backbone, enabling dynamic evolution and reuse of a skill library to improve the efficiency and performance of GPU kernel generation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the daVinci-kernel framework with three agents sharing one LLM backbone: 1) Skill Selection Agent (BM25 retrieval + LLM reranking of optimization techniques), 2) Policy Agent (generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton kernels conditioned on selected skills), 3) Skill Summary Agent (distills successful rollouts into reusable skills); uses structured SFT for cold start, then jointly trains end-to-end via multi-turn REINFORCE with per-agent advantage estimation, adding skills to the library only after execution verification confirms reproducible speedups
summary_en.experiments: Tested on the KernelBench benchmark; the 14B-parameter daVinci-kernel-14B achieves 37.2% speedup (full metrics and baseline details not disclosed in abstract)

recommendation.zh: 代码Agent做GPU kernel优化的工程实现，对基座预训练无直接启发，仅作为多Agent协同设计案例备查
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of coding agent for GPU kernel optimization; no direct insight for foundation pretraining, keep as multi-agent collaboration reference only

paper.title: tap: A File-Based Protocol for Heterogeneous LLM Agent Collaboration
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent software development systems have proposed many forms of agent collaboration, including role-based collaboration and automated code review. However, many systems assume a common runtime, a central conversation server, or the same API family. Under these assumptions, LLM agents from different vendors cannot easily exchange messages directly from their own execution environments while dividing development and review work on a shared codebase. This paper presents tap, a file-ba

summary.core_problem: 不同厂商的代码 Agent 往往依赖不同运行时、API 和对话环境，难以在同一代码库上直接协作。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个轻量协作协议，而不是新模型。它关注异构 LLM Agent 的互操作性，对 coding agent 系统工程有参考价值，但对基座预训练没有直接方法增益。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 tap，一种 file-based collaboration protocol。核心是 file-first 设计：用带 metadata 的 markdown 文件保留原始消息；Tier 1 通过文件检查通信；Tier 2 使用 Claude 和 Codex 的实时通知路径；用独立 git worktree 隔离各 Agent 的工作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出系统性 benchmark、任务数量、成功率或和现有 multi-agent coding 系统的量化对比。主要展示 Claude 与 Codex 在无共享内存、无相同运行时条件下协作一个代码库的协议设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents from different vendors often cannot collaborate directly because existing systems assume a shared runtime, central conversation server, or common API family.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a lightweight interoperability protocol rather than a new model. It is relevant to coding-agent infrastructure, but only weakly informative for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces tap, a file-based collaboration protocol. It uses markdown files with metadata as durable message records, combines file inspection as Tier 1 communication with real-time notification paths as Tier 2, and isolates agent work through separate git worktrees.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report a systematic benchmark, task count, success rate, or quantitative comparison against other multi-agent coding systems. It focuses on demonstrating Claude-Codex collaboration without shared memory or identical runtime.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent 互操作的小协议，不是模型研究；做 coding-agent infra 可备查，预训练侧不必读正文。
recommendation.en: This is an interoperability protocol, not model research; keep it as a coding-agent infra reference, skip for pretraining.

paper.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
paper.abstract: AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assemb

summary.core_problem: 现有AI智能体的运行时harness（包括提示词、工具、记忆、控制流等介导模型观察、推理、行动的组件）均为手工定制的静态系统，存在三大核心问题：模型/工具/任务域变化时需重新定制，无经验驱动的改进机制；各组件架构耦合，修改易出错、复用依赖复制；harness工程与模型训练完全割裂，执行轨迹数据被丢弃，无法实现协同优化。
summary.importance: 明确了harness是智能体能力的一等决定因素，而非外围工程补丁，其优化增益常超过模型小版本迭代的收益。提出的harness-模型协同进化框架将harness优化产生的轨迹复用为RL训练信号，同时打破了单独harness优化的性能天花板与单独模型RL的训练信号天花板。对智能体后训练的数据流水线设计、闭环优化机制有明确参考价值，可组合harness的形式化方法也为智能体工程标准化提供了基础。
summary.technical_approach: HarnessX是统一的harness铸造框架，包含三大核心模块：1）可组合harness：将harness形式化为一等类型化对象，由覆盖上下文、工具、技能、控制、记忆的类型化原语（processor）通过替换代数在生命周期钩子点插入组合，九维分类法覆盖完整行为空间，实现类型安全的组件增删改与完全解耦。2）AEGIS自适应进化引擎：将harness适配建模为符号工件（提示词、工具、记忆、控制策略）上的学习问题，通过四阶段流水线（Digester压缩轨迹、Planner规划适配方案、Evolver生成候选、Critic评估）结合全轨迹可观测性，解决对应RL的奖励黑客、灾难性遗忘、探索不足等风险；可选变体隔离策略避免异构任务集上的跨任务干扰。3）harness-模型协同进化：通过共享回放缓冲区，交替进行harness进化与模型GRPO训练，让模型内化不同版本harness的策略，形成闭环优化。
summary.experiments: 在5个基准（GAIA、ALFWorld、WebShop、τ³-Bench、SWE-bench Verified）、3类任务智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5-9B）上开展最多15轮进化实验。15组模型-基准配置中14组获得提升，平均绝对增益为+14.5%，最高增益达+44.0%（ALFWorld上的Qwen3.5-9B）。增益呈逆缩放规律：基线性能越弱的模型从harness进化中获益越大。在异构任务集GAIA上，单harness进化会出现停滞，变体隔离策略可恢复稳定提升（+13.6%，15轮无退化）。协同进化相比单独harness优化额外带来+4.7%的增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先关注第1节中现有harness的三大核心问题定义、第3节的可组合harness核心设计、第4节的AEGIS四阶段进化流水线、第6节的主要实验结果（尤其是逆缩放规律与协同进化增益），预计阅读时间20-25分钟。若关注工程实现可查看第3节的类型化原语与替换代数细节，若关注训练闭环设计可重点阅读第5节的协同进化机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agent runtime harnesses (including prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate model observation, reasoning, and action) are hand-crafted, static systems with three core flaws: bespoke reengineering is required for any change in model, tooling, or task domain, with no mechanism for experience-driven improvement; components are architecturally entangled, leading to fragile modifications and copy-based reuse; harness engineering and model training operate in silos, with execution traces discarded rather than reused, preventing joint optimization.
summary_en.importance: The agent harness is established as a first-class determinant of agent capability rather than a peripheral engineering patch, with optimization gains that often exceed minor model version iterations. The proposed harness-model co-evolution framework repurposes traces from harness optimization as RL training signal, breaking both the performance ceiling of harness-only optimization and the training signal ceiling of model-only RL. Actionable insights are provided for agent post-training data pipeline design and closed-loop optimization, while the composable harness formalization lays groundwork for standardized agent engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: HarnessX is a unified harness foundry with three core modules: 1) Composable harness: The harness is formalized as a first-class typed object, assembled from typed primitives (processors spanning context, tools, skills, control, memory) via a substitution algebra inserted at lifecycle hook points. A 9-dimensional taxonomy covers the full behavioral space, enabling type-safe component addition/removal and full decoupling. 2) AEGIS adaptive evolution engine: Harness adaptation is framed as a learning problem over symbolic artifacts (prompts, tools, memory, control policies). A four-stage pipeline (Digester for trace compression, Planner for adaptation planning, Evolver for candidate generation, Critic for assessment) combined with full trace observability addresses RL-aligned risks including reward hacking, catastrophic forgetting, and under-exploration. An optional variant-isolation strategy eliminates cross-task interference on heterogeneous benchmarks. 3) Harness-model co-evolution: A shared replay buffer enables interleaved harness evolution and model GRPO training, allowing the model to internalize strategies from successive harness versions to form a closed optimization loop.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover 5 benchmarks (GAIA, ALFWorld, WebShop, \(\tau^3\)-Bench, SWE-bench Verified), 3 task agent families (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Qwen3.5-9B) with up to 15 evolution rounds. 14 of 15 model-benchmark configurations show improvement, with an average absolute gain of +14.5% and a maximum of +44.0% (Qwen3.5-9B on ALFWorld). Gains follow an inverse-scaling pattern: weaker baseline models benefit more from harness evolution. On heterogeneous GAIA, single-harness evolution stagnates; variant isolation restores a stable +13.6% gain without degradation over 15 rounds. Co-evolution delivers an additional +4.7% gain over harness-only optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: start with the three core flaws of existing harnesses in Section 1, core composable harness design in Section 3, AEGIS four-stage evolution pipeline in Section 4, and key experimental results in Section 6 (especially inverse-scaling patterns and co-evolution gains); estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. For implementation details, explore typed primitives and substitution algebra in Section 3; for training loop design, focus on the co-evolution mechanism in Section 5.

recommendation.zh: 轨迹驱动脚手架自演化的闭环设计有参考价值，重点看§3的AEGIS演化机制与§4的跨基准增益拆解。
recommendation.en: The closed-loop trace-driven harness evolution design is worth referencing; focus on §3 for the AEGIS mechanism and §4 for cross-benefit breakdown.

paper.title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require effective orchestration to coordinate specialized agents, yet training such orchestrators is hindered by limited supervision and high computational cost. We propose Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM), a self-supervised framework for evaluating orchestration quality without human annotations. OrchRM leverages intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions to construct win-lose pairs for Bradley-Terry reward model trai

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统中 orchestrator 缺少监督、训练和 test-time scaling 需要大量子智能体 rollout 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 训练信号与系统方法创新。它把多智能体执行过程中的中间产物转成偏好对，用于训练 orchestration reward model，从而降低多智能体编排训练和搜索的 token 成本。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于 reward 信号构造和 test-time compute 分配，而不是模型基座训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OrchRM，自监督构造 orchestration quality 的 win-lose pair，并用 Bradley-Terry 目标训练 reward model。关键点是不在每个候选编排上重复昂贵的子智能体 rollout，而是在 orchestration level 直接评分，再用于 reward-guided orchestrator training 和 MAS test-time scaling。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 token 使用量最高降低 10 倍，同时 MAS test-time scaling accuracy 最高提升 8%。收益跨多个领域迁移，包括数学推理等；摘要未给出底座模型、具体 benchmark、训练样本量和完整 baseline 列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of supervision and high rollout cost when training orchestrators for LLM-based multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent training-signal and system-method contribution. It converts intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions into preference pairs for reward modeling, reducing the token cost of orchestrator training and test-time search. For pretraining researchers, the relevant part is reward-signal construction and test-time compute allocation, not base-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: OrchRM self-supervises win-lose pairs for orchestration quality and trains a Bradley-Terry reward model. The key design is to score at the orchestration level instead of repeatedly running expensive sub-agent rollouts, then use the reward model for reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to 10x lower token usage and up to 8% accuracy improvement in MAS test-time scaling. Gains transfer across multiple domains including mathematical reasoning, but the abstract does not specify base models, benchmarks, training size, or the full baseline set.

recommendation.zh: 可读方法和消融；真正有用的是“中间产物造 reward”这条线，别把 +8% 当成通用 agent scaling 定律。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; the useful signal is artifact-derived reward modeling, not the +8% as a general law of agent scaling.

paper.title: Arbor: Tree Search as a Cognition Layer for Autonomous Agents
paper.abstract: Arbor is a multi-agent framework that introduces structured tree search as a cognition layer for autonomous agents operating in large, stateful action spaces. Prior autonomous optimization systems operate on isolated targets with stateless evaluation. Arbor instead maintains an explicit search tree of scored hypotheses that serves as the shared working memory across agents, evolving with every measurement, treating failures as diagnostic signal that reshapes subsequent exploration, and expanding

summary.core_problem: 自主代理在大型有状态动作空间中缺乏结构化认知层，传统优化系统针对孤立目标、无状态评估，无法跨层次协调决策并从失败中学习。
summary.importance: 提出将显式树搜索作为多代理共享工作记忆的认知层范式，在 LLM 推理全栈优化这一复杂真实场景中进行了验证。
summary.technical_approach: Arbor 维护一个显式搜索树作为跨代理共享工作记忆，每次测量后演化，将失败视为诊断信号重塑后续探索。架构包括 Orchestrator agent（跨推理栈委派给 Domain Specialists）和 Critic agent（通过根本原因分析保障稳定性），搜索树作为 scored hypotheses 的共享记忆。
summary.experiments: 在 LLM 推理全栈优化（应用、框架、编译器、kernel、硬件栈）上验证，对比传统孤立优化方法，展示 Arbor 在协调多领域专家和从失败中学习方面的优势。
summary.authors_note: 机构未从摘要确认，推测可能来自微软研究团队（Emad Barsoum 曾任职 Microsoft）。

summary_en.core_problem: Autonomous agents in large stateful action spaces lack a structured cognition layer; traditional optimization targets isolated goals with stateless evaluation, failing to coordinate across levels or learn from failures.
summary_en.importance: Proposes explicit tree search as shared working memory across agents — a new cognition-layer paradigm for multi-agent systems — validated on the complex real-world task of full-stack LLM inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Arbor maintains an explicit search tree of scored hypotheses as shared working memory across agents, evolving with every measurement, treating failures as diagnostic signals to reshape subsequent exploration. Architecture pairs an Orchestrator agent (delegates to Domain Specialists across the inference stack) with a Critic agent (safeguards stability via root-cause analysis).
summary_en.experiments: Validated on full-stack LLM inference optimization (application, framework, compiler, kernel, hardware), showing advantages over traditional isolated optimization methods in coordinating domain specialists and learning from failures.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not confirmed from abstract; Emad Barsoum has past Microsoft affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 树搜索 + 多代理认知层的范式在 LLM 推理优化场景有启发性，对做 agentic inference / 自动化系统调优的研究有参考。预训练研究员可浏览 §3 搜索树设计了解思路。
recommendation.en: Tree search + multi-agent cognition layer paradigm is conceptually interesting for agentic inference and automated system tuning. Pre-training researchers may browse §3 search tree design for high-level ideas.

paper.title: Multiagent Protocols with Aggregated Confidence Signals
paper.abstract: Confidence is used for reliability, oversight, and a range of downstream decision tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP), yet no existing method produces or evaluates a confidence for the output of a multiagent system. Prior work uses confidence within multiagent debate (MAD) to weight messages, trigger debate, or calibrate individual agents, but it never aggregates these into a single confidence for the system itself. We introduce three protocols that produce a final answer along with a sin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：多智能体系统给出最终答案时，如何把各个 agent 的置信信号聚合成一个可比较、可校准、可用于决策的系统级置信度。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 agent 可靠性方法，而不是基座模型训练。它的价值在于把单 agent 置信度扩展到 multi-agent setting，并给出可验证的聚合协议与校准流程；对做 post-train、judge、self-verification 或多 agent 推理系统的人有参考意义，但对预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三种协议：先把不同模型产生的原始 confidence 做变换，使其在跨模型间可比；再用 soft voting 或一种称为 Bayesian fusion 的概率融合方式，得到单一系统级 confidence。文中还比较了两类置信估计器，包括 sequence probability 和 self-report confidence，并分析它们在多 agent 聚合中的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 实验以 AUARC 评估置信度判别力，以 F1 评估答案正确性。结果显示，聚合后的 confidence 比最佳单 agent 或标准 multi-agent debate baseline 更有区分度，同时 F1 基本保持稳定，并在更模糊的任务上弥补了 MAD 带来的性能损失。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体任务集细节，因此目前更像一篇系统协议层面的经验论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to produce a single, calibrated system-level confidence score for a multi-agent system, rather than leaving confidence at the individual-agent level.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent reliability paper, not a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its value is in extending confidence estimation from single-agent outputs to multi-agent protocols with explicit aggregation and calibration; useful for people working on post-training, judges, self-verification, or multi-agent reasoning systems, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose three protocols: first transform raw confidence signals so they become comparable across models, then aggregate them via soft voting or a probability-fusion method they call Bayesian fusion. They also compare two confidence estimators, including sequence probability and self-reported confidence, and analyze how they behave under multi-agent aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate discriminative quality with AUARC and answer quality with F1. Aggregated confidence is reported to be more discriminative than the best single agent and standard debate baselines, while keeping F1 roughly stable and recovering some losses that MAD incurs on ambiguous tasks. The abstract does not provide model scales, dataset sizes, or detailed task setup, so this currently reads as a protocol-level empirical paper.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深；若你在做 verifier、self-eval 或多 agent 置信校准，只看聚合协议与 AUARC 结果，别把它误当成能力提升论文。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant; read only the aggregation protocol and AUARC tables if you care about verifier-style confidence calibration, not capability gains.

paper.title: Exploration Structure in LLM Agents for Multi-File Change Localization
paper.abstract: Software engineering tools increasingly rely on LLM based agents to localize files to change to resolve a software issue. Most AI agents explore repositories linearly, that is, visiting one directory or file per step. We postulate that this is a structural mismatch for changes that span several subsystems. We compare linear sequential exploration against non-linear, domain-scoped parallel agentic exploration. Using SWE Bench Pro as initial benchmark, we focus on ansible as an exemplar. We constr

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM软件工程Agent在定位需要修改的文件时大多采用线性探索（每次访问一个目录或文件），这与涉及多个子系统的软件变更存在结构性不匹配。
summary.importance: 提出了非线性、域范围的并行Agent探索策略替代传统线性探索，在SWE-bench Pro上验证了domain-scoped parallel agent spawning的优势，属于SWE-agent领域的方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 对比线性顺序探索与非线性、域范围的并行Agent探索；设计持久会话评估协议锚定在单一base commit；使用Haiku级小模型实现domain-scoped parallel agent spawning。
summary.experiments: 基准包括：无仓库直接访问的LLM、单Agent RLM baseline（持久Python REPL）、Codex 5.5 High CLI baseline；在ansible仓库上测试，domain-scoped并行Agent在Haiku级模型中取得最高micro F1。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM software engineering agents mostly use linear exploration (one directory/file per step) for file change localization, creating a structural mismatch for changes spanning multiple subsystems.
summary_en.importance: Proposes non-linear, domain-scoped parallel agent exploration as an alternative to traditional linear exploration, validated on SWE-bench Pro — a methodological contribution in SWE-agent research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compares linear sequential exploration against non-linear domain-scoped parallel agentic exploration; designs a persistent-session evaluation protocol anchored at a single base commit; implements domain-scoped parallel agent spawning with a small Haiku-class model.
summary_en.experiments: Baselines include LLM without direct repo access, single-agent RLM with persistent Python REPL, and Codex 5.5 High CLI baseline; tested on ansible repo; domain-scoped parallel agent achieves highest micro F1 among Haiku-class models by a large margin.

recommendation.zh: SWE-agent领域的方法增量，仅关注多文件定位的探索策略，与LLM基座预训练无直接关联，可快速浏览摘要了解Agent探索结构设计思路。
recommendation.en: Incremental contribution in SWE-agent exploration strategy, not directly relevant to LLM foundation model pretraining; quick scan of abstract suffices.

paper.title: INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration methods, ranging from brute-force ensembles to learned routers, select models and topologies based on task and model features. However, these methods do not consider the runtime state of the serving infrastructure. On shared GPU clusters under concurrent load, this infrastructure blindness causes systematic resource underutilization: preferred models accumulate deep request queues while equally capable alternatives sit idle. In multi-agent pipelines, where

summary.core_problem: 多 agent LLM 编排通常只看任务和模型能力，不看服务基础设施的实时状态，导致共享 GPU 集群下延迟和资源利用率恶化。
summary.importance: 贡献偏系统侧，讨论的是 agent 编排与 serving 状态的耦合，而不是模型训练本身；对做大规模推理服务和在线评测的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 INFRAMIND，把基础设施信号纳入整个多 agent 栈：规划器在拓扑和角色选择时感知 infra 状态，路由器在每一步根据队列、KV-cache 压力和延迟做模型选择，调度器再联合优化执行顺序。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是在共享 GPU、并发负载和多步 agent pipeline 场景下比较 infra-aware 与 task-only orchestration 的吞吐和延迟；未见与预训练或模型能力提升直接相关的实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration ignores live serving-state signals, causing poor utilization and compounded latency on shared GPU clusters.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution around agent orchestration and serving awareness rather than model training, but it is relevant to large-scale inference operations.
summary_en.technical_approach: INFRAMIND injects infrastructure signals into the full multi-agent stack: an infra-aware planner chooses topology and roles, a per-step router uses queue depth, KV-cache pressure, and latency signals, and a scheduler coordinates execution accordingly.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, the evaluation focuses on throughput and latency under concurrent shared-cluster settings for multi-step agent pipelines, not on pretraining or model-quality gains.

recommendation.zh: 更像 serving-aware agent orchestration，不是 pretrain 论文；若你管线上线或大规模评测，只看系统图和延迟分解就够了。
recommendation.en: This is serving-aware agent orchestration, not a pretraining paper; read it only if you care about deployment or large-scale eval latency breakdowns.

paper.title: Divide and Cooperate: Role-Decomposed Multi-Agent LLM Training with Cross-Agent Learning Signals
paper.abstract: Modern language agents which perform multi-step reasoning have shown strong performance in knowledge-intensive question answering. However, existing approaches typically couple evidence acquisition and answer generation within a single policy. This forces a single model to play multiple potentially conflicting roles, inducing a combinatorial explosion in the policy space and hindering efficient exploration. It also introduces a credit assignment problem during training: a search action that retr

summary.core_problem: Agentic search 任务中，现有方法通常将证据检索和答案生成耦合在同一个策略里，导致两个核心问题：(1) 策略空间组合爆炸——单个模型需要同时扮演多个潜在冲突的角色，探索效率低；(2) 信用分配困难——检索到好的证据但生成失败时检索侧仍受罚，弱检索被生成器的参数知识弥补时检索侧不受罚。多智能体框架在推理端已被证明有效，但训练端始终面临误差传播和信用模糊的难题。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练交叉研究有启发。核心贡献在于提出了一种用一个智能体的行为信号给另一个智能体提供信用的机制——generator 的 abstention 行为作为 searcher 的奖励信号。这种跨智能体学习信号的设计思路，对其他需要联合训练多角色 LLM 系统的场景有借鉴意义（如规划+执行、检索+写作等分解架构）。对 pretrain 的直接启示有限，更偏 post-train/RL 方法。
summary.technical_approach: DAC 将 agentic search 分解为两个顺序交互的智能体：证据采集智能体 S 和答案生成智能体 G。每个智能体只负责自己的子任务，通过专用 LoRA adapter 训练。核心创新是奖励设计：(1) Generator 的动作空间增加 abstention 动作——当它判断证据不足时可以选择拒答；(2) 这个拒答信号作为 searcher 的信用信号——generator 不拒答则说明证据充分，searcher 获得正奖励；(3) 引入 turn-level 差分奖励为 searcher 提供更密集的信用信号。同时识别出过拒答（over-abstention）问题，用 hard-positive evidence augmentation（在充分证据集中加入噪声文档）来对抗 generator 验证边界过于保守的倾向。从博弈论角度用 Stackelberg 博弈解释了合作奖励的不稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上评估，在通用 QA 和 multi-hop QA benchmark 上持续优于所有 baseline（非搜索推理、搜索增强推理、RL 训练的单智能体 baseline）。仅使用两个轻量级 LoRA adapter（约占全量微调参数的 2.12%）就超过了全量微调的单智能体 baseline。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，建议重点看第3节（DAC 框架）的奖励设计细节和图1。可跳过实验细节。阅读时间约 30 分钟。对多智能体联合训练信用分配感兴趣的读者，值得细读关于 Stackelberg 博弈视角的分析和 hard-positive augmentation 的动机部分。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容中确认具体机构和作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: In agentic search tasks, existing methods couple evidence retrieval and answer generation within a single policy, causing two key problems: (1) combinatorial explosion of the policy space as one model plays multiple potentially conflicting roles, hurting exploration efficiency; (2) credit assignment ambiguity—good retrieval is penalized when generation fails, and weak retrieval is unpenalized when the generator's parametric knowledge compensates. Multi-agent frameworks show gains at inference time but training-side remains challenging due to error propagation and ambiguous credit.
summary_en.importance: Instructive for pretrain/post-train interface research. The core contribution is a mechanism where one agent's behavioral signal provides credit for another—generator's abstention acts as reward signal for the searcher. This cross-agent learning signal design is transferable to other scenarios requiring joint training of multi-role LLM systems (e.g., planning+execution, retrieval+writing decomposition). Direct implications for pretrain are limited; more relevant to post-train/RL methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: DAC decomposes agentic search into two sequentially interacting agents: evidence acquisition agent S and answer generation agent G. Each agent handles only its subtask, trained via dedicated LoRA adapters. Key innovations in reward design: (1) Generator's action space is augmented with an abstention action—used when it judges evidence insufficient; (2) This abstention decision serves as credit signal for the searcher—no abstention implies sufficient evidence, giving positive reward to searcher; (3) Turn-level difference rewards provide denser credit signals for the searcher. Over-abstention is addressed by hard-positive evidence augmentation (adding noise documents to sufficient evidence sets) to push back against overly conservative generator verification boundaries. Cooperative reward instability is analyzed through a Stackelberg game lens.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B. Consistently outperforms all baselines (non-search inference, search-augmented inference, RL-trained single-agent baselines) on both general QA and multi-hop QA benchmarks. Achieves better results than full fine-tuned single-agent baselines using only two lightweight LoRA adapters (~2.12% of full fine-tuning parameters).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on Section 3 (DAC framework) for reward design details and Figure 1. Experimental details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: ~30 minutes. Readers interested in multi-agent joint training credit assignment should examine the Stackelberg game analysis and hard-positive augmentation motivation.

recommendation.zh: 角色拆分 + 弃权信号做跨智能体 credit assignment 的思路干净，重点看 §3 的学习信号设计与 §4.3 的信用分配消融。
recommendation.en: Role decomposition plus abstention-based cross-agent credit assignment is a clean idea; focus on §3 learning-signal design and §4.3 credit-assignment ablations.

paper.title: Can Multi-Agent LLMs Identify Their Peers? Stylometric Fingerprinting in Role-Constrained Political Analysis
paper.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines for political statement analysis are vulnerable to peer-preservation bias: models tend to protect peer models from deactivation and show identity-dependent scoring distortions. Prompt-level anonymization was proposed as a mitigation, but prior work simultaneously documented that stylometric fingerprints survive anonymization in role-constrained outputs - raising the question of whether this mitigation is sufficient. This paper provides the first s

summary.core_problem: 研究在匿名化的多 Agent 政治分析文本中，LLM 是否仍能识别生成文本的模型家族。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制与安全分析：它把多 Agent 系统中的身份偏置、匿名化失效和模型输出风格指纹联系起来，但实验场景较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 构造五分类模型归因任务，覆盖四个商业 LLM 家族和一个 open-world unknown 类；比较 Claude Sonnet 4.6、Llama-3.3-70B 的 zero-shot/few-shot 分类，以及用银标数据微调的 T5-base；提出 statement-disjoint cross-validation，避免同一政治声明内容泄漏到训练和测试两侧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数值；实验重点是匿名化条件下的模型家族归因，并用内容不重叠交叉验证检验风格线索是否仍可被分类器利用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can still identify the model family behind anonymized role-constrained political analysis texts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism and safety analysis linking peer-preservation bias, failed anonymization, and stylometric fingerprints in multi-agent systems, though the setting is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formulates a five-class attribution task over four commercial LLM families plus an open-world unknown class; it compares zero-shot and few-shot classifiers using Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Llama-3.3-70B with a T5-base model fine-tuned on silver labels, and introduces statement-disjoint cross-validation to reduce content leakage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full numerical results; the core experiment tests whether model-family attribution remains possible under anonymization with content-disjoint validation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SD-CV 设定和归因结果即可；它提醒多 Agent 匿名化不是干净干预，但政治文本 setup 偏窄。
recommendation.en: Read only the SD-CV setup and attribution results; it is a useful warning that agent anonymization is not a clean intervention, but the political-text setting is narrow.
