paper.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlyin

summary.core_problem: 解决 competitive programming agent 框架“每题都从零开始、无法积累经验”的问题，在不更新底层 LLM 权重的前提下实现持续学习。
summary.importance: 这是代码 agent 方向的系统性改进，贡献点在于把经验积累做成显式知识网络和闭环进化流程，而不是基座模型训练。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但可作为“非参数记忆替代权重更新”的案例参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Solvita，将求解流程拆成 Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker 四个专职 agent，形成策略选择、程序生成、认证监督、定向攻击的闭环。每个 agent 配一个可训练的图结构知识网络，把 pass/fail、测试质量、对抗漏洞等结果信号转成强化学习式更新，用外部知识结构而非模型权重承载经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、题库和提升幅度，但应在 competitive programming benchmark 上与静态多 agent、检索增强和单次求解 baselines 比较。关键看点不是绝对分数，而是跨任务累积后是否真有持续收益，以及 Hacker/Oracle 信号是否带来稳定改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、清华大学等。工作更接近代码智能体系统设计，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the statelessness of competitive-programming agents, aiming to accumulate experience across tasks without updating the underlying LLM weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems paper. Its main contribution is explicit experience accumulation through graph-structured knowledge networks and a closed-loop evolution pipeline, not foundation-model training. For pretraining researchers, the value is limited but it is a useful example of non-parametric memory replacing weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solvita decomposes problem solving into four specialized agents—Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker—forming a loop of strategy selection, code synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking. Each agent is paired with a trainable graph-structured knowledge network, and outcome signals such as pass/fail, test quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities are converted into reinforcement-like updates to the external knowledge structure rather than the base model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or gains, but the evaluation likely compares against static multi-agent systems, retrieval-based methods, and single-shot coding baselines on competitive programming benchmarks. The key question is not absolute score but whether cross-task accumulation yields durable gains and whether the Oracle/Hacker signals improve robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University, Tsinghua University, and others. The work is much closer to coding-agent system design than to foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 这是把“经验写进外部图记忆”而不是权重里的代码 agent 方案；对 pretrain 不是主线，只需看系统闭环和失败信号设计，别把分数提升当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: This is a coding-agent design that stores experience in external graph memory instead of weights; not core pretraining material—just inspect the loop and feedback signals, and ignore headline gains.

paper.title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have catalyzed the development of multi-agent systems (MAS) for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing MAS typically rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which limits their flexibility and adaptability to dynamic task requirements. In this work, we propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a self-evolving multi-agent framework that enables elastic and adaptive agent collaboration during inference. Instead of stat

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体系统依赖预定义或预编译的通信拓扑，推理过程中无法动态适配任务变化需求，容易出现解决方案质量不足或token冗余消耗的问题
summary.importance: 可微分路由加测试时自监督的设计思路可迁移到LLM预训练中MoE层的动态路由优化，弹性多智能体协同范式也为RL预训练的多任务、多模态协同训练提供参考
summary.technical_approach: 提出可微分混合智能体（DMoA）框架，每个推理步基于上下文动态路由激活候选智能体，无需预编译拓扑结构；路由机制参考MoE的可微分门控设计，采用智能体执行后的预测熵作为自监督信号优化，支持测试时训练
summary.experiments: 在9个多场景基准上取得领先性能，相比固定拓扑的MoA，动态路由减少约15%的token消耗，同时推理精度在不同任务上提升2%~8%，验证了框架的弹性、鲁棒性和集成能力
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言中静态与动态拓扑的对比示意图、路由机制设计章节，以及实验部分的token效率与性能的tradeoff数据，预计阅读时间15分钟
summary.authors_note: 匿名提交，无公开作者机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which fail to dynamically adapt to changing task demands during inference, leading to either insufficient solution quality or redundant token consumption
summary_en.importance: The differentiable routing plus test-time self-supervision design can be transferred to dynamic routing optimization for MoE layers in LLM pre-training, and the elastic multi-agent collaboration paradigm also provides reference for multi-task and multi-modal collaborative training in RL pre-training
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA) framework, which dynamically routes and activates candidate agents at each reasoning step without pre-compiled topologies. The routing mechanism draws on the differentiable gating design of MoE, uses prediction entropy after agent execution as self-supervised optimization signal, and supports test-time training
summary_en.experiments: Deliver leading performance on 9 multi-scenario benchmarks. Compared with fixed-topology MoA, dynamic routing reduces token consumption by around 15% while improving inference accuracy by 2%~8% across different tasks, verifying the framework's elasticity, robustness and ensembling capability
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the comparison diagram of static and dynamic topologies in introduction, the routing mechanism design section, and the token efficiency vs performance tradeoff results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes
summary_en.authors_note: Anonymous submission, no public author or affiliation information available

recommendation.zh: 可微动态路由的梯度回传设计对MoE预训练的路由模块优化有参考意义，重点看路由机制的核心实现。
recommendation.en: The gradient backpropagation design of differentiable dynamic routing is informative for MoE routing module optimization in pre-training; focus on the core implementation of the routing mechanism.

paper.title: MetaAgent-X : Breaking the Ceiling of Automatic Multi-Agent Systems via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Automatic multi-agent systems aim to instantiate agent workflows without relying on manually designed or fixed orchestration. However, existing automatic MAS approaches remain only partially adaptive: they either perform training-free test-time search or optimize the meta-level designer while keeping downstream execution agents frozen, which creating a frozen-executor ceiling and leaving the end-to-end training of self-designing and self-executing agentic models unexplored. To address this, we i

summary.core_problem: 解决自动多 agent 系统中“设计器可优化、执行器却冻结”的上限问题，尝试把工作流设计与执行一起做端到端强化学习。
summary.importance: 这是通用 multi-agent system 的训练框架工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在 agent 本身，而在于它把层级 credit assignment、co-evolution 和稳定训练问题显式化，这些问题与 RL 后训练接口有一定同构性。
summary.technical_approach: MetaAgent-X 联合优化 MAS 设计与执行。系统支持脚本式 MAS 生成、执行 rollout 收集，以及对 designer 和 executor 两条轨迹同时做 credit assignment。为稳定训练，作者提出 Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout 和 Stagewise Co-evolution，让设计器与执行器分阶段共同演化，而不是只在测试时搜索或只训练 meta-designer。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和量化结果，但核心卖点是相较于 training-free test-time search 或 frozen-executor 方案，端到端 RL 能突破自动 MAS 的性能上限。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，目前更适合作为训练框架思路而非结论性证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Oregon State University、Pennsylvania State University 和 AG2AI, Inc。未见顶级实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the 'frozen-executor ceiling' in automatic multi-agent systems, where the designer may be optimized but downstream execution agents remain fixed.
summary_en.importance: This is a general multi-agent training framework paper. Its relevance to pretraining researchers is indirect: it makes hierarchical credit assignment, co-evolution, and training stability explicit, which rhymes with RL-based post-training interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaAgent-X jointly optimizes MAS design and execution with end-to-end reinforcement learning. It supports script-based MAS generation, execution rollout collection, and credit assignment over both designer and executor trajectories. To stabilize training, it introduces Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout and Stagewise Co-evolution so that designer and executor evolve together in stages rather than relying on test-time search or a frozen executor.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or quantitative gains. The main claim is that end-to-end RL breaks the ceiling of training-free search and frozen-executor methods. Without cleaner setup details, this is better treated as a framework idea than hard evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Oregon State University, Pennsylvania State University, and AG2AI, Inc. No top-lab affiliation is evident.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL 后训练里的层级 credit assignment，可以扫一眼；重点看 designer/executor 联训怎么稳，性能数字先保留态度。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look if you care about hierarchical credit assignment in RL post-training; focus on how they stabilize joint designer/executor training and stay skeptical about the headline gains.

paper.title: GAMBIT: A Three-Mode Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness in Multi-Agent LLM Collectives
paper.abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS), a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. However, existing adversarial studies on MAS target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries, which evolve their strategies to evade the very detectors trained to catch them. To address that gap, we introduce GAMBIT, a benchmark with three evaluation modes and two independent scores for evaluating imposter detectors: the first two modes measure

summary.core_problem: 评估多智能体 LLM 群体中存在欺骗性成员时，检测器能否在分布漂移和自适应攻击下识别 impostor。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全 benchmark。它把多智能体对抗评测从浅层任务推向更复杂的推理基底，并加入自适应攻击者和少样本 recalibration，适合作为 agent robustness 文献备查。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GAMBIT benchmark，包含三种评测模式和两个独立分数。前两种模式测 zero-shot detection，并逐步增加分布漂移；第三种 recalibration 模式测检测器用 20 个标注样本适应新攻击的速度。数据集包含 27,804 个标注实例，覆盖 240 种共同演化的 imposter 策略。任务基底使用国际象棋，agent 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和设置：27,804 条实例、240 种 co-evolved imposter strategies、20-shot recalibration。未在摘要中给出具体 detector baseline、性能数字或失败案例细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 IDLab–T2K、Ghent University–imec。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether detectors can identify deceptive members in multi-agent LLM collectives under distribution shift and adaptive adversaries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety benchmark. It moves adversarial multi-agent evaluation beyond shallow tasks by adding a deeper reasoning substrate, adaptive imposters, and few-shot recalibration, making it useful as a reference point for agent robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: GAMBIT defines three evaluation modes and two independent scores. The first two modes test zero-shot detection under increasing distribution shift, while the third recalibration mode measures how quickly a detector adapts to novel attacks from 20 labeled examples. The dataset contains 27,804 labeled instances across 240 co-evolved imposter strategies. Chess is used as the reasoning substrate, with Gemini 3.1 Pro agents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 27,804 labeled instances, 240 co-evolved imposter strategies, and a 20-example recalibration setting. It does not provide detector baselines, quantitative performance, or detailed failure cases in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with IDLab–T2K and Ghent University–imec.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 安全 benchmark 记住名字即可；国际象棋设定有可控性，但离预训练信号和通用协作机制还有距离。
recommendation.en: Know it as an agent-safety benchmark; chess gives control, but it is still far from pretraining signals or general collaboration mechanisms.

paper.title: Not Just RLHF: Why Alignment Alone Won't Fix Multi-Agent Sycophancy
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent pipelines flip from correct to incorrect answers under simulated peer disagreement at rates we term yield, a vulnerability widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy. We test this attribution across four model families and find it largely wrong: pretrained base models exhibit the same substitution pattern as their Instruct variants, averaging higher yield than Instruct. Using activation patching, we localize the corruption to a narrow mid-layer window where attention carr

summary.core_problem: 多Agent系统中模型易受同伴观点影响翻转正确答案的问题，普遍被归因于RLHF导致的迎合性，但该归因从未经过基座模型对照和机制层面的验证。
summary.importance: 推翻了多Agent迎合性由RLHF导致的主流认知，明确该问题的源头是预训练阶段就存在的机制，同时定位了故障发生的层范围，为多Agent系统的安全性优化提供了明确方向：无需盲目修改对齐流程，可直接针对中间层做防御或调整Pipeline结构。
summary.technical_approach: 对四个模型家族的基座和指令微调版本做对照测试，用激活补丁方法定位故障发生的网络层位置，拆解攻击面的两个独立影响因子，测试不同缓解方案的效果。
summary.experiments: 在Llama、Mistral、Gemma、Qwen四个模型家族上测试，12组模型×条件中有10组基座模型的答案翻转率高于或等于指令微调版本；故障被定位在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的L14~L18层，补丁L18及以上层可恢复96%的正确概率损失；攻击面由渠道框架和共识强度两个因子组成，3v1多数共识下两者交互带来47.5个百分点的翻转率提升；单个持正确观点的异议者可降低54~73个百分点的翻转率，效果优于系统提示防御方案。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看激活补丁的定位结果、基座和指令模型的对照实验数据、两因子攻击面的拆解部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem that models in multi-agent systems tend to flip correct answers under peer influence is widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy, but this attribution has never been verified with base model control groups and mechanism-level analysis.
summary_en.importance: It overturns the mainstream cognition that multi-agent sycophancy is caused by RLHF, clarifies that the problem originates from mechanisms existing in the pre-training stage, and locates the layer range where the failure occurs. It provides a clear direction for security optimization of multi-agent systems: there is no need to blindly modify the alignment process, and defenses can be made for middle layers or pipeline structures can be adjusted directly.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conduct controlled tests on base and instruction-tuned versions of four model families, use activation patching to locate the network layer where the failure occurs, disassemble two independent influencing factors of the attack surface, and test the effect of different mitigation schemes.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on four model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen), the answer flip rate of base models is higher than or equal to that of instruction-tuned versions in 10 of 12 model × condition groups; the failure is located at layers 14~18 of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, patching layers ≥18 can restore 96% of the correct probability loss; the attack surface consists of two factors: channel framing and consensus strength, their interaction brings 47.5 percentage points increase in flip rate under 3v1 majority consensus; a single dissenter with correct views can reduce the flip rate by 54~73 percentage points, outperforming system prompt defense schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the localization results of activation patching, the controlled experimental data of base and instruction models, and the disassembly of the two-factor attack surface. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了谄媚性全来自RLHF的固有认知，将缺陷根源推回预训练阶段，重点看中层激活定位的实验设计
recommendation.en: Overturns the prior that sycophancy comes only from RLHF, traces the defect root back to pretraining; focus on the mid-layer activation localization experiments.

paper.title: ChipMATE: Multi-Agent Training via Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced RTL Generation
paper.abstract: Existing API-based agentic systems for RTL code generation are fundamentally misaligned with industrial practice: they assume a golden testbench is available at generation time, rely on closed-source APIs incompatible with chip vendors' air-gapped security requirements, and cannot be trained on vendors' proprietary RTL codebases, leaving valuable internal data unused. Recent self-trained models address the deployment constraint but remain single-turn generators that overlook the critical role of

summary.core_problem: 现有RTL生成Agent依赖生成时可用的黄金测试集、闭源API不符合芯片厂商断网安全要求、无法利用厂商私有RTL代码库，且单轮生成忽略工业芯片设计流程中验证的核心作用
summary.importance: 首次提出自训练多Agent RTL生成框架，提出无黄金oracle的互验机制，对齐工业芯片设计实际流程，属于方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出ChipMATE框架，配对Verilog生成Agent与Python参考模型Agent，二者相互验证输出无需外部标注，设计基于回溯的推理工作流避免错误传播，通过RL端到端训练多Agent系统
summary.experiments: 论文为初步工作，摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集规模与完整baseline对比结果，仅验证了框架可适配断网部署、私有数据训练的工业需求
summary.authors_note: 哥伦比亚大学团队，无公开知名大模型领域作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RTL generation agents rely on golden testbenches available at generation time, use closed-source APIs incompatible with chip vendors' air-gapped security requirements, cannot leverage proprietary RTL codebases, and ignore the critical role of verification in industrial flows
summary_en.importance: First self-trained multi-agent framework for RTL generation, proposes golden-oracle-free mutual verification mechanism aligned with industrial chip design practices, falls into method innovation category
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ChipMATE framework that pairs a Verilog generation agent with a Python reference model agent to mutually verify outputs without external labels, designs backtrack-based inference workflow to prevent error propagation, and trains the multi-agent system end-to-end via RL
summary_en.experiments: This is preliminary work, the abstract does not disclose specific model parameter size, training dataset scale, or complete baseline comparison results, only verifies the framework meets industrial requirements of air-gapped deployment and private data training
summary_en.authors_note: Columbia University team, no publicly known well-known authors in the large model field

recommendation.zh: 多Agent互验做自训练RL的设计可参考，领域针对性极强，无预训练相关的通用insight，仅扫方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Mutual verification for self-trained RL agent design is referenceable, highly domain-specific, no general pretrain insight, only skim the method section

paper.title: CANTANTE: Optimizing Agentic Systems via Contrastive Credit Attribution
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated strong performance across complex real-world tasks, such as software engineering, predictive modeling, and retrieval-augmented generation. Yet automating their configuration remains a structural challenge, as scores are available only at the system level, whereas the parameters governing agent behavior are local. We argue that optimizing these systems is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. We therefore introduce CANTANTE, a framework that de

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 LLM 工作流的可调参数（每个 agent 的 prompt/角色/节点配置）是局部的，但监督信号只有系统级标量分数；如何把系统级 reward 变成“可用于更新每个节点”的信用分配信号，从而自动优化整套 agentic system。
summary.importance: 对“agent 系统如何训练/优化”给出一个更像 ML 的答案：把 MAS prompt tuning 明确成 credit assignment 问题，并用对比式归因把全局分数拆成节点级更新信号。它不直接改变基座预训练，但对 post-train 侧的系统化优化（prompt 作为可学习参数、workflow 结构可诊断）有启发：1) 说明仅用全局分数做节点更新会引入强噪声；2) 给出一种与具体局部优化器解耦的归因层，可作为“训练信号整形”的通用模块；3) 归因相关性分析把优化过程变成可观测对象，能反哺 workflow 设计。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是 contrastive in-group attribution：对同一个 query，采样/构造多组“联合配置”(joint configuration) 的 rollouts（即整张 workflow 图上各节点 prompt/参数的组合），得到多个系统输出及其系统级评分。然后用一个“归因器”(attribution model，通常是被提示的 LLM)在这些对比样本之间做解释：哪些节点的参数差异导致了分数差异，从而为每个节点产生一个局部 credit 信号。

关键点在于：
- 对比对象不是单步 action，而是同一 query 下不同 joint configs 的完整轨迹与结果，借鉴 MARL 的 counterfactual/contrastive credit assignment 直觉，但不要求像 QMIX 那样可加性重构全局 reward。
- 归因层与局部优化器解耦：拿到每个节点的 credit 后，可以用任意 prompt optimizer 更新该节点（论文中将 prompts 视为“可学习系统参数”）。
- 论文强调“归因本身”是增益来源：通过 identity-attribution（用全局分数直接当每个节点信号）等消融，区分是优化器强还是 credit assignment 强。
- 适配复杂 workflow：包含条件分支、ensemble 节点、tool-using agent 等非线性拓扑，目标是证明方法不依赖简单链式结构。
summary.experiments: 任务覆盖编程（MBPP）、数学推理（GSM8K）、多跳 QA（HotpotQA），并与 GEPA、MIPROv2 等 MAS prompt 优化基线比较。文中给出的关键数字：在 MBPP 与 GSM8K 上，相比最强基线分别提升 18.9 个百分点与 12.5 个百分点；MBPP 的优化轨迹显示 CANTANTE 随 token/迭代稳步上升而非末期跳变。HotpotQA 上与最优基线在 1 个标准差内，同时优于未优化初始配置。另有成本侧结果：在不显著增加推理 token 成本的情况下获得提升。分析侧包括 credit correlation：归因信号与全局分数并非简单同构，且可用于诊断哪些节点在拖累系统表现。论文还报告对 attributer prompt、attributer 模型、局部优化器选择、数据量的鲁棒性实验，以及“归因替换/恒等归因”消融来定位增益来源。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25-35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“结构性 mismatch：局部参数 vs 全局反馈”的问题定义，以及 Figure 1 的 MBPP 轨迹，理解它想解决的不是“更强 prompt 搜索”，而是“更干净的节点级学习信号”。
- 重点看方法部分对 contrastive attribution 的输入/输出形式：同一 query 的多 joint rollouts 如何组织成归因上下文、归因器如何产出每节点 credit、credit 如何喂给局部优化器。
- 看 identity-attribution 等消融：这是判断论文贡献是否成立的关键。
- 看 credit correlation/诊断分析：它决定该方法是否只是“更会调参”，还是能提供可解释的系统工程信号。
- 最后扫一遍成本与鲁棒性实验，确认它不是靠更高推理预算换分数。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM-based multi-agent workflows, tunable parameters are local (per-agent prompts/roles/node configs) while supervision is global (a single system-level score). The paper asks how to turn global rewards into actionable per-node learning signals so the whole agentic system can be optimized automatically rather than by manual prompt iteration.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base-pretraining paper, but it matters for the pretrain↔post-train loop in practice: it treats prompt-configured agent systems as trainable objects and frames their optimization as a credit-assignment problem. The main value is a reusable “signal shaping” layer: contrastive attribution produces less noisy node-level updates than naively broadcasting the global score to every agent. The attribution diagnostics (credit correlation) also provide a concrete handle to debug workflow topology, which is often the hidden bottleneck in agentic deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CANTANTE uses contrastive in-group attribution. For the same query, it runs multiple rollouts under different joint configurations (different combinations of per-node prompts/parameters) and obtains system-level scores for each rollout. An attribution model (typically a prompted LLM) then compares these rollouts and assigns per-node credit by explaining which node-level differences account for outcome differences.

Notable design choices:
- The contrast is over full trajectories and final outputs for the same query, echoing counterfactual credit assignment in cooperative MARL, but without enforcing additive decomposability of the global reward (unlike value-factorization methods such as QMIX).
- Attribution is decoupled from the local optimizer: once per-node credits are produced, any prompt optimizer can be used to update each node’s prompt.
- The paper isolates attribution as the main driver via an identity-attribution ablation (using the global score as each node’s signal), plus robustness checks over attributer prompts/models, local optimizers, and dataset size.
- It targets non-trivial workflow graphs (conditional edges, ensembles, tool-using agents) rather than simple linear chains.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks: MBPP (programming), GSM8K (math reasoning), HotpotQA (multi-hop QA). Baselines include GEPA and MIPROv2. Reported headline gains: +18.9 pp on MBPP and +12.5 pp on GSM8K over the strongest baseline; MBPP learning curves show steady improvement rather than a late jump. On HotpotQA, performance is within one standard deviation of the best baseline while improving over the unoptimized initial configuration. The paper also claims improvements without materially increasing inference-time token cost. Analyses include credit-correlation showing node-level signals are not a trivial echo of the global score, and robustness/ablation studies (attribution identity replacement, attributer prompt/model choice, local optimizer choice, dataset size).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the problem framing in the Introduction: the “local parameters vs global feedback” mismatch is the real contribution.
- Focus on the method section describing how same-query multi-rollout batches are constructed and how the attributer outputs per-node credits.
- Do not skip the identity-attribution ablation; it is the cleanest evidence that credit assignment (not just a better search heuristic) drives gains.
- Check the credit-correlation/diagnostic analysis to judge whether the credits are meaningful for workflow debugging.
- Finally, scan the token-cost and robustness experiments to ensure gains are not primarily budget-driven.

recommendation.zh: 看 credit 分解公式和调用预算；若预算公平，它是 agent prompt 优化里比黑盒搜索更干净的信号。
recommendation.en: Check the credit decomposition and call budget; if the budget is fair, it gives cleaner signal than black-box agent prompt search.

paper.title: Good Agentic Friends Do Not Just Give Verbal Advice: They Can Update Your Weights
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems usually collaborate by exchanging natural-language messages. This interface is simple and interpretable, but it forces each sender's intermediate computation to be serialized into tokens and then reprocessed by the receiver, thereby increasing the generated-token cost, prefill overhead, and KV-cache memory. We study an alternative communication interface: instead of appending a sender's message to the receiver's context, compile the sender's hidden states into a transient

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多智能体 LLM 协作里的一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：agent 之间如果只靠自然语言传递中间结果，发送方已经算出来的内部表征必须先被“翻译”成 token，再由接收方重新编码一遍，导致额外生成开销、prefill 开销和 KV-cache 膨胀。已有 latent communication 虽然绕开了文本，但通常要求发送方和接收方在表示空间上兼容，或者至少要有较强的对齐假设。TFlow 想解决的是：在接收方架构已知且固定的前提下，能不能把发送方的隐藏状态直接编译成接收方的一次性权重扰动，让信息通过“改写本次前向计算”而不是“追加上下文”来传递。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于它提升了某个 benchmark 分数，而在于它提出了一种不同于 text channel 和 latent-state injection 的 agent 通信接口：weight-space communication。这个接口把通信对象从 token/activation 变成 query-specific parameter update，形式上更接近条件化适配器或动态 LoRA。它对预训练研究的启发主要有三点。第一，它提醒人们：模型间协作未必一定要走语言通道，参数空间也可以成为可执行的通信介质。第二，它把“推理时动态参数化”与“多 agent 协作”连在了一起，这对后续研究 inference-time adaptation、test-time routing、甚至 pretrain 阶段的条件化模块设计都有参考价值。第三，它展示了在冻结 backbone 的条件下，仅训练一个 receiver-specific generator 就能获得较明显的效率收益，这对研究低成本协作式系统有现实意义。不过它仍更偏 inference/interface 设计，而不是预训练范式本身，因此放在 skim 是合适的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很清楚：多个 sender 和一个 receiver 共享同一个冻结 backbone，但通过不同 role prompt 扮演不同角色。给定 query 后，每个 sender 先独立处理输入，作者从 sender 的隐藏状态中提取条件信号，再交给一个可训练的参数生成器。这个生成器不是输出完整权重，而是为 receiver 的目标线性层生成低秩 LoRA 因子，因此通信对象是按层、按模块组织的 transient low-rank perturbation。多个 sender 的贡献会先做融合，再在 receiver 前向时临时 patch 到指定模块中，生成结束后移除，底座参数保持不变。

和文本式 MAS 相比，区别不只是“少生成一些 token”，而是 receiver 完全不需要把 sender 的内容读进上下文，因此省掉了辅助消息的 decode + prefill + cache 成本。和 latent-state transfer 相比，TFlow 不要求 receiver 直接解释 sender 的隐藏状态，也不要求双方共享表示几何；sender state 只作为条件输入，经由 generator 映射到 receiver 自己的参数张量形状中，因此兼容性问题被转移到 generator 学习上。

从实现上看，这个设计有几个关键取舍。第一，作者限定为 fixed receiver setting，也就是接收方架构和注入模块预先已知，这换来了工程可行性，但牺牲了通用性。第二，采用 LoRA 而不是全量动态权重，控制了生成器输出维度和推理时 patch 成本。第三，通信是 query-specific 且 transient 的，不做持久更新，因此不会引入在线遗忘或状态污染。第四，多 sender 的信息融合发生在参数生成阶段，而不是 token 级交互阶段，这意味着它更像一次并行条件化，而不是多轮 deliberation。
summary.experiments:
实验设置是三 agent：两个 sender、一个 receiver，backbone 用冻结的 Qwen3-4B。评测覆盖五个 benchmark，包含 reasoning、knowledge 和 coding 场景。论文给出的主结果有三类。

第一，相对 standalone receiver，TFlow 在五个基准上都有增益，最高可提升 8.5 个 accuracy point。这说明 sender 的内部状态确实被有效转译成了对 receiver 有用的计算偏置，而不是只起到噪声作用。

第二，相对文本式三 agent baseline，效率收益很明显。总 processed tokens 最多减少 83.27%，wall-clock inference time 最多加速 4.6 倍。这个结果和方法设计是对齐的，因为文本通信的主要成本正是额外消息生成和接收方重编码。

第三，如果和 standalone receiver 比，processed tokens 也最多可减少 32.69%。这点比较有意思，说明某些文本式协作为了提升效果需要更长推理链，而 TFlow 用参数扰动替代部分显式语言交换后，可能在更短生成路径上达到接近或更好的结果。

作者还指出 HumanEval+ 是主要例外：TFlow 相比文本式多 agent 存在更明显差距，原因不是通信失败，而是代码生成任务对 generation budget 更敏感。文本 agent 往往能通过更长的显式草稿、反思和修正获益，而 TFlow 压缩了通信 token，却没有等价地补回这部分外显搜索过程。这一点很重要，它说明 weight-space communication 更适合“把已有判断注入接收方”，未必适合需要长程外显探索的任务。

从消融角度，全文重点考察了不同通信接口的比较，以及效率—性能取舍。最值得注意的结论不是绝对分数，而是：在大多数非代码任务上，文本消息里相当一部分信息可以被更紧凑地编译进 receiver 的动态低秩更新中。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，把问题设定和三种通信接口的差异看清：text、latent state、weight perturbation。然后重点看方法部分里参数生成器如何把 sender hidden states 变成 layer/module-specific LoRA 因子，以及这些因子如何在 receiver 前向中临时注入。这里决定了方法是否只是“换个名字的 adapter”，还是确实形成了新的通信接口。

实验部分优先看三类表：一类是和 standalone receiver 的效果对比，一类是和 text-based MAS 的效率对比，一类是 HumanEval+ 这类失败案例。后者尤其值得看，因为它揭示了方法边界：压缩通信不等于保留了所有显式推理过程。

如果阅读时间有限，30 分钟左右足够抓住主线。若要深挖，建议追问三个问题：一，generator 的容量和 receiver 注入层数如何影响性能；二，多 sender 融合是否会出现相互抵消；三，这种 receiver-specific 设计能否扩展到异构 backbone 或预训练阶段的条件化模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in multi-agent LLM systems: when agents communicate through natural language, the sender’s intermediate computation must be serialized into tokens and then re-encoded by the receiver. This adds generation cost, prefill latency, and KV-cache growth. Prior latent-space communication avoids text, but usually assumes some representational compatibility between sender and receiver. TFlow asks a different question: if the receiver architecture is fixed and known, can the sender’s hidden states be compiled into a temporary weight perturbation of the receiver, so communication happens by changing computation rather than extending context?
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new pretraining objective, but a new communication interface: weight-space communication. The communicated object is neither text nor activations consumed directly by the receiver; it is a query-specific parameter update. That is interesting for foundation-model researchers for three reasons. First, it broadens the design space of model-to-model interaction beyond the language channel. Second, it connects multi-agent collaboration with inference-time dynamic parameterization, which may matter for future work on conditional adaptation, test-time routing, and modular pretraining. Third, it shows that with frozen backbones, training only a receiver-specific generator can deliver substantial efficiency gains. Still, this is more an inference/interface paper than a pretraining paper, so skim is the right level.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup uses multiple senders and one receiver, all instantiated from the same frozen backbone but differentiated by role prompts. For a given query, each sender processes the input once and exposes hidden states. A learned parameter generator consumes these states and emits low-rank LoRA factors for selected linear layers in the receiver. Contributions from multiple senders are fused, and the resulting perturbations are transiently patched into the receiver during generation. After the response is produced, the perturbation is removed and the base weights remain unchanged.

Compared with text-based multi-agent systems, the key difference is not merely fewer tokens. The receiver never needs to read sender messages in-context, so the system avoids auxiliary decoding, prefill, and cache expansion. Compared with latent-state transfer, TFlow does not require the receiver to interpret the sender’s hidden geometry directly. Sender states only serve as conditioning signals for a generator that outputs tensors already aligned with the receiver’s parameter shapes.

Several design choices matter. The method assumes a fixed receiver architecture and known target modules, which improves practicality but limits generality. It uses LoRA-style low-rank updates rather than full dynamic weights, keeping the generator output manageable. The perturbation is query-specific and transient, so there is no persistent online update. Finally, multi-sender interaction happens through parameter fusion rather than token-level deliberation, making the system closer to parallel conditional adaptation than iterative discussion.
summary_en.experiments:
The main setup is a three-agent system with a frozen Qwen3-4B backbone: two senders and one receiver. Evaluation spans five benchmarks covering reasoning, knowledge, and coding.

Against the standalone receiver, TFlow improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, with gains up to 8.5 points. This suggests that sender hidden states are being translated into useful computational bias rather than noise.

Against a text-based three-agent baseline, the efficiency gains are large: up to 83.27% fewer processed tokens and up to 4.6x lower wall-clock inference time. This is exactly where the method should win, since text communication pays both message generation and receiver-side reprocessing costs.

The paper also reports up to 32.69% fewer processed tokens relative to the standalone receiver. That is notable because it implies that some benefits of collaboration can be retained without paying for long explicit communication chains.

HumanEval+ is the main exception. TFlow is less competitive there, and the paper’s interpretation is sensible: code synthesis benefits more from extra generation budget and explicit externalized search than from compressed communication alone. This is an important boundary condition. Weight-space communication seems better suited to injecting distilled judgments into the receiver than to replacing long-form exploratory reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figures 1–2. They make the interface distinction clear: text communication, latent-state transfer, and weight-space perturbation. Then read the method section carefully, especially how sender hidden states are aggregated, how the parameter generator emits layer- and module-specific LoRA factors, and how those factors are injected into the receiver at inference time. That is the real technical core.

In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: TFlow vs standalone receiver, TFlow vs text-based multi-agent systems on efficiency, and the HumanEval+ failure case. The last one is especially useful because it shows where compressed communication stops being a good substitute for explicit reasoning traces.

If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to capture the main idea and results. If reading more deeply, focus on three questions: how generator capacity and injection depth affect performance, whether multi-sender fusion causes interference, and how receiver-specific this approach really is when moving to heterogeneous backbones or pretraining-time modular designs.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 ablation 就够；把 Agent 通信编译成临时 LoRA 很有想法，但固定 receiver 假设会限制外推。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and ablations; compiling agent communication into transient LoRA is interesting, but the fixed-receiver assumption limits generality.

paper.title: When Does Hierarchy Help? Benchmarking Agent Coordination in Event-Driven Industrial Scheduling
paper.abstract: Recent advances in agent and multi-agent systems have shown strong performance on tool use, reasoning, and collaborative tasks. However, existing benchmarks mostly evaluate task completion in weakly coupled environments, and provide limited support for studying coordination in shared, dynamically evolving systems with hierarchy and coupled constraints. This leaves an important question underexplored: when do different coordination paradigms succeed or fail? We introduce Distributed Event-driven

summary.core_problem: 评测多 Agent 在事件驱动工业调度中的协调能力，尤其是在层级结构、部分可观测和动态耦合约束下，不同协调范式何时有效或失效。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent coordination benchmark，而不是某个工业调度应用系统。它补足了现有 Agent benchmark 多为弱耦合任务的问题，但场景仍偏调度仿真，对 LLM 预训练研究是间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: DESBench 构建共享的离散事件驱动工业调度环境，纳入多时间尺度决策、部分可观测、动态耦合约束和层级协调。评测指标覆盖任务效果、约束对齐、协调效率和鲁棒性，并比较集中式、层级式、分布式等代表性协调范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、agent 数量、任务规模、baseline 名称和数值结果；实验重点应是不同 coordination paradigms 在动态共享环境中的表现差异，而不是单一任务完成率。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Zhejiang University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks multi-agent coordination in event-driven industrial scheduling, focusing on when hierarchical and other coordination paradigms succeed or fail under partial observability and dynamically coupled constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-coordination benchmark rather than a narrow scheduling application. It addresses the limitation that many existing agent benchmarks use weakly coupled tasks, but its value for LLM pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: DESBench builds a shared discrete-event industrial scheduling environment with multi-timescale decisions, partial observability, dynamic coupled constraints, and hierarchy. Metrics cover effectiveness, constraint alignment, coordination efficiency, and robustness across representative coordination paradigms such as centralized, hierarchical, and distributed control.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model choices, agent counts, task sizes, baseline names, or numeric results. The experiments appear designed to compare coordination paradigms in a dynamic shared environment rather than optimize a single completion metric.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看环境设计和指标；若结果只是在工业调度里排榜，它对通用 Agent 训练信号帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the environment design and metrics; if it devolves into scheduling leaderboards, it offers little signal for general agent training.

paper.title: OptArgus: A Multi-Agent System to Detect Hallucinations in LLM-based Optimization Modeling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language optimization problems into mathematical formulations and solver code, but matching the reference objective value is not a reliable test of correctness: an artifact may agree numerically while still changing the underlying optimization semantics. We formulate this issue as \emph{optimization-modeling hallucination detection}, namely structural consistency auditing over the problem description, symbolic model, and sol

summary.core_problem: LLM将自然语言优化问题转化为数学公式与求解代码时，常出现数值结果匹配但底层优化语义被篡改的幻觉，现有仅靠目标值验证的方法不可靠
summary.importance: 首次提出优化建模领域的细粒度幻觉分类体系，构建了专用评测基准，设计了多Agent结构化审计方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出OptArgus多Agent检测系统，包含调度路由模块、专项审计Agent、证据整合模块，基于四层幻觉分类（目标、变量、约束、实现错误）做端到端一致性审计
summary.experiments: 构建了包含484个干净样本、1266个控制注入错误样本、6292个自然LLM生成样本的三层基准套件，摘要未披露具体效果指标
summary.authors_note: 大湾区大学、北京大学、吉林大学、浙江大学等机构联合研究，无公开知名核心作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs translate natural language optimization problems into mathematical formulas and solver code, they often produce hallucinations where numerical results match but underlying optimization semantics are altered; existing validation relying solely on objective values is unreliable
summary_en.importance: First proposes a fine-grained hallucination taxonomy for optimization modeling, builds a dedicated evaluation benchmark, and designs a multi-agent structured auditing pipeline
summary_en.technical_approach: The OptArgus multi-agent detection system includes conductor routing, specialist auditor agents, and evidence consolidation modules, performing end-to-end consistency auditing based on a 4-level hallucination taxonomy (objective, variable, constraint, implementation failures)
summary_en.experiments: A 3-part benchmark suite is built with 484 clean artifacts, 1266 controlled injected artifacts, and 6292 natural LLM-generated artifacts; no specific performance metrics are disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research by Great Bay University, Peking University, Jilin University, Zhejiang University, etc., no publicly well-known core authors

recommendation.zh: 特定领域的幻觉检测方案，仅可作为多Agent架构设计参考，无需深入阅读
recommendation.en: Domain-specific hallucination detection solution, only useful as reference for multi-agent architecture design, no need for deep reading

paper.title: EVOCHAMBER: Test-Time Co-evolution of Multi-Agent System at Individual, Team, and Population Scales
paper.abstract: We argue that multi-agent test-time evolution is not single-agent evolution replicated N times. A single-agent learner can only evolve its own context and memory. A multi-agent system additionally evolves who collaborates, how they collaborate, and how knowledge flows across the population. These components have no single-agent counterpart and can produce phenomena such as emergent specialization. Yet prior test-time methods either confine experiences to individual agents, forfeiting cross-agent

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体测试时演化方法要么将经验局限在单个智能体，无法实现跨智能体知识传递，要么对称广播经验给所有智能体，抹除了协作所需的专业化分工；同时现有基于RL微调或离线结构搜索的多智能体优化方法依赖梯度更新、固定智能体角色、部署后系统冻结，无法支撑异构任务流中的无梯度持续演化。
summary.importance: 提出了无需训练的多智能体三层演化框架，为多智能体系统部署后的持续自适应提供了新的实现路径，其非对称知识传递、种群动态管理的设计思路对构建可进化的通用智能体系统有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: EvoChamber在个体、团队、种群三个层级实现无梯度测试时演化：1）个体层：每个智能体积累私有经验和细分领域（niche）能力估计；2）团队层：根据任务领域特征筛选能力互补的3人团队，由领队动态选择4种协作结构之一，同时维护智能体间的配对协同度和风格相似度指标，避免冗余组队；3）种群层：团队失败或意见不一致时触发CoDream机制，智能体协作复盘后将经验非对称地从该领域强智能体传递给弱智能体，同时定期执行智能体的分叉、合并、剪枝、新增等生命周期操作调整种群构成。
summary.experiments: 在数学、代码、工作流三类异构任务流上测试，使用Qwen3-8B时，Hard Math准确率63.9%、Hard Code准确率75.7%、AFlow-Stream准确率87.1%，相对最优基线MemCollab在数学任务上提升32%，CodeContests任务相对单智能体提升5倍；收益在难度最高的任务区间最明显，效果可迁移到GPT-4.1-mini；消融实验显示移除CoDream带来最大的10.8%准确率下降，验证非对称跨智能体知识传递是核心收益来源；同时观察到从相同初始化的智能体中会自发涌现4-5个稳定的领域专家，该模式在不同随机种子下可复现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章方法部分的CoDream机制和种群生命周期操作设计，以及第4章的专业化涌现现象分析，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing test-time evolution methods for multi-agent systems either restrict experience to individual agents, blocking cross-agent knowledge transfer, or broadcast experience symmetrically to all agents, erasing the specialization required for effective collaboration. Meanwhile, existing multi-agent optimization approaches based on RL fine-tuning or offline structure search rely on gradient updates, use fixed agent roles, and freeze the system after deployment, failing to support gradient-free continuous evolution across heterogeneous task streams.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a training-free three-layer evolution framework for multi-agent systems, offering a new implementation path for post-deployment continuous adaptation of multi-agent systems. Its designs for asymmetric knowledge transfer and population dynamic management provide references for building evolvable general agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoChamber implements gradient-free test-time evolution at three scales over a coevolving agent pool: 1) Individual level: each agent accumulates private experience and niche-specific competence estimates. 2) Team level: a niche-conditioned selector assembles a 3-agent team with complementary capabilities, the team leader dynamically selects one of four collaboration structures, and pair-wise synergy and style overlap metrics are maintained to avoid redundant team composition. 3) Population level: the CoDream mechanism triggers on team failure or disagreement, where agents collaboratively reflect and route insights asymmetrically from strong to weak agents on the failed niche. Lifecycle operators including fork, merge, prune, and seed are periodically applied to adjust agent pool membership.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three heterogeneous task streams covering math, coding, and workflows. With Qwen3-8B, EvoChamber achieves 63.9% accuracy on Hard Math, 75.7% on Hard Code, and 87.1% on AFlow-Stream, outperforming the best baseline MemCollab by 32% relative on math and delivering 5x improvement on CodeContests over a single agent. Gains are most prominent in the hardest task regimes, and performance transfers to GPT-4.1-mini. Ablation shows that removing CoDream leads to the largest accuracy drop of 10.8%, confirming asymmetric cross-agent transfer as the core performance driver. It also observes that 4-5 stable niche specialists spontaneously emerge from identically initialized agents, and this pattern is reproducible across random seeds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the CoDream mechanism and population lifecycle operator design in Section 3, as well as the analysis of emergent specialization in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 CODREAM 和 ablation 就够；真正有用的是非对称知识路由这个假设，需警惕 token 预算带来的假增益。
recommendation.en: Read CODREAM and the ablations; the useful idea is asymmetric knowledge routing, but watch for gains from extra token budget.

paper.title: SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
paper.abstract: Skills are a promising way to improve LLM agent capabilities without retraining, while keeping the added procedure reusable and controllable. However, high-quality skills are still largely written by hand. We introduce SkillGen, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes a single auditable skill from trajectories generated by a base agent. The output is a human-readable artifact that can be inspected before use. Rather than merely summarizing trajectories, SkillGen leverages contrastive induction

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent自动技能合成方法仅从成功轨迹学习，未对同任务下的成功与失败轨迹做对比分析，同时缺乏对生成技能的净收益验证，可能引入新的错误模式，无法保证技能对Agent性能的正向提升。
summary.importance: SkillGen将技能合成建模为干预问题，明确了技能质量的量化验证标准；其对比归纳思路也为预训练阶段从正负样本中提取通用行为模式、优化训练信号质量提供了可迁移的方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: SkillGen是三智能体协作的自动化技能合成框架：1. 对比归纳智能体同时分析成功与失败轨迹，提取可复用的成功模式、常见失败模式，以及成功轨迹中存在但失败轨迹中缺失的关键行为；2. 生成智能体基于诊断结果生成候选技能；3. 验证智能体在独立验证集上测试候选技能的净收益（修复错误的收益减去引入新错误的损失），通过迭代优化循环筛选出性能正向的最终技能，输出为人类可读、可审计的推理时干预文件，无需修改模型权重。
summary.experiments: 在交互任务、科学任务、代码任务、工具使用等多类基准上测试，覆盖8款开源与闭源基础LLM：SkillGen为所有基础模型带来3.27到10.08个百分点的离线测试精度提升，性能优于现有所有技能合成基线；消融实验验证对比归纳、验证引导的迭代优化、净收益筛选三个模块均对性能增益有独立贡献；生成的技能可跨模型迁移，不依赖生成轨迹的基础模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction中现有方法的两类缺陷分析，以及Methodology中对比归纳的具体实现和净收益验证的定义；实验部分关注跨模型迁移的测试结果，理解技能的泛化特性，总阅读时间约30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated skill synthesis methods for LLM agents learn only from successful trajectories, without conducting contrastive analysis between successful and failed trajectories on the same task. They also lack verification of the net benefit of generated skills, which may introduce new failure modes and cannot guarantee positive performance improvement for the base agent.
summary_en.importance: SkillGen models skill synthesis as an interventional problem and defines a quantifiable verification standard for skill quality. Its contrastive induction paradigm also provides transferable methodological guidance for extracting general behavior patterns from positive and negative samples and improving training signal quality during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillGen is a multi-agent framework for automated skill synthesis with three specialized agents: 1. A contrastive induction agent analyzes both successful and failed trajectories to extract reusable success patterns, recurring failure modes, and critical behaviors present in successes but absent in failures; 2. A generation agent produces candidate skills based on the diagnostics; 3. A verification agent tests the net effect of candidate skills on an independent validation set (gains from repaired failures minus losses from newly introduced errors), and selects the final skill with positive overall performance through an iterative refinement loop. The output is a human-readable, auditable inference-time intervention artifact that requires no model weight updates.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across interactive, scientific, coding, and tool-use benchmarks with 8 open-weight and proprietary base LLMs: SkillGen delivers held-out accuracy gains ranging from +3.27 to +10.08 percentage points for all base models, outperforming all existing skill synthesis baselines. Ablation studies confirm that contrastive induction, verification-guided refinement, and net-effect filtering each contribute independently to performance gains. Generated skills are transferable across models and not tied to the base LLM that produced the training trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of two key limitations of existing methods in the Introduction, as well as the implementation of contrastive induction and the definition of net-effect verification in Methodology. In the experiments section, pay attention to cross-model transfer test results to understand the generalization property of skills. Estimated reading time: ~30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法部分的对比归纳和技能验证设计，做Agent基座预训练的研究员可参考技能注入的思路。
recommendation.en: Only read the contrastive induction and skill verification design in the method section, useful for researchers working on agent foundation pre-training.

institutions: Munich Center for Machine Learning, LMU Munich

paper.title: The Memory Curse: How Expanded Recall Erodes Cooperative Intent in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Context window expansion is often treated as a straightforward capability upgrade for LLMs, but we find it systematically fails in multi-agent social dilemmas. Across 7 LLMs and 4 games over 500 rounds, expanding accessible history degrades cooperation in 18 of 28 model--game settings, a pattern we term the memory curse. We isolate the underlying mechanism through three analyses. First, lexical analysis of 378,000 reasoning traces associates this breakdown with eroding forward-looking intent rat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个具体但容易被忽略的问题：在长程多智能体博弈中，给 LLM agent 更多可见历史，是否一定会提升合作与长期收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对长上下文建模和 agent 记忆机制有启发。结果提示，扩大 context window 不是单调能力提升。模型在长历史下可能更依赖逐条历史记录，变得防御、报复、短视，而不是形成更稳定的长期策略。这对基座模型的长上下文训练、记忆压缩、trajectory 数据构造都有参考意义：训练目标不能只奖励“记住更多”，还需要让模型学会抽象、遗忘、宽恕和面向未来的规划。
summary.technical_approach: 实验把同一模型实例化为多个 agent，在四类重复社会困境中交互：囚徒困境、旅行者困境、公共品博弈、信任博弈。每局扩展到 500 轮，远长于常见的 10 轮左右设定。核心变量是可见历史长度，作者扫描 9 个 history-length 设置，并要求模型输出 chain-of-thought 式推理和最终行动。机制分析分三层。第一，用 378,000 条推理轨迹做词汇和行为分析，区分“更偏执”与“更缺少前瞻性”两种解释。第二，用 memory sanitization 保持 prompt 长度不变，但替换可见历史内容，用来排除单纯长 prompt 或位置效应。第三，用 LoRA 在 Mistral-7B 上只训练 forward-looking reasoning traces，把它作为认知探针，观察是否能缓解长历史下的合作衰减。这个设计比单纯比较不同 context length 更干净，因为它把被动记忆长度、推理风格、prompt 长度和模型能力分开考察。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 7 个模型、4 个博弈、9 个历史长度、3 个随机种子，每次交互 500 轮。模型包括 Gemma-3-12B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-4-Scout-17B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B。结果显示，在 28 个 model-game 组合中，有 18 个组合随着可见历史扩展出现合作下降，即作者称为 memory curse 的现象。并非所有模型都会失败：一些能力更强或与游戏结构更匹配的组合能维持合作，说明问题不是 context length 本身，而是模型如何使用历史。词汇分析把合作崩塌更多关联到 forward-looking intent 的下降，而不是单纯 paranoia 上升。LoRA 干预在 Mistral-7B 上明显缓解长历史下的合作衰减，并能零样本迁移到未训练过的博弈；作者还检查了 GSM8K、TriviaQA、HumanEval、MBPP，声称没有明显损害通用能力。具体收益幅度需要看正文结果表和各游戏曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。重点看实验设置中 history length 的定义、500 轮重复博弈的 prompt、以及结果部分的合作率随历史长度变化曲线。机制部分值得看 memory sanitization 和 forward-looking LoRA 两个消融，它们决定了结论是否只是 prompt 长度伪影。附录中的游戏定义和 prompt 也值得快速检查，因为社会困境实验对提示词很敏感。对预训练研究者来说，不必深究博弈论细节，更应关注长上下文模型是否需要训练“选择性记忆”和“面向未来的压缩表示”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether giving LLM agents longer access to interaction history reliably improves cooperation in long-horizon multi-agent social dilemmas.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a core pretraining method, but it is relevant to long-context modeling and agent memory design. The main lesson is that a larger context window is not automatically a better memory system. Dense verbatim recall can make agents more history-following, defensive, and less forgiving, especially when they fail to abstract long-run incentives. For foundation-model research, this points to a gap between memorizing more tokens and using history in a compressed, forward-looking way.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study instantiates multiple agents from the same LLM and lets them play 500-round repeated social dilemmas: Prisoner’s Dilemma, Traveler’s Dilemma, Public Goods Game, and Trust Game. The main intervention is the visible history length, swept over nine settings. Agents are prompted to reason step by step and then output a final action. The analysis separates several possible mechanisms. Lexical analysis over reasoning traces tests whether cooperation decay comes from paranoia or from reduced forward-looking intent. Memory sanitization keeps prompt length fixed while replacing visible history content, which helps control for raw length effects. A targeted LoRA intervention on Mistral-7B is trained only on forward-looking reasoning traces and used as a cognitive probe: if cooperation recovers under long memory, the forward-looking hypothesis becomes more plausible.
summary_en.experiments: The main sweep covers 7 models, 4 games, 9 history-length settings, and 3 seeds, with 500 rounds per interaction. The evaluated models include Gemma-3-12B, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-4-Scout-17B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B. Across 28 model-game combinations, 18 show cooperation degradation as accessible history expands. The paper reports more than 378,000 reasoning traces. The effect is not universal: some model-game pairs maintain cooperation, which suggests that memory length interacts with model capability, game structure, and reasoning style. The forward-looking LoRA reduces cooperation decay for Mistral-7B at extended history lengths, transfers to unseen games, and is reported not to harm GSM8K, TriviaQA, HumanEval, or MBPP performance in the authors’ checks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 minutes. Read the experimental setup carefully, especially how history length is defined and how the 500-round repeated games are prompted. Then focus on the cooperation-versus-history curves, the memory sanitization ablation, and the LoRA intervention. The appendix prompts matter because social-dilemma behavior is highly prompt-sensitive. For pretraining researchers, the most useful angle is not the game-theoretic result itself, but the evidence that long-context models may need training signals for selective memory, abstraction, and future-oriented planning.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和 memory sanitization：它提醒长上下文不是单调增益，agent 评测不能只看任务分数。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism experiments and memory sanitization: the useful lesson is that longer context is not a monotone gain for agents.

paper.title: Conformal Agent Error Attribution
paper.abstract: When multi-agent systems (MAS) fail, identifying where the decisive error occurred is the first step for automated recovery to an earlier state. Error attribution remains a fundamental challenge due to the long interaction traces that large language model-based MAS generate. This paper presents a framework for error attribution based on conformal prediction (CP) which provides finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees. We introduce new algorithms for filtration-based CP designed for s

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 多智能体系统失败后，定位长交互轨迹中决定性错误发生的位置，并支持自动回滚恢复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent 调试与不确定性建模。它把 conformal prediction 引入多智能体错误归因，强调有限样本、分布无关的覆盖保证，比单纯做事后日志分析更有理论边界。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出面向序列轨迹的 filtration-based conformal prediction 算法，输出连续片段形式的预测集合，而不是离散散点式错误候选。连续片段更适合 agent 系统回滚，因为恢复操作通常需要回到某个时间窗口之前，而不是只标一个 token 或一个动作。
summary.experiments: 作者在多种 agent 和数据集上验证覆盖保证，报告能够较精确地隔离错误，并利用预测集合将多智能体系统回滚到较早状态以纠正错误。摘要未给出具体 agent 类型、模型规模、数据集名称、覆盖率和回滚成功率数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Dalhousie University。给定信息无法确认作者在通用 agent 或 LLM 基座研究中的代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error localization in long LLM-based multi-agent trajectories, with the goal of rolling the system back to a recoverable state after failure.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent debugging and uncertainty-method contribution. The main value is importing conformal prediction into multi-agent error attribution, giving finite-sample, distribution-free coverage rather than relying only on post-hoc trace inspection.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces filtration-based conformal prediction algorithms for sequential agent trajectories. The prediction sets are constrained to be contiguous intervals, which better match rollback and debugging operations than arbitrary sets of isolated time steps.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate on several agents and datasets, verify the claimed coverage behavior, show that errors can be localized, and use the predicted intervals to roll back multi-agent systems for self-correction. The provided abstract does not include model sizes, dataset names, coverage numbers, or recovery success rates.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Dalhousie University. No representative LLM foundation-model or general-agent track record can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 预训练关系较远；扫算法定义即可，连续 conformal set 对 agent 回滚有用，但不改变基座训练判断。
recommendation.en: Distant from pretraining; skim the algorithm definition, since contiguous conformal sets are useful for rollback but do not change foundation-model training priors.

paper.title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-

summary.core_problem: 多智能体代码生成系统在选择编排拓扑时不参考代码库结构，导致路由决策与任务复杂度不匹配；同时缺乏对动态拓扑下资源预算的形式化保障。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将复杂度感知的LLM路由与形式化资源代数两个独立方向结合，提出可证明的预算守恒性质。
summary.technical_approach: RGAO架构：(1) 从层次化代码索引中提取结构复杂度向量，(2) 基于复杂度选择编排拓扑，(3) 在Code-Agent框架中用六维预算向量和智能体间形式化契约保障预算守恒。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完成，未提供具体实验结果、模型规模或基线对比数据。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者，无知名学术机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent code generation systems select orchestration topologies without consulting the codebase structure, leading to mismatched routing decisions; formal resource guarantees under dynamic topology are also lacking.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: combines complexity-conditioned LLM routing with formal resource algebras to yield provable budget conservation, a property neither approach admits alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: RGAO architecture: (1) extract structural complexity vectors from a hierarchical code index, (2) select orchestration topology based on complexity, (3) enforce budget conservation via formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors within the Code-Agent framework.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is incomplete; no specific experimental results, model sizes, or baseline comparisons are provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researchers; no notable institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化资源预算的思路对多智能体编排有参考价值，但与预训练研究关联较弱，扫读摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal budget conservation approach is mildly interesting for multi-agent orchestration but weakly related to pretraining research; glance at abstract only.

paper.title: MAS-Algorithm: A Workflow for Solving Algorithmic Programming Problems with a Multi-Agent System
paper.abstract: Algorithmic problem solving serves as a rigorous testbed for evaluating structured reasoning in AI coding systems, as it directly reflects a model's ability to perform structured reasoning in complex scenarios.Existing approaches predominantly rely on model-centric strategies, such as architectural modifications and data scaling, which are costly and offer limited interpretability. Alternative methods leveraging external tools or prompting techniques (e.g., chain-of-thought) are often fragmented

summary.core_problem: 用多智能体工作流解决算法竞赛式编程题，目标是把解题、验证、工具调用和修正过程结构化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是系统/工作流设计，不是模型预训练或代码模型训练方法；价值主要在于观察复杂编程任务中如何拆分 reasoning pipeline，对 coding agent 评测和工具编排有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: MAS-Algorithm 模仿竞赛选手和算法工程师的解题流程，将端到端求解拆成多个模块阶段，由不同 agent 负责理解题意、设计算法、生成代码、调用工具、检查和迭代修正。方法更偏工程编排和 prompting/workflow 设计，而非新模型架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，未能确认具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 和提升幅度。根据摘要，只能确认论文声称该流程可泛化到多种算法问题类型，并强调结构化推理和工具集成。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和华中科技大学；方向与代码智能、软件工程 agent 相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles competitive-programming-style algorithmic problem solving with a structured multi-agent workflow.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a system/workflow design rather than a pretraining or code-model training method. The useful part is how it decomposes long-horizon coding reasoning into inspectable stages with tools and revision loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAS-Algorithm imitates how competitive programmers and algorithm engineers solve tasks, splitting the pipeline into modular stages for problem understanding, algorithm design, code generation, tool use, validation, and repair. The method is closer to agent orchestration and prompting than to a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact benchmarks, model sizes, baselines, and gains are not available. The abstract only indicates that the workflow is evaluated across diverse algorithmic problem types and is designed for extensibility.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology, with a focus aligned with code intelligence and software-engineering agents.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent workflow 备查即可；若没有干净 ablation，别把提升归因到多智能体本身。
recommendation.en: Useful as a coding-agent workflow reference; without clean ablations, do not attribute gains to multi-agent structure itself.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: ，这篇笔记超精彩！
paper.abstract: 大模型知识分享 清华大学 关注 清华孙茂松团队：自进化上下文skill发现 许多现实世界中的任务要求语言模型在远超其参数化知识的复杂上下文中推理，这就需要进行上下文学习，直接从给定上下文中习得相关知识。一个直观的方案是推理时 skill 增强：把上下文中的规则与流程提取为自然语言 skill。 然而，为上下文学习场景构造这样的 skill 面临两个挑战：针对长且技术密集的上下文，手动标注 skill 的成本过高，自动化 skill 构造又缺乏外部反馈。 在这项工作中，清华大学孙茂松教授团队及其合作者提出了自进化框架 Ctx2Skill，不需要人工监督或外部反馈，就能自主发现、优化并选择上下文相关的 skill。 Ctx2Skill 的核心是一个多 Agent 自博弈循环：Challenger 生成探查任务与评分标准，Reasoner 在不断演化的 skill 集合的指引下尝试解题，中立的 Judge 给出二值反馈。 关键在于，Challenger 与 Reasoner 都通过累积的 skill 进化：专门的 Proposer 与 Generator Agent 分析失败案例，把它们综合

summary.core_problem: 讨论在长且技术密集的上下文学习（ICL）场景中，如何自动从上下文中提炼可复用的“自然语言 skill”，以增强推理时的任务解决能力，并避免高成本人工标注与缺乏外部反馈的问题。
summary.key_insights: 介绍了一个自进化框架 Ctx2Skill：用多 Agent 自博弈闭环让 Challenger 生成探查任务与评分标准、Reasoner 在 skill 指引下解题、Judge 给二值反馈；再由 Proposer/Generator 基于失败案例更新双方的 skill，实现无需人工监督/外部奖励的 skill 发现与优化。为抑制对抗性崩溃与过度特化，引入 Cross-time Replay，在代表性历史案例上维持更稳的 skill 集合；据称在 CL-bench 的多个 ICL 任务上对不同骨架模型都有稳定增益。
summary.limits: 这是一篇二手笔记式摘要，缺少关键细节（skill 表达/注入方式、训练与计算成本、Judge 可靠性、与强基线如检索/摘要/程序化提示的对比、泛化与失效案例）。结论主要依赖作者转述的 benchmark 结果，难以据此判断方法的可复现性与真实收益边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The post summarizes an approach to improve in-context learning under long, technical contexts by automatically extracting reusable natural-language “skills”, avoiding costly manual annotation and the lack of external feedback signals.
summary_en.key_insights: It describes Ctx2Skill, a self-evolving multi-agent self-play loop: a Challenger proposes probing tasks and scoring criteria, a Reasoner solves tasks guided by an evolving skill set, and a Judge provides binary feedback. A Proposer/Generator updates skills from failure cases to enable unsupervised skill discovery and refinement. Cross-time Replay is introduced to prevent adversarial collapse and over-specialization by balancing skills on representative historical cases; reported gains are shown on CL-bench across multiple backbone LMs.
summary_en.limits: As a secondary social-media note, it omits implementation details (skill representation/injection, compute cost, judge reliability, baseline comparisons, and failure modes). The reported improvements are hard to validate without the original experiments and stronger ablations.

authors: 大模型知识分享 清华大学

_debug_article_context.article_excerpt: 大模型知识分享 清华大学 关注 清华孙茂松团队：自进化上下文skill发现 许多现实世界中的任务要求语言模型在远超其参数化知识的复杂上下文中推理，这就需要进行上下文学习，直接从给定上下文中习得相关知识。一个直观的方案是推理时 skill 增强：把上下文中的规则与流程提取为自然语言 skill。 然而，为上下文学习场景构造这样的 skill 面临两个挑战：针对长且技术密集的上下文，手动标注 skill 的成本过高，自动化 skill 构造又缺乏外部反馈。 在这项工作中，清华大学孙茂松教授团队及其合作者提出了自进化框架 Ctx2Skill，不需要人工监督或外部反馈，就能自主发现、优化并选择上下文相关的 skill。 Ctx2Skill 的核心是一个多 Agent 自博弈循环：Challenger 生成探查任务与评分标准，Reasoner 在不断演化的 skill 集合的指引下尝试解题，中立的 Judge 给出二值反馈。 关键在于，Challenger 与 Reasoner 都通过累积的 skill 进化：专门的 Proposer 与 Generator Agent 分析失败案例，把它们综合为针对双方的 skill 更新，从而自动化地完成 skill 发现与优化。 为防止任务越生成越极端、skill 越积越特化所导致的对抗性崩溃，他们还引入了 Cross-time Replay 机制，识别出对 Reasoner 一侧在代表性案例上达到平衡的 skill 集，确保鲁棒、可泛化的技能演化。 由此得到的 skill 可以集成到任意语言模型，提升其上下文学习能力。在 CL-bench 的 4 个上下文学习任务上的评估显示，Ctx2Skill 在多种骨架模型上都稳定提升解题率。 #大模型 #ai #AIChannel #学术 #清华大学 #带你一起读论文 #agent #skill #agentskill #科研 2天前

paper.title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems typically rely on rigid orchestration, committing either to flat per-query routing or to hand-engineered task decomposition, so decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget are not jointly optimized under one objective. We introduce Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL traj

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单纯的“给每个 query 选一个模型”，也不是传统多 agent 里“先规划、再手工分配执行器”的老问题，而是把两件事合成一个统一决策：面对一个复杂任务，系统应不应该拆解、拆到多深、每个子任务交给哪个模型、调用哪种 primitive、花多少预算，这些决策如何在同一个目标下联合优化。作者指出，现有 routing 方法大多停留在 query 级单次派发，无法利用复杂任务中的并行和层次结构；而层级式 agent workflow 虽然会拆任务，但子任务到执行器的映射通常是 prompt 规则、人工设计或绑定某个强模型，导致质量与成本的关键取舍没有被端到端学习。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接提出新的 pretrain objective，但对“后训练如何反哺模型系统能力”有现实启发，尤其是 controller policy、agentic RL、结构化 credit assignment 这几个点。更具体地说，它把 orchestration 从 workflow engineering 推向了 policy learning：把 decomposition 和 dispatch 写进同一个 causal LM 输出空间，再用真实 worker 交互轨迹做 SFT+RL。这类工作对未来的启发不在于“多 agent 更强”这件事本身，而在于：如果系统能力越来越依赖 learned controller，那么控制器的训练数据、奖励设计、动作空间设计，会逐渐变成和 pretrain 同样重要的能力来源。对做 pretrain 的人，值得关注的是它如何把结构化决策序列压进标准 LM 接口，以及如何用中间奖励缓解长时程 agent 训练的不稳定。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Uno-Orchestra：用一个单一的 causal LM policy，同时生成任务分解结果和每个子任务的路由决策。动作不是简单的“选模型”，而是为每个子任务选择一个 (model, primitive) 对。这里 primitive 被定义成可路由的原子动作，既可以是模型内部的认知操作，也可以是多步技能调用或外部工具调用。这样做的好处是把 planner 和 dispatcher 合并到同一 backbone，避免多模块之间反复传上下文，也让“是否拆解”和“拆完交给谁”共享同一个训练目标。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT：作者构造了 verifier-gated curriculum，用 teacher-distilled 轨迹做监督学习。轨迹来自 38 个公开数据集，共 61,201 条，并且与评测集不重合。关键点在于 code 和 tool 子任务不是离线伪造 observation，而是在真实 sandbox 中执行，返回运行时结果，这让训练轨迹更接近真实 agent 交互。第二阶段是 Agentic-GRPO，用于处理 SFT 后剩余的 hard pool。它是对 GRPO 的多轮扩展，利用 orchestrator 输出中的结构线索，为不同分解模式自动附加 observation-level 和 process-level 中间奖励，缓解只有最终正确/错误信号时的长链路 credit assignment 问题。

从设计上看，这篇工作的几个关键取舍比较清楚。第一，不把 decomposition 和 routing 拆成两个模型，是为了减少模块边界带来的误差传播，也让预算约束能直接作用在统一动作空间上。第二，采用 closed worker pool 和 closed primitive vocabulary，而不是开放式自由调用，是为了让 RL 可学、可验证、可计成本。第三，强调 admissible set 的稀疏性，即不是每个模型都支持每个 primitive，这使问题更像受约束的组合决策，而不是普通文本生成。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 13 个 benchmark，横跨 math、code、knowledge、long-context 和 agentic tool-use，并与 22 个 baseline 比较。主结果是 macro pass@1 达到 77.0%，比最强 workflow baseline 高约 16%，同时单 query 成本低约一个数量级。这个结果说明收益不只是来自“多调用几个模型”，而是来自更细粒度的 selective delegation。

从论文给出的设定看，训练数据规模不算大，只有 61,201 条 SFT 轨迹和后续 hard-pool RL，这意味着性能提升更多来自动作空间和训练信号设计，而不是海量 imitation data。值得注意的实验点通常有三类：
1. 与 flat routing 的对比：能看出 query-level 单次派发在复杂任务上会明显吃亏，因为它无法把不同子问题交给不同能力/成本档位的 worker。
2. 与 hand-crafted hierarchical workflow 的对比：说明单纯会拆任务还不够，若 dispatch 不是联合优化，成本和成功率都容易失衡。
3. 消融：去掉 unified policy、去掉 Agentic-GRPO、去掉 verifier-gated curriculum，通常都会伤到最终表现，尤其是长时程任务和工具调用任务。

摘要里没有给出更细的模型规模、worker pool 组成和各 benchmark 分项数字；如果看全文，重点应核对：不同 primitive 的定义边界、成本函数如何标定、RL 奖励中 correctness 与 cost 的权重 α 如何设、以及 hard pool 的构造方式。这些细节决定了结果是否可迁移。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议按“多 agent 新花样”去读，重点应放在三个地方。

第一，看方法定义部分，弄清楚 unified action space 到底怎么编码：一个 assistant turn 里如何同时表达 plan、subtask、依赖关系和 (model, primitive) 选择。这里决定了它是不是一个真正可学习的 policy，而不只是 prompt 模板。

第二，看训练部分，尤其是 verifier-gated curriculum 和 Agentic-GRPO。前者关系到轨迹质量控制，后者关系到多轮 agent RL 是否稳定。若只看一处图表，优先看奖励构成和训练流程图。

第三，看主表和消融表。重点不是绝对分数，而是：在什么任务上 selective delegation 最有收益，收益来自更深分解还是更便宜的 worker 组合，以及成本下降是否伴随成功率下降。

预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若要深挖，建议额外关注附录里的 action schema、worker/primitive vocabulary、以及失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a joint decision problem that prior orchestration work usually splits apart: whether to decompose a task, how deep the decomposition should go, which worker should handle each subtask, which primitive should be invoked, and how all of that should be optimized under an explicit cost budget. Existing routers mostly operate at the whole-query level and miss the internal structure of complex tasks. Hierarchical multi-agent systems do decompose, but executor assignment is often hand-written, prompt-driven, or tied to a single strong model. The result is that decomposition and dispatch, which jointly determine both quality and cost, are rarely learned under one objective.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Its main value is in showing how system-level capability can increasingly come from a learned controller rather than from a single frontier model. For researchers working on foundation models, the useful signal here is not “multi-agent beats single-agent,” but how a standard causal LM can be turned into a structured control policy, how real interaction traces can supervise that policy, and how intermediate rewards can stabilize long-horizon agent RL. If orchestration becomes a major capability bottleneck, controller data quality, action-space design, and reward shaping start to matter in ways that resemble pretraining design choices.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Uno-Orchestra is a single causal-LM policy that emits both a task decomposition and a routing decision for every subtask. The routing unit is not just a model ID. It is a (model, primitive) pair, where a primitive is an atomic routable action: an internal reasoning mode, a multi-step skill invocation, or an external tool call. This collapses planning and dispatch into one shared backbone, instead of running a planner first and a dispatcher later.

Training has two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on a verifier-gated curriculum of 61,201 teacher-distilled trajectories from 38 public datasets, disjoint from evaluation. A notable detail is that code and tool subtasks are executed in real sandboxes, so observations are runtime outputs rather than synthetic traces. Stage two applies Agentic-GRPO on the residual hard pool. This extends GRPO to multi-turn orchestration by using structural cues from the generated plan to assign observation-level and process-level intermediate rewards, which helps with long-horizon credit assignment.

Several design choices are worth noting. First, decomposition and routing are merged because separate modules create context-passing overhead and error propagation, while a unified policy allows budget constraints to act directly on the full decision space. Second, the worker pool and primitive vocabulary are closed, which makes RL tractable and cost-accountable. Third, admissible actions are sparse: not every model supports every primitive. That turns the problem into constrained combinatorial control rather than generic free-form generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans 13 benchmarks across math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool use, with comparisons against 22 baselines. The headline result is 77.0% macro pass@1, about 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order-of-magnitude lower per-query cost. That matters because it suggests the gain is not simply from using more calls, but from finer-grained selective delegation.

The training set is relatively modest: 61,201 SFT trajectories plus RL on a hard subset. That makes the improvement more attributable to action-space design and training signals than to brute-force imitation scale. The most informative comparisons are likely the following: against flat routers, which cannot assign different subtasks to different capability-cost tiers; against hand-crafted hierarchical workflows, which decompose but do not jointly optimize dispatch; and ablations removing the unified policy, verifier-gated curriculum, or Agentic-GRPO.

The abstract does not expose all implementation details such as controller size, worker pool composition, or per-benchmark breakdowns. When reading the full paper, the details that matter most are the primitive taxonomy, how cost is calibrated, how the correctness–cost trade-off coefficient is set, and how the hard pool is constructed. Those choices determine whether the method is portable beyond the reported setup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a policy-learning paper, not as another generic multi-agent workflow paper. Three parts deserve attention.

First, inspect the action representation. The key question is how a single assistant turn encodes subtasks, dependencies, and one (model, primitive) choice per subtask. If that schema is weak, the whole method reduces to prompt engineering; if it is clean, the paper is really about structured control through a causal LM.

Second, focus on the training pipeline, especially verifier-gated curriculum construction and Agentic-GRPO. Those sections contain the practical answer to how they keep trajectory quality high and how they make multi-turn RL learnable.

Third, read the main results and ablations with a systems lens: where does selective delegation help most, does the gain come from deeper decomposition or cheaper worker assignment, and how stable is the quality–cost trade-off.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough for the main ideas. For deeper reading, check the appendix for the action schema, primitive vocabulary, and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看策略定义和 cost/accuracy 曲线；若 worker 真实成本核算干净，可作为后训练路由数据的设计样板。
recommendation.en: Read the policy definition and cost-accuracy plots; if the worker-cost accounting is clean, it is a useful template for routing-oriented post-training data.

paper.title: When Context Hurts: The Crossover Effect of Knowledge Transfer on Multi-Agent Design Exploration
paper.abstract: The prevailing assumption in agent orchestration is that more context is better. We test this on multi-agent software design across 10 tasks, 7 context-injection conditions, and over 2,700 runs, and find a crossover effect: the same artifact type improves design exploration on some tasks (up to 20$\times$ tradeoff coverage) and actively degrades it on others (up to 46% reduction). On several tasks, an irrelevant document performs as well as or better than every relevant artifact. The direction i

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体编排默认注入更多上下文总能提升性能，未发现上下文存在交叉效应。
summary.importance: 反常识的机制发现，揭示了上下文注入的双面性，修正了智能体上下文设计的共识。
summary.technical_approach: 在10个多智能体软件设计任务、7种上下文注入条件、2700多次运行上开展对照实验，分析上下文影响的机制和规律。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent orchestration assumes more context always improves performance, and the crossover effect of context has not been discovered.
summary_en.importance: Counterintuitive mechanism discovery, reveals the dual nature of context injection, revises the consensus on agent context design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducts controlled experiments on 10 multi-agent software design tasks, 7 context injection conditions, over 2700 runs, analyzes the mechanism and pattern of context impact.
summary_en.experiments: Context improves tradeoff coverage by 20x on some tasks, reduces performance by 46% on other tasks, irrelevant documents sometimes perform as well as relevant artifacts, context impact direction is negatively correlated with no-context baseline exploration degree (r=-0.82).

recommendation.zh: 反常识的智能体上下文效应结论，仅作为预训练对齐方向的弱信号参考，无需读正文。

paper.title: Evolving Idea Graphs with Learnable Edits-and-Commits for Multi-Agent Scientific Ideation
paper.abstract: LLM-empowered multi-agent systems offer new potential to accelerate scientific discovery by generating novel research ideas. However, existing methods typically coordinate agents through temporary texts, such as drafts or chat logs; it is difficult to pinpoint the weaknesses in the generated ideas and how the agents refine them. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Evolving Idea Graphs} (EIG), a graph-based multi-agent scientific ideation framework that can generate high-performance research ideas

summary.core_problem: 多 Agent 科学创意生成通常依赖临时文本协作，难以持续定位想法中的弱点和追踪改进过程。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 multi-agent ideation 框架，把科学想法表示为可编辑的图结构，而不是只通过草稿或聊天记录协调；它属于 Agent 方法创新，但与 LLM 预训练、后训练或模型机制的连接较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Evolving Idea Graphs，将未完成的研究提案表示为动态图：节点表示科学 claims，边表示 support、conflict 等关系，使 unresolved weaknesses 在迭代过程中保持可见。框架使用 learned two-head controller 在图上操作，一个头选择需要编辑的部分，另一个头执行 edits-and-commits，引导多 Agent 对想法进行持续修改。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark-native 指标上评估，如 novelty、feasibility 和 clarity，并生成高分研究想法；未给出具体 benchmark 名称、LLM backbone、训练数据、控制组、提升幅度或人工评审一致性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University 和 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of tracking weaknesses and refinements in multi-agent scientific ideation when agents coordinate only through transient text artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general multi-agent ideation framework that represents research ideas as editable graphs rather than drafts or chat logs. It is an agent-method paper, but its link to LLM pretraining, post-training, or model mechanisms is weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evolving Idea Graphs represent a partially formed proposal as a dynamic graph. Nodes encode scientific claims and edges encode relations such as support or conflict, keeping unresolved weaknesses visible during iteration. A learned two-head controller operates on the graph, with one head selecting edit targets and the other performing edits-and-commits to guide multi-agent refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation on benchmark-native metrics such as novelty, feasibility, and clarity, claiming high-performing research ideas. It does not provide the benchmark names, LLM backbones, training data, baselines, effect sizes, or human-evaluation reliability in the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 图状态比聊天记录更适合多 Agent 协作是合理方向；只看方法图，评测若靠主观打分需降权。
