recommendation.zh: UQ用张量分解拆MAS不确定性挺新，但可复现性取决于轨迹采样与拓扑设定；只看分解项定义和验证实验。
recommendation.en: Tensor-decomposition UQ for MAS is novel-ish, but reproducibility hinges on trajectory sampling/topology choices; focus on factor definitions and validation experiments.

paper.title: AlphaLab: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Across Optimization Domains with Frontier LLMs

summary.core_problem: 如何让前沿LLM以多智能体方式在计算密集型优化任务中端到端自动完成“读数据-设指标-写代码-跑大规模实验-总结报告”的完整研究闭环。
summary.importance: 系统创新/Agent范式探索：把“自动研究”从单步代码生成推进到可自举的评测构建与对抗验证、以及可持续积累的在线提示/策略库（playbook），对通用科研Agent与coding agent的工程形态有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AlphaLab自治研究框架：三阶段流水线(1)领域适配与数据探索：LLM自动写分析代码并生成研究报告；(2)自建评测并进行对抗式验证以减少指标投机/评测漏洞；(3)通过Strategist/Worker多智能体循环调度GPU大规模实验。将领域特定行为封装为由模型自生成的adapters，并把实验中获得的知识沉淀为持久playbook，作为一种在线prompt/策略优化机制以提升后续迭代效率与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 使用两种“frontier LLM”（文中称GPT-5.2与Claude Opus 4.6）在三个优化域评测；摘要明确包含CUDA kernel优化（自动写GPU kernel并追求运行时性能）。其余域与具体指标/提升幅度、对比基线、实验预算在摘要中未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Enabling frontier LLMs, organized as a multi-agent system, to autonomously complete an end-to-end research loop for compute-intensive optimization: data understanding, metric design, code writing, large-scale experimentation, and reporting.
summary_en.importance: Advances “autonomous research” beyond single-shot code generation by incorporating self-constructed evaluations, adversarial validation against metric loopholes, and a persistent playbook that accumulates reusable strategies—informing practical designs for research agents and coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents AlphaLab as a three-stage pipeline: (1) domain adaptation and data exploration where the LLM writes analysis code and drafts reports; (2) automatic benchmark construction with adversarial checks to reduce evaluation gaming; (3) a Strategist/Worker multi-agent loop that schedules and runs large GPU experiments. Domain behaviors are packaged as model-generated adapters, and learned procedures are stored in a persistent playbook for online prompt/strategy refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates the system with two frontier LLMs (named in the abstract as GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6) across three optimization domains, including CUDA kernel optimization targeting runtime performance; the abstract omits full details on the other domains, baselines, budgets, and quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 工程秀成分偏多、结论强依赖系统细节；想抄作业就看playbook/自动验证那段，别把“自动科研”当可泛化证据。
recommendation.en: More systems demo than clean science and heavily setup-dependent; read the playbook + adversarial validation bits if you want ideas, but don’t overgeneralize the claims.

paper.title: Enhancing LLM Problem Solving via Tutor-Student Multi-Agent Interaction

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖更强监督模型或异构集成的情况下，仅通过同一LLM的角色分工交互来提升编码问题求解能力。
summary.importance: 系统/范式探索：用“导师-学生”非对称角色交互作为自我改进机制，属于多智能体协作提升单模型能力的思路，对通用/coding agent的交互设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PETITE框架：同一LLM实例化两个agent，学生负责生成并迭代改进解法；导师在无ground-truth的条件下提供结构化评估与反馈（类似自我批判/审阅），通过多轮交互推动学生解法收敛到更优。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体基座模型、任务集合、对比基线与提升幅度；仅说明在自主编码问题域测试“角色化交互”带来的协同增益。

summary_en.core_problem: Boosting LLM performance on programming/problem-solving tasks using only interactions among role-specialized instances of the same model, without relying on stronger teacher models or heterogeneous ensembles.
summary_en.importance: Explores a multi-agent self-improvement paradigm where asymmetric “tutor–student” interaction serves as an internal feedback mechanism, informing the design of coding agents and interactive problem-solving workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PETITE: two agents instantiated from the same LLM. The student generates and iteratively refines solutions, while the tutor provides structured critique and guidance without access to ground truth; repeated feedback cycles drive the student toward better solutions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains on autonomous coding/problem-solving settings from the role-based interaction, but omits the underlying model, benchmarks, baselines, and quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 同模型分角色提分并不新，容易被提示长度与自一致性效应混淆；当作交互模板库看看即可，主要读消融与失败例。
recommendation.en: Same-model role-splitting gains aren’t novel and can be confounded by prompt length/self-consistency; treat it as an interaction pattern library—skim ablations and failure cases.
